name: Arrow Hoodling

skills.name: Bow
text: Shooting Attack with a bow at “Range: 2 (20m)”. Accuracy check and
damage are the same as a normal attack.

skills.name: Targeting
text: Stray shots cannot occur.

description: The Hoodling is a small Youma common on the Alframe continent. They are ugly and have grayish skin. They have large heads, long, slender limbs and walk with a forward slant.
They hate their look and hide by wearing hoods. Also, they hate beautiful things and especially enjoy killing Humans and elves.
Arrow Hoodlings are armed with bows and prefer to surround their prey in groups, shooting and killing them all at once.

name: Kobold
description: Kobolds are the weakest monsters among the Barbarous. They are about 1.2m tall and resemble upright dogs. Other Barbarous treat them like slaves or emergency rations, and some of them, not liking it, flee to the Humanoid cities.
They are obedient to everyone and loyal to those who feed them. Because of their dexterity and culinary skills, they can often be seen working in the dining hall attached to the Adventurers' Guild.

name: Dagger Hoodling
description: Armed with a dagger, this Hoodling excels in close combat.

Hoodlings are short-sighted, unable to understand the battlefield, and are so eager to fight that they are blind to their surroundings. They act in groups and obey stronger Barbarous such as Goblins and Bolgs. They have no fear of death and are mainly enslaved.

name: Gremlin

skills.name: Targeting
text: Stray shots cannot occur.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Gremlin receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

description: They look like infants with hair all over their bodies and have small fangs and bat-like wings. They work hard and are mischievous, sometimes tricking and kidnapping Humanoid children or robbing livestock.

They also like to break things like watermills and windmills. Because of that, Humanoids use “Gremlin laughed” as a synonym for the failure of devices. They have the same position as Bolgs in the Barbarous army.

name: Goblin
description: Goblins have green skin and are shorter than humans, with stubby limbs and large eyes and noses.

They act intimidating when they feel dominant but quickly grovel when overpowered. These petty creatures neither learn from their mistakes nor show any self-reflection, and they betray others without hesitation.

They are fertile and mainly work in groups. They are not very smart, but they are resourceful. They are rather unintelligent creatures and often steal and rob to survive. In addition, they completely lack the reflex to flee from danger.

name: Saber Hoodling

skills.name: Decoy Attack I
text: It gains -2 to Accuracy checks, but the damage is increased by +2 on hit.
If the declared attack is evaded, the enemy receives a -1 penalty to Evasion
checks for the next 10 seconds (1 round). This effect is cumulative up to -
4 but is lost if the target fails an Evasion check even once.

description: A Saber-equipped Hoodling excels at hunting in groups, using intimidation to drive the enemy toward its companions. When they appear with upper Barbarous such as Bolgs (see p. 75) and Hugls (see p. 74), their attacks become even more threatening.

name: Sahagin
description: Sahagin resemble fish with arms and legs. They are treated as slaves among the Gilman tribe and are often used for labor and as soldiers. Sahagin are very self-conscious and timid, and will not fight unless ordered to by a superior. They primarily live in water but sometimes attack small boats or children playing on the shore.

name: Hugl

skills.name: Mobile Flying
text: It gains a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion checks for melee attacks for
10 seconds (1 round).
This ability cannot be used in consecutive turns. When used in Combat
Preparation, it cannot be used in the first round, regardless of the result of
the Initiative check.

skills.name: Winged Pursuit
text: If it hits with a Claw attack, it can make an additional melee attack with
wings. Accuracy bonus, damage, and other values are the same as for the
claw attack.
This ability cannot be used on the same turn in which [⏩△Mobile Flying]
is used. Also, once an additional attack is made with this ability,
[⏩△Mobile Flying] cannot be used on that turn.

description: This Youma has a lizard-like face, brown scales, and a long tail. It has large, strong, leathery wings on its back and can fly.

Although smaller in stature than Humans, they are strong enough to grab a Human child or goat and fly away and can attack simultaneously with sharp claws on both arms and wings on their back. However, it is not good at flying and fighting simultaneously.
Hugls live in family units on rocky mountains but are often seen accompanying other Barbarous as bouncers.

name: Centaur

skills.name: Fairy Magic 2 Level/Magic Power 4 (11)
text: It can use earth, fire, wind, and light types.

skills.name: Charge/5 (12)/Evasion/Neg
text: This ability can only be used in the round in which the Normal Move is
made.
Charges and spears 1 enemy character as with melee attack, dealing
"2d+7" physical damage.

description: These are Barbarous, with the Human's upper body connected to the horse's body. They are proud to be Barbarous, fight, and make a name for themself fairly and squarely.
Centaurs also tend to be excellent soldiers listening to orders.

name: Shield Hoodling

skills.name: Cover I
text: The effect is the same as the combat feat [Cover I] (see CR I, p. 255).

description: The Hoodling (see p. 72) holds a shield large enough to conceal itself. Although they can attack by slamming their large shield down, their main role is to cover their Barbarous superiors when they are exposed to attack.
This shield is a sign of strength and self-discipline but often makes them overconfident.

name: Hook Hoodling

skills.name: Hook Rope
text: Attacks with Grappling Hook are treated as melee attacks that reach up
to "Range: 1 (10m)".

skills.name: Hanging by a Rope
text: The piece of rope is used to hang from an overhead structure or other
object. The Hook Hoodling does not receive any penalty until the
beginning of the next move due to poor footing. Additionally, they receive
a +1 bonus to Accuracy checks, and damage is reduced by -2.
Note that this ability can only be used in environments with ceilings or
tall structures overhead, such as in a city.

description: They are Hoodlings (see p. 72), who quickly appear on the outer edges of towns inhabited by Humanoids and carry out destruction and looting. They carry 10-meter-long hooked ropes in their hands, which they use to hook ceilings and other objects, and move about by swinging down like a pendulum.

name: Hugl Caster

skills.name: Targeting
text: Spells with “Area: Shot” fired into a skirmish will not cause stray shots.

skills.name: Mobile Flying
text: It gains a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion checks for melee attacks for
10 seconds (1 round).
This ability cannot be used in consecutive turns. When used in Combat
Preparation, it cannot be used in the first round, regardless of the result of
the Initiative check.

description: Perhaps once a servant of an evil magician, some Hugls can use magic. Such individuals become leaders of small groups or preside over evil rituals.
Sometimes they collaborate with Bolgs and others to plan evil acts, such as an attack on a Humanoid settlement.

name: Hog Hoodling
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Rider/Pig) Main Section: Rider

skills.name: Dismounting
text: This monster’s Rider section is mounted on the Pig section. If the Rider
is dismounted, all sections suffer a -2 penalty on all Skill Checks and have
their damage reduced by -2 points.
See Rider class and the Riding Rules (see CR III, p. 87) for rules for this
monster on how to dismount and mount back at the mount.

description: This is a Hoodling (see p. 72) who is used to handling animals and fights by riding on them. The riding animal is carried around for food and may be a variety of small to medium size animals, not limited to pigs.

name: Bolg

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +4 points.

description: They are larger, stronger, and hairier Barbarous than Humans.
They have bluish skin, and most of their body hair is white. They are characterized by their large fangs and ferocious nature.

They prefer swords, spears, long-handled weapons, etc. Their intellect is low, they love a fight, and they will fight to the death because they believe they can turn the tables no matter how unfavorable the odds are.
They are also good at training animals and mounts and can force a mount or other inferior Barbarous to serve them.

name: Bolg Highlander

skills.name: Repeated Strike I
text: Can make two Accuracy checks; if one hits, the damage is dealt once.

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +6 points.

description: They are the leaders of a small group of the Bolg tribe (see p. 186).
Armed with a two-handed greatsword, they exhibit overwhelming combat prowess.

They make their home in underground labyrinths and ruins and repeatedly attack Human settlements. Bolgs believe that the bigger the weapon, the stronger they are, and they are more daring and bold in their fighting style.

name: Medusa

skills.name: Simultaneous Attack
text: A Medusa's Snake Hair attacks all characters in the skirmish, but a
separate Accuracy Check is needed for each character.

skills.name: Snake Venom/5 (12)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Snake Hair attack hits, it inflicts 3 poison magic damage to the
target.

skills.name: Eyes of Stone/4 (11)/Willpower/Neg
text: At the end of each round, if a character faces a Medusa, they need to roll
a Willpower Check or receive effects of Petrification (Dexterity, Agility/-
This effect is treated as a curse type.

loot.item: Eyes of Stone (1,200G/Gold, Red, Black S)

description: Often mistaken for a human female, Medusae are barbarous with multiple thin snakes for hair. Not only can a Medusa slowly petrify unlucky adventurers, but the hair snakes are also poisonous. Rarely a Medusa's eyes may retain their fearsome gaze after death. These magical eyes can be used to make magical armor and command a high price in the markets.

name: Lizardman

skills.name: Tail Sweep
text: The monster can use its tail to attack up to 5 targets in the same skirmish.
An Accuracy check is made on all characters at once, and damage is
determined individually.
This attack cannot be used in consecutive rounds.

description: Lizardmen are one of the more aquatically inclined barbarous, preferring to spend time in swamps and other wetlands worshiping their dragon gods. Standing shy of 2m, they look like upright lizards, though they take offense if mistaken for lildraken.
While they cannot breathe underwater, like elves, Lizardmen can hold their breath for up to an hour and similarly have houses with dry and wet sections.

name: Lizardman Bearer

skills.name: Inspiring Flag Spear/Can’t
text: Lizardman Bearer raises its flag spear high, inspiring allies.
Lizardmen (regardless of gender) within "Range: Caster" and "target: All
Areas (30m radius)/All" get +1 bonus to Accuracy check and Magic Power
of unique skill for 10 seconds (1 round) and regain 5 HP immediately.
This unique skill cannot be used on consecutive turns.

description: He is one of the Lizardmen. Their fighting ability is no different from that of an ordinary Lizardman, but they carry a battle flag attached to their spear. In battle, they stay in the rear or beside their regiment, inspiring and supporting their comrades.

name: Lesser Ogre
language: Trade Common, Barbaric, Ogre, Drakish, Arcana

skills.name: Personification
text: A Lesser Ogre may take on the appearance and mannerisms of a
character they have eaten or can change back. It can be either innate or
something that once had its heart eaten out of it.
When transformed, the Lesser Ogre's maximum HP and MP are
decreased by 5. Accuracy, Evasion, Fortitude, and Willpower are also
reduced by 1 point each. This form can be held up to 18 hours per day.
The [⏩△Personification] can also be canceled by Minor Action and
Combat Preparation.

description: Standing about 2m tall, a Lesser Ogre is a fearsome flesh-eating behemoth of pure muscle. Lesser Ogres are still small among Ogres (see p. 59). Lesser Ogre's most distinctive feature is its ability to take on Human form.

Those who actively take on Human form often have a deep knowledge of Human culture, which may be why some have a Human-like personality and mindset. Lesser Ogre can take the form of a fixed Humanoid, but if it eats the heart of a Humanoid, it can also take that individual's form. The more hearts they eat, the more forms they can take.
It is difficult to detect a Lesser Ogre disguised as a Humanoid. The PCs must have sufficient reason to be suspicious (as judged by the GM) to perform a Detect check (see CR I, p. 111).

name: Loreley

skills.name: Special Spellsong [Love Song] /7(14)/All areas (40m Radius)
text: Can use [Love Song] (see CR II, p. 194) spellsong. This unique skill can
only be used if a male is in the opposing faction and if [►Basic Spellsongs]
were used on the previous turn.

skills.name: [Finale: Spring Breeze]/7 (14)
text: Uses [Finale: Spring Breeze] at "Range: 2 (40m)" to deal 1 character 2d+4
wind magic damage.
This unique skill could be used only if [►Basic Spellsongs] or [►Special
Spellsong] were used on the previous turn.

description: They are a tribe of Barbarous who live in rivers and riverbanks and take the form of beautiful, light-robed women. They charm humanoid men with their magical singing voices and kidnap them to live in their dwellings. However, when Loreley gets bored or they are no longer useful, Loreley is believed to simply throw them into the river and leave them to drown.

name: Arakcruder

skills.name: Flight
text: This monster receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Spear Pursuit
text: A monster’s spear can be used as a melee attack against an opponent who
has been attacked with a beak.
Accuracy check and damage are the same as those of the beak. This effect
is effective only when the monster is Flying.

description: Arakcruder is Barbarous with its entire body is covered with feathers, and its head resembles a bird of prey. It has a pair of upper limbs with large wings. It is about 2 meters tall, but its wing span is twice that when flying. Although their ability to manipulate objects with their hands has degenerated significantly, they can use their legs like hands while flying, and they mainly live in this way. When they have no choice but to walk, they walk upright.

They are territorial and live in groups, building primitive dwellings in caves, cliffs, or on the tops of large trees, often using floating rocks (see CR I, p. 341) as their strongholds. Although belligerent and ferocious, they revere Garuda (see p. 97) as the King of the Flying Barbarous, and many serve them.

name: Androscorpion
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Upper Body / Lower Body) Main Section: Upper Body

skills.name: Gunfire/6 (13)/Evasion/Neg
text: An Androscorpion can attack with a readied gun, whose Max. Magazine
is 4, the range is 2(20m), and the Critical Threshold is 10.

skills.name: Targeting
text: Stray shots cannot occur.

skills.name: Poison/5 (12)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Androscorpion's Lower Body hits with their Tail attack, the target
will receive an extra 6 poison-type damage.

skills.name: Weakening
text: When the Lower Body section is reduced to 0 HP or fewer, the
Androscorpion receives a -2 penalty for Evasion.

loot.item: Poison Stinger with Intact Poison Sac (800G/Red A)

description: These odd barbarous have a humanoid upper body growing out of the lower body of a giant scorpion.

Living in deserts and around ruins, Androscorpions are reasonably capable Artificers in their own right. They will often be seen carrying and wearing the various spoils of their expeditions, whether armor, weapons, or strong magical artifacts.

name: Goblin Shaman

skills.name: Fairy Magic 5 Level/Magic Power 8 (15)
text: Types used are "Earth", "Fire", "Wind", and "Dark".

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: Can use [Metamagic/Targets] Combat Feat.

description: This is a higher class Goblin (see p. 73). They look like ordinary Goblins, but they are decorated with dark-colored bird feathers and gems. They are more intelligent than ordinary Goblins and can cast spells.

name: Dawn Walker

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Metamagic/Targets], [Multi-
Action].

description: Dawns are barbarous creatures that wear black cloaks and infiltrate humanoid habitats. They are about 1.8 meters tall, with stout, rounded backs. Their bodies are entirely covered in dark-colored body hair, and they have long, sharp claws on both hands.
They possess knowledge of stealth and carry out their duties unnoticed at the request of the Upper Barbarous. Loyal and modest, they prioritize the accomplishment of their mission above all else.
They follow Dalkhrem, Zeides, and Eiryak and sometimes act as liaisons with the pagan cult of humanoids.

name: Hugl Assaulter

skills.name: Mobile Flying
text: It gains a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion checks for melee attacks for
10 seconds (1 round).
This ability cannot be used in consecutive turns. When used in Combat
Preparation, it cannot be used in the first round, regardless of the result of
the Initiative check.

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: They can make two Claws attacks each round. After checking the result
of the first attack, the monster can choose whether to make a second attack
on the same target further or on a different target of their choice.

skills.name: Winged Pursuit
text: If it hits with a Claw attack, it can make an additional melee attack with
wings. Accuracy bonus, damage, and other values are the same as for the
claw attack.
This ability cannot be used on the same turn in which [⏩△Mobile Flying]
is used. Also, once an additional attack is made with this ability,
[⏩△Mobile Flying] cannot be used on that turn.

description: This is a warrior of the Hugl clans (see p. 74) with sharper fingers and enhanced fighting skills.
Skilled at fighting multiple opponents, they use their claws and wings to strike down one foe after another. They are carefree and are sometimes asked to serve as guards for weaker Barbarous.

name: Bolg Heavy Arm

skills.name: Power Strike I
text: They can deal an additional 4 damage on their next attack. However, any
Evasion Check made by them this turn receives a -2 penalty.

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +6 points.

description: They are heavily-armed warriors of the Bolg tribe (see p. 75). Armed with a shield and a greatsword, they will do their best to crush their enemies without fear of being wounded.

name: Merman

skills.name: Underwater Specialization
text: Can move in water without penalties and restrictions. Conversely, all
action checks are subject to a -2 penalty on the ground.

skills.name: Cover I
text: Can use [Cover I] combat feat (see CR I, p. 256).

description: Also called mermaids, these barbarous have the lower half as that of a fish. Since they lived in the sea, they had little contact with other barbarous and humanoids, so they have remained neutral and have not been eradicated in the Magitech Civilization era.

As a race, Mermen tend to avoid fighting except in self-defense and are often neutral towards most other races. However, they have a hostile relationship with some marine Barbarous, which could theoretically be leveraged into an alliance with Elves against the other aquatic races.

name: Diablo Cadet (Human Form)

skills.name: Tough Skin
text: Whenever it receives physical or magical damage of the bludgeoning
type, it is reduced by -3 points.

skills.name: Flight
text: Receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee attacks.

skills.name: Cleave I
text: It can attack up to 3 characters with melee attacks that can be reached,
but the damage will be reduced by -3. If more than one is hit, the damage
is determined individually.

skills.name: Daemonic Eyes/Can’t
text: With a sharp look in its eyes, it makes enemies shrivel.
With “Range/Area: 1 (10m)/Target”, select any number of targets and
deal each of them 2 curse magic damage. Afterward, Diablo’s HP is
restored by the sum of all applied damage dealt to the targets.
Using this ability consumes 2 points of MP per character targeted.

skills.name: Daemonshift
text: The character changes into the daemon form. For the data, see Diablo
Cadet (Daemon Form). HP and MP are restored to their maximum values,
and all effects of magic, etc., are negated. In the turn in which
[►Daemonshift] is performed, only the Body section of the Daemon
Form is treated as having completed the Major Action, and the Head
section can make it this turn.
[►Daemonshift] cannot be used for 3 hours immediately after the
[►Humanification] was used. Also, [►Humanification] cannot be used
for 1 hour immediately after [►Daemonshift] was used.

description: It is said that the race was created at the end of the Magic Civilization Period as a result of a fusion experiment between Barbarous and daemons. Known on the Alframe continent as the upper Barbarous along with Drakes, Cadets are young candidates for leadership.

They have blue-colored skin, large and prominent horns, and black jewels in which the mana is condensed in various body parts. Although they do not have wings, they are able to float with the power of their jewels. Their facial features resemble those of Humans and elves, and they are intimidating and highly charismatic at the same time.

While flexible, their skin instantly hardens to protect the body against strong attacks, and sharp prongs extend from the shoulders, elbows, knuckles, and fingertips (the presence varies from individual to individual). These protrusions can be used by Diablos by pulling them out to create their own weapons (mainly swords and spears).
Diablos have the ability to transform into a form similar to that of a daemon. This transformation makes them twice their size and gives them incredible power.
With numerous Bolgs (see p. 75) and Goblins (see p. 73) in their ranks, they attack the Humanoid realm with their prowess and guile.

name: Diablo Cadet (Daemon Form)
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Head/Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Tough Skin
text: Whenever it receives physical or magical damage of the bludgeoning
type, it is reduced by -3 points.

skills.name: Daemonic Eyes/Can’t
text: With a sharp look in its eyes, it makes enemies shrivel.
With “Range/Area: 1 (10m)/Target”, select any number of targets and
deal each of them 2 curse magic damage. Afterward, Diablo’s HP is
restored by the sum of all applied damage dealt to the targets.
Using this ability consumes 2 points of MP per character targeted.

skills.name: Chain of Curses/8(15)/Willpower/Half
text: Diablo injures themselves to curse an enemy.
They can select an arbitrary number of targets with “Range: 1 (10m)” and
“Area: Target” and deal each of them 2d+6 curse magic damage.
To use this ability, 8 points of HP and 4 points of MP per number of
targets must be consumed (HP consumption is 8 points, regardless of the
number of targets).

skills.name: Flight
text: All sections receive a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If the Body section falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be
used.

skills.name: Cleave I
text: It can attack up to 3 characters with melee attacks that can be reached,
but the damage will be reduced by -3. If more than one is hit, the damage
is determined individually.

skills.name: Humanification
text: It changes to the Human form. For data on the Human form, refer to
Diablo Cadet (Human Form). If the Body section has suffered HP or MP
damage or has been affected by magic or other effects, these are carried
over to the Human form. If its HP is less than 0, it immediately falls
unconscious.
[►Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately after
[►Daemonshift] was used. Also, [►Daemonshift] cannot be used for 3
hours immediately after the [►Humanification] was used.

description: It is a giant Diablo Cadet. Its form is reminiscent of a daemon, and it is more powerful in it. It symbolizes awe for both the Humanoid and the Barbarous and is the cause of why Diablos are feared. The fear is also heightened by the giant Diablo becoming more aggressive and brutal.
However, after taking this form and releasing it, they cannot Daemonshift again for some time.

name: Arbor

skills.name: Magic (1 system) 5 Level /Magic Power 8 (15)
text: Arbor can cast either Fairy Magic or Nature Magic at the 5th level.
In the case of Fairy Magic, the types used are "Earth" and "Fire".

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Metamagic/Targets], [Multi-
Action].

skills.name: Weapons of Raging Fire
text: Sews the weapon with its own angry faire. Arbor empowers up to 5 targets
within an area (3m radius) centered on themself with fire. Empowered
targets now deal fire-type damage, and their melee and ranged are treated
as attacking with magical weapons for 3 minutes (18 rounds), granting +2
points to physical damage (not magic damage).
Using this effect consumes 8 points of MP.

description: Arbors are Barbarous that live deep within the forest. They resemble Humans but have white skin like snow and white or light green hair. They have large eye-like patterns on their forehead and all over their body.

Arbors are considered close relatives of Meria. Although they do not have flowers, their ecology and body structure are similar to those of the long- lived Meria. According to legend, during the War of the Gods, the trees in the forests that Dwarves burned to make large quantities of armor took human form with the hatred fueled by Ignis. Arbors especially hate Dwarves and are also enemies of Artificers since their forests were massively cut down during the Magitech Civilization Period.
Arbors are skilled at spy missions and may engage in intelligence, reconnaissance, and sabotage in cooperation with Drakes and other Upper Barbarous (see p. 60).

They have a small number of soulscars and are not affected by Swords of Protection, so they may lead Ogres (see p. 83) to infiltrate the city. However, since Arbors themselves do not have the shapeshifting ability, it is relatively easy to detect their disguise. Even if they are discovered, Arbors are not only excellent sworders, but also fearsome Fairy and Nature magic- users with the ability to make people feel the fire of rage.

name: Quepala’ula

skills.name: Magic (2 systems) 6 Level /Magic Power 8 (15)
text: Most of them have Truespeech and Spiritualism Magic at 6th level, but
some of them might instead of one of them have Summoning Arts at 6th
level.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Metamagic/Targets], and
[Multi-Action].

skills.name: Poison/7(14)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Bite attack hits, the target is dealt additional 6 poison magic damage.

description: It is Barbarous with a snake head. From the neck down, it is almost the same as a Human, but the neck and head are those of a thick snake, together about 50 cm long.

Although Quepala’ulas are known to have inherited knowledge from the Magic Civilization Period, their clan can be divided into two main groups. The first are those who prefer dark, damp places and live in tribes. In these settlements, the lower Barbarous, such as Goblin (see p. 73) and Bolg (see p. 75), often serve as slaves and guards.

The others live in “Shallow Abysses”, utilizing their knowledge of Magic Civilization and controlling daemons as their followers. They use the area as a hunting ground, leaving a few zones of seeming safety amidst the thick growth of poison grass and mushrooms, where they enjoy slowly hunting down their “passing prey”.

name: Centaur Impaler

skills.name: Fairy Magic 4 Level/Magic Power 6 (13)
text: It can use Earth, Fire, Wind, and Light types.

skills.name: Charge/7 (14)/Evasion/Neg
text: This ability can only be used in the round in which the Normal Move is
made.
Charges and spears 1 enemy character as with melee attack, dealing
"2d+14" physical damage.

description: Spear cavalry of Centaurs (see p. 74), Impalers are often young and anxious to show off their military training. Despite their youth, Centaur Impalers are the equivalent of knights in their hierarchy and will often have subordinates following their commands. In combat, a Centaur Impaler will often seek out and fight the most potent enemy in the skirmish, looking to prove themselves in battle.

name: Troll

skills.name: Power Strike I
text: They can deal an additional 4 damage on their next attack. However, any
Evasion Check made by them this turn receives a -2 penalty.

skills.name: Weakening
text: As long as a Troll is under sunlight, it receives a -2 penalty to all Accuracy
and Evasion Checks.

description: A Troll's stature is like that of a boulder; standing taller than 3m, its skin is tougher than that of a rock. For Barbarous, Trolls have incredible discipline and take great pride in maintaining their physique. They are also a devout follower of the gods.

Troll blood is said to symbolize power as well, and it is often used as a sort of paint. When applied by a Troll, it will strengthen weapons and armor. Even a Troll's skin can be toughened by its own blood. Trolls are often nocturnal creatures as well and dislike bright lights. Sunlight, in particular, will significantly weaken a Troll, and they abhor going out during the daytime.

name: Merman Bishop

skills.name: Underwater Specialization
text: Can move in water without penalties and restrictions. Conversely, all
action checks are subject to a -2 penalty on the ground.

description: Bishops are one of the strongest Mermen (see p. 79). They follow the gods and lead their tribes as prescribed by their words. Bishops even have the ear of Merman chiefs, giving them considerable political power.

While Merman Bishops tend to follow the Ancient Gods, regardless of whether they're gods of the First Sword, Lumiere, or the Second Sword, Ignis, some follow gods that have recently found apotheosis and are thus unknown among the land-dwelling races.

name: Rumblefist

skills.name: Elastic Skin
text: Against blunt weapons, its Defense is treated as 3 points higher.

skills.name: Quick Spinning Fist/9(16)/Evasion/Neg
text: It attacks by spinning both arms and swinging them widely. Up to 5 targets
of Rumblefist choice will be hit with a melee attack that deals 2d+8 points
of physical damage and causes them to fall prone.
A character whose Evasion check for this ability is only 1 or 2 short of
this ability's Success Value does not take any damage but only falls prone.
This ability cannot be used in consecutive turns.

description: These Barbarous are towering beasts cloaked in the black hide, standing at an imposing 2.5 meters tall. Their fists are rock-hard, mutated into weapons of deadly force. Every inch of their bodies is encased in black, resilient skin, impervious to most impacts.
These creatures are uncivilized and meritocratic, preferring to settle disputes through duels.

name: Drake (Human Form)

skills.name: Mana Strike = +8 damage
text: A Drake can deal an additional 8 damage on their next attack. However,
any Fortitude or Willpower Check made by the Drake this turn receives a
-2 penalty.

skills.name: Flight
text: Receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee attacks.

skills.name: Dragonification
text: The Drake transforms into a draconic form, healing all HP and MP. Any
lingering magical effects are removed as well. For more information, see
the Drake (Dragon Form) stats. In the turn in which [►Dragonification] is
performed, only the Body section of Dragon Form is treated as having
completed the Major Action, and Wings sections can make them on this
turn.
[⏩△Instant Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately
after using [►Dragonification].

description: Drakes are similar in appearance to beautiful young men and women, though horns gracefully sweep from their heads and membranous wings sprout from their backs. Drakes can transform into huge dragons that wield massive swords infused with magic.
Another Barbarous look to Drakes as natural leaders and huge forces have been known to gather at Drake's disposal.
While there is often little cooperation between Drakes, a powerful “king” Drake appears in rare cases, followed by many other Drakes.

name: Drake (Dragon Form)
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Body / Wing x 2) Main Section: Body

skills.name: Breath of Light/8 (15)/Fortitude/Half
text: With “Range/Area: 2 (50m)/Shot”, it spits out a chunk of energy at
“Target: 1 Character”, dealing “2d+10” energy magic damage.
This unique skill cannot be used in consecutive turns.

skills.name: Instant Humanification
text: It instantly transforms into Human form. Refer to Drake (Human Form)
for data on the Human form.
If the Body section has suffered HP or MP damage or has been affected
by magic or other effects, these are carried over to the Human form. If its
HP is less than 0, it immediately falls unconscious.
[⏩△Instant Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately
after using [►Dragonification].

skills.name: Flight
text: All section receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If one of the wings falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be used.

loot.item: Sword Shard (200G/-) x 2 11 Sword Shard (200G/-) x 3
Decayed Magic Sword (4,000G/Gold Black White S)

description: Drake will change into dragon form if in danger. They always carry a magical sword that allows them to transform. While transforming, the Drake takes on a silvery-white sheen of razor-edged scales. Its physique becomes sleek and streamlined, and its wings become as sharp as a sword.
In addition, despite their huge size, they retain high agility and are quick to attack.

name: Ogre
language: Trade Common, Barbaric, Ogre, Drakish, Arcana

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting] and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Personification
text: An Ogre may take on the appearance and mannerisms of a character they
have eaten or change back.
When transformed, the Ogre's maximum HP and MP are decreased by
5. Accuracy, Evasion, Fortitude, and Willpower are also reduced by 1
point each. This form can be held up to 18 hours per day.
The [⏩△Personification] can also be ended with Minor Action or during
Combat Preparation.

description: Much larger than the Lesser species, Ogres wield significantly more physical and magical power. Standing close to 3m tall, they can use larger equipment. Ogres want to act as though they are master tacticians, using Lesser Ogres and other barbarous as fodder for their evil (and often cowardly) operations to attack humanoid races. However, their success rate isn't the greatest, and those who fail often tend to be sent on those same suicide missions by other Ogres.

name: Scissorscorpion
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Upper Body / Pincers / Lower Body) Main Section: Upper Body

skills.name: Gunfire/7 (14)/Evasion/Neg
text: A Scissorscorpion can attack with a readied gun, whose Max. Magazine
is 4, the range is 2(30m), and the Critical Threshold is 10.

skills.name: Targeting
text: Stray shots cannot occur.

skills.name: Poison/8 (15)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Scissorscorpion's Lower Body hits with their Tail attack, the target
will receive an extra 8 poison-type damage.

skills.name: Weakening
text: When the Lower Body section is reduced to 0 HP or fewer, the Upper
Body and Pincers sections of the Scissorscorpion receive a -2 penalty for
Evasion.

loot.item: Poison Stinger with Intact Poison Sac (800G/Red A)
Poison Stinger with Deadly Poison Sac (1,200G/Red S)

description: A warrior branch of the Androscorpions (see p. 78), Scissorscorpions have often seen leading groups in sorties or at the head of a squadron of Androscorpions in emergencies. As the name says, Scissorscorpions have a pair of large pincers that can cut through enemies like scissors through paper.

name: Tannoz

skills.name: Fairy Magic 6 Level/Magic Power 8 (15)
text: It can use earth, water/ice, wind, and dark types.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting] and [Metamagic/Targets].

description: They are ugly Barbarous that live mainly by the seashore and riverside. They are short and have wrinkled faces. Their right hand is a pair of crab- like pincers, and they carry a lantern in their left hand. Lanterns are used for hunting prey, confusing and stranding boats at night, and luring Humanoids into swamps and rivers.
Sometimes they can also be seen inland serving other Barbarous. They are hated by humanoid fairy tamers because they do not make contracts with them but force them to work.

name: Dawn Ripper

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Metamagic/Targets], [Multi-
Action].

skills.name: Mana Strike = +9 damage
text: A Dawn Ripper can deal an additional 9 damage on their next attack.
However, any Fortitude or Willpower Check made by the Dawn Ripper
this turn receives a -2 penalty.

description: This is a Dawn species (see p. 78) that has developed its skills and abilities through its work. Many Humanoids mistake these monsters for Humanoid assassins or vampires, and there were confirmed cases where such rumors were true.

name: Minotaur

skills.name: Cleave I
text: It can attack up to 3 characters with melee attacks that can be reached,
but the damage will be reduced by -3. If more than one is hit, the damage
is determined individually.

skills.name: Power Strike I
text: They can deal an additional 4 damage on their next attack. However, any
Evasion Check made by them this turn receives a -2 penalty.

skills.name: Techniques
text: They may use the [Bear Muscle], [Beetleskin], [Cat's Eyes], [Gazelle
Feet], [Recovery (5 pts.)], Techniques.

description: The creature has the body of a human and the head of a bull, a gigantic monster. It has low intelligence, and it is ferocious, becoming uncontrollable when enraged. It is skilled at finding sword labyrinths and sometimes lives inside them like a guardian. It prefers Humanoid women, tormenting them for several days before devouring them.

name: Lizardman Mariner

skills.name: Coordination
text: A Lizardman Mariner gains a bonus to their Accuracy equal to the
number of other Lizardman Mariners in the same skirmish, up to a
maximum of +4.

skills.name: Rage
text: When another Lizardman (regardless of type) in the same skirmish is
defeated, the Lizardman Mariner gains a cumulative +2 bonus to damage
for 10 seconds (1 round).
The GM decides when a Lizardman is defeated (so it cannot recover).

description: These are members of an elite group of Lizardmen (see p. 76) trained to rush into enemy territory and create openings for other Barbarous from within. In the past, there was concern that these elite Lizardmen could take down cities under united leadership. Today, they are rarely seen.

name: Arakcruder Hunter

skills.name: Flight
text: This monster receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Spear Pursuit
text: A monster’s spear can be used as a melee attack against an opponent who
has been attacked with a beak.
Accuracy check and damage are the same as those of the beak. This effect
is effective only when the monster is Flying.

skills.name: Cleave I
text: This ability can only be used with [◯Spear Pursuit]. It can attack up to 3
characters with melee attacks that can be reached, but the damage will be
reduced by -3. If more than one is hit, the damage is determined
individually.

skills.name: Techniques
text: They may use the [Cat’s Eye], [Bear Muscle], [Gazelle Feet], and
[Beetleskin] Techniques.

description: Among the Arakcruder (see p. 77), they are the ones who are skilled with spears and lead their tribes in hunting and eliminating foreign enemies.

name: Arbor Senior

skills.name: Magic (1 system) 7 Level /Magic Power 10 (17)
text: Arbor Senior can cast either Fairy Magic or Nature Magic at 7th level.
In the case of Fairy Magic, the types used are "Earth" and "Fire".

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Hawk Eye],
[Metamagic/Targets], [Multi-Action].

skills.name: Flame Shield
text: The Arbor Senior creates a wall of fire with his anger. It is placed in front
of up to 5 targets within a 3m radius of the Arbor Senior, and the target
gains +3 Defense for 3 minutes (18 rounds). Also, any character who uses
a melee attack or "Range: Touch" effect against the target during the
duration of this effect will receive 5 fire magic damage after the damage or
effect applied. There is no resistance against this damage, but reducing
magic damage and fire damage are effective.

description: This is the leader of Arbor (see p. 81), an experienced member of the clan. The number of eye-like patterns on their body has been increasing with age, and they look more mischievous.
They lead the younger Arbors and the Ogres (see p. 83) in attacks and sabotage of Humanoid cities and strongholds.
They are skilled defenders and fire fighters, adept at surrounding their targets and ensuring that the job gets done.
They also seem to be able to mate with long-lived Meria, and long-lived Meria have been seen living together with Arbor Seniors in captivity.

name: Quepala’ula’ula

skills.name: Truespeech Magic, Spiritualism Magic 8 Level/Magic Power 10 (17)
Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Metamagic/Targets], and
[Multi-Action].

skills.name: Poison/10(17)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Bite attack hits, the target is dealt additional 8 poison magic damage.

description: This is a Quepala’ula (see p. 81), who is particularly knowledgeable and excels in magical knowledge. They are sometimes the leaders of settlements in the larger Shallow Abysses. They are gruesome and brutal and have a strong hatred for Humanoids and the beings who are in their service.

name: Dark Troll

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Metamagic/Targets], and
[Wordbreak].

skills.name: Mana Strike = +10 damage
text: May deal an additional +10 damage to their next melee attack. At risk,
they take a -2 penalty to their Fortitude and Willpower checks.

skills.name: Dark Regeneration = 5 points
text: At the end of each round, a Dark Troll recovers 5 HP. This has no effect
if the Dark Troll is at 0 HP or lower or is under sunlight.

skills.name: Weakened
text: As long as a Dark Troll is under sunlight, it receives a -2 penalty to all
Accuracy and Evasion Checks.

description: Much leaner than a typical Troll (see p. 82), a Dark Troll has an excellent sense of fighting and a strong religious belief. A high-ranking member of Troll society, they stand out with their jet-black skin and dangerous aura. Dark Trolls violently hate cowardice and will respect those who show their strength, even if they're humanoids who'll get crushed under the Dark Troll's immense power.

name: Loud Bolg Commander

skills.name: Frightful Commander/Can’t
text: Gives the order and forces subordinates to follow it.
All Accuracy and Evasion checks for "Target: All areas (30m Radius)/All"
with "Range: Caster" are increased by +1. User can exclude any character
from the target when used. The character itself is always excluded. This
effect is treated as a psychic type with a success value of 0. This ability can
only be used in Combat Preparation and lasts until it is individually
removed or until this monster is no longer on the battlefield.

skills.name: Repeated Strike II
text: Can make two Accuracy checks; if one hits, the damage is dealt once. If
the first Accuracy check is successful, the damage is increased by +4; if the
second check instead is successful, the damage is determined as usual.

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +6 points.

description: They are the frontline commander of Bolgs (see p. 75), leading their men with fear.

name: Volticfist

skills.name: Elastic Skin
text: Against blunt weapons, its Defense is treated as 3 points higher.

skills.name: Charged Fist
text: Fists fill lightning, increasing its striking power.
If Volticfist is the target of a lightning-type effect, their fists become hard
and treated as magic weapons (they still deal physical damage), increasing
physical damage by +2 points over 3 minutes (18 rounds). This effect is
cumulative up to 3 times (+6 total).

skills.name: Thunder Scream/10(17)/Fortitude/Neg
text: Volticfist shouts to the heavens and drop bolts of lightning around
themselves.
Up to 2 random creatures (including itself) in the melee area where it is
located are hit by this effect and are dealt "2d+8" lightning magic damage.
This effect can be used while in melee, and it costs 6 MP.

description: Among the Rumblefists (see p. 82), there are individuals who have undergone a special ritual that allows them to control lightning. These individuals have a black horn on the top of their heads, which they can use to summon lightning. This ability is only demonstrated in the heat of battle. By channeling the lightning through their bodies, they are able to attack with lightning-charged fists.

name: Werewolf

skills.name: Beast Power
text: Werewolf receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion on the night of a
full moon.
Conversely, they receive a -1 penalty for Accuracy and Evasion while
under sunlight.

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: A Werewolf can make two Claw attacks each round, though each attack
requires its Accuracy check. They may choose to attack different characters
with each attack.

skills.name: Techniques
text: They may use the [Beetleskin] and [Strong Blood] Techniques.

skills.name: Beastification
text: A Werewolf can turn from a humanoid to a bestial form and back again.
The Werewolf can only make Claw attacks while in beast form.
The [⏩△Beastification] can be released with Minor Action or during
Combat Preparation.

description: One of many different shapeshifters that fall under the classification “Lycanthrope,” a Werewolf is the most common of the beastmen.

When in their humanoid form, they would easily pass among civilized folk without issue. However, they can turn into a bestial form, growing fur over their body, their face turning to that of a wolf, and sharp claws growing from both hands. They form their own clans, with strict hierarchies based on age, so the young Werewolves help the elders when necessary.

They cannot reproduce independently but rather kidnap Humans to join them through a special ritual. Therefore, their soulscar is relatively small, and they sometimes blend in with human society, taking advantage of their beastification ability. In addition to wolves, there are many other species of Lycanthrope, such as tigers and bears.

name: Basilisk (Human Form)
language: Trade Common, Barbaric, Basilisk, Drakish, Youma, Arcana

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Universal Metamagic],
and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Petrifying Gaze/9 (16)/Willpower/Neg
text: With "Range/Area: 50m/Target", it stares at the enemy and gives the effect
of Petrifaction (dexterity or agility/-6) (see p. 71).
If the target of this unique skill is the one who holds a mirror, and if
Willpower's success value is 4 or more points higher than the Target
Number, gaze can bounce off them, giving this effect to Basilisk always
affecting them without a check even if Basilisk is blindfolded. This unique
skill is of curse type.
This unique skill can be used only once per round.

skills.name: Poison Blood/11 (18)/Fortitude/Neg
text: Anyone who deals damage to this monster in the same skirmish will
receive 2d poison magic damage at the end of their turn.

skills.name: Monstrous Form
text: The monster transforms into its monstrous form. For data on the
monstrous form, see "Basilisk (Monstrous Form)". HP and MP are
restored to their maximum values, and all effects of spells and the like are
removed. When [►Monstrous Form] was activated Body section is treated
as if it made Major Action. The Head section may take Major Action on
this turn. Also, Evil Eye can use [⏩Petrifying Gaze] if it has not already
used it for its turn.
[⏩△Instant Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately after
using [►Monstrous Form].

description: Indistinguishable from humans at first glance, a Basilisk is Barbarous with the power of petrification. Basilisks often wear blindfolds to suppress their petrifying gaze until they find the right target.
Even then, the petrifying gaze can be used through the blindfold, and petrified animal remains can often be found around a Basilisk den.
Often found in deserts, they collect various lesser Barbarous as followers and enslaved people, though they have a rivalry with Drakes regarding who is stronger.
Petrified animal fragments and other debris are often found near the Basilisk's birthplace.

name: Basilisk (Monstrous Form)
language: Trade Common, Barbaric, Basilisk, Drakish, Youma, Arcana
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Evil Eye / Head / Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Poison Blood/12 (19)/Fortitude/Neg
text: It is the same as the unique skill of Basilisk (Human Form), except for a
different target number.

skills.name: Petrifying Gaze/10 (17)/Willpower/Neg
text: It is the same as the unique skill of Basilisk (Human Form), except for a
different target number.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Universal Metamagic],
and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Instant Humanification
text: It instantly transforms into Human form. Refer to Basilisk (Human
Form) for data on the Human form. If the Body section has suffered HP
or MP damage or has been affected by magic or other effects, these are
carried over to the Human form. If its HP is less than 0, it immediately
falls unconscious.
[⏩△Instant Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately after
using [►Monstrous Form].

skills.name: Weakening
text: When the Body section is reduced to 0 HP or fewer, the Evil Eye and
Head sections of the Basilisk (Monstrous Form) receive a -2 penalty for
Evasion.

description: The true identity of a Basilisk, this eight-legged beast, looks like a lizard 5m long. While the Basilisk's intelligence and speed are a little lower, the ability to petrify foes has increased, making the Basilisk even more dangerous. However, most Basilisks feel that this form is quite ugly and hate being seen by others in this form. As such, they will almost certainly try to kill or petrify those who see this hideous form.

name: Ogre Wizard
language: Trade Common, Barbaric , Ogre, Drakish, Arcana

skills.name: Truespeech Magic, Spiritualism Magic 8 Level/Magic Power 11(18)
Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Personification
text: An Ogre Wizard may take on the appearance and mannerisms of a
character they have eaten or change back.
When transformed, the Ogre Wizard's maximum HP and MP are
decreased by 5. Accuracy, Evasion, Fortitude, and Willpower are also
reduced by 1 point each. This form can be held up to 18 hours per day.
The [⏩△Personification] can also be ended with Minor Action or during
Combat Preparation.

description: This is a high-ranking Ogre (see p. 83) with excellent magical abilities. They are capable of casting Truespeech Magic and Spiritualism Magic and often blend in with humanoids to carry out their evil deeds.

Ogre Wizards are considered elite among Ogres and sometimes command infiltration teams of Lesser Ogres (see p. 77). They use Lesser Ogres to secretly neutralize the Swords of Protection and enter humanoid cities. Ogre Wizards are known to gradually replace the inhabitants of a city with Ogres under their control and then one day reveal their true nature and ravage the city. When an Ogre Wizard is discovered in a town, it is often too late to stop them.

name: Grendel
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Upper Body / Lower Body) Main Section: Upper Body

skills.name: Water Blast/12(19)/Fortitude/Neg
text: It slams the water's surface as hard as possible, generating waves.
Within "Range: Caster" and "Target: 1 area (4m Radius)/10," the target
falls prone. This effect does not apply to characters not restricted while in
the water by abilities such as [◯Underwater Aptitude], [◯Underwater
Specialization], [◯Underwater], or [Sword's Grace/Gentle Water].
This unique skill can only be used on or underwater.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Grendel's height prevents enemies from attacking them. The Upper
Body receives a +4 bonus to Evasion checks against melee attacks.
This effect disappears when the Lower Body falls to 0 HP or lower.

description: They are giants of about 4 meters in length that inhabit seashores, reefs, lakes, etc. They are sometimes found together with Tannoz.
They are especially dangerous underwater.

name: Tannoz Cleric

skills.name: Divine Magic 9 Level & Fairy Magic 9 Level/Magic Power 11(18)
text: It can use earth, water/ice, wind, and dark types.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], and [Metamagic/Targets].

description: They are the leader of the Tannoz (see p. 84), who use Divine Magic in addition to Fairy Magic. Tannoz generally follow Sea Snatcher Eiryak, whose teachings Tannoz Clerics preach to their companions. Clerics prefer to summon fairies and support allies with Divine Magic.

name: Hugl Motor

skills.name: Mobile Flying
text: It gains a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion checks for melee attacks for
10 seconds (1 round).
This ability cannot be used in consecutive turns. When used in Combat
Preparation, it cannot be used in the first round, regardless of the result of
the Initiative check.

skills.name: Winged Pursuit
text: If it is hit with a Claw attack, it can make an additional melee attack with
wings.
Accuracy bonus, damage, and other values are the same as for the claw
attack. This ability cannot be used on the same turn in which [⏩△Mobile
Flying] is used. Also, once an additional attack is made with this ability,
[⏩△Mobile Flying] cannot be used on that turn.

skills.name: Techniques
text: They may use the [Cat's Eyes], [Bear Muscle], [Daemonfinger], and
[Giant Arms], Techniques.

description: This is a skilled warrior of the Hugl (see p. 74) tribe who knows how to use Techniques.

name: Minotaur Caster
language: Barbaric, Minotaur, languages by magic system learned

skills.name: Magic (2 Systems) 8 Level / Magic Power 11(18)
text: Can use any two of Truespeech Magic, Spiritualism Magic, Divine Magic,
and Fairy Magic at 8 levels. Fairy Magic has earth, water/ice, fire, and dark
types.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: A Minotaur Caster can use the Combat Feats [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], and [Targeting].

skills.name: Cleave I
text: It can attack up to 3 characters with melee attacks that can be reached,
but the damage will be reduced by -3. If more than one is hit, the damage
is determined individually.

description: A much smarter variety of Minotaur (see p. 85), these masters of magic are ferociously cunning. Willing to lie in wait in their labyrinth, a Minotaur Caster will use a variety of traps, spells, and other monsters to wear down any intruders before joining the fray themselves.

name: Drake Baron (Human Form)

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Magic
Convergence], [Metamagic/Targets], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Techniques
text: They may use the [Beetleskin], [Cat's Eyes], and [Recovery (5 pts.)]
Techniques.

skills.name: Mana Strike = +10 damage
text: May deal an additional +10 damage to their next melee attack. At risk,
they take a -2 penalty to their Fortitude and Willpower checks.

skills.name: Flight
text: Receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee attacks.

skills.name: Dragonification
text: The Drake transforms into a draconic form, healing all HP and MP. Any
lingering magical effects are removed as well. For more information, see
the Drake Baron (Dragon Form) stats. In the turn in which
[►Dragonification] is performed, only the Body section of Dragon Form
is treated as having completed the Major Action, and Wings sections can
make them on this turn.
[⏩△Instant Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately after
using [►Dragonification].

description: Similar in appearance to the Drakes (see p. 83), yet with a much more regal presence, Drake Barons are imposing leaders of the Barbarous. The only difference is that they are more beautiful and more refined and are dressed in luxurious costumes. The dragon form is one size larger than the normal Drake, and its crest is shining in copper color.
While it's rumored there are little more than 100 of these Drake Barons throughout the entirety of Raxia, even those few are enough to bring much of humanity to its knees.

name: Drake Baron (Dragon Form)
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Body/Wing x 2) Main Section: Body

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Magic
Convergence], [Metamagic/Targets], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Breath of Light/11 (18)/Fortitude/Half
text: The Drake Baron may vomit a mass of pure energy directed toward a
single target. The energy travels to “Range/Area: 2(50m)/Shot” and deals
2d + 16 energy magic damage.
This unique skill cannot be used in consecutive turns.

skills.name: Techniques
text: They may use the [Beetleskin], [Cat's Eyes], and [Recovery (5 pts.)]
Techniques.

skills.name: Instant Humanification
text: It instantly transforms into Human form. Refer to Drake Baron (Human
Form) for data on the Human form. If the Body section has suffered HP
or MP damage or has been affected by magic or other effects, these are
carried over to the Human form. If its HP is less than 0, it is immediately
stunned.
[⏩△Instant Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately after
using [►Dragonification].

skills.name: Flight
text: Receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee attacks.
If one of the wings falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be used.

name: Arakcruder Predator

skills.name: Flight
text: This monster receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Spear Pursuit
text: A monster’s spear can be used as a melee attack against an opponent who
has been attacked with a beak.
Accuracy check and damage are the same as those of the beak. This effect
is effective only when the monster is Flying.

skills.name: Cleave II
text: This ability can only be used with [◯Spear Pursuit]. It attacks with a
weapon up to 5 characters within the skirmish in which it resides.

skills.name: Techniques
text: They may use the [Cat’s Eye], [Bear Muscle], [Gazelle Feet], [Recovery
(5 pts.)], and [Beetleskin] Techniques.

skills.name: Rage
text: This effect appears automatically when this monster's current HP
becomes less than half its maximum value (rounding up) and disappears
automatically when its HP recovers to more than half its maximum value.
The monster becomes frenzied and attacks indiscriminately and without
regard for the consequences. In all melee attacks, the target is randomly
selected from among possible targets, friend or foe. When declaring
[🗨Cleave II], select 5 targets at random (or all of them if there are fewer
than 5 suitable targets).
All melee attacks gain a +2 bonus to Accuracy checks and +4 points to
damage. At the same time, the monster receives a -2 penalty on Evasion
checks.
While this effect is in effect, this monster cannot use the [Recovery]
Technique.

description: It is a very powerful Arakcruder (see p. 77). They justify their violent nature by defining justice as simply being strong. When cornered, they go berserk and begin to rampage without restraint.

name: Arbor Elder

skills.name: Magic (1 system) 10 Level /Magic Power 13 (20)
text: Arbor Senior can cast either Fairy Magic or Nature Magic at the 10th
level. In the case of Fairy Magic, the types used are "Earth" and "Fire".

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Hawk Eye], [Metamagic/Targets], [Multi-Action].

skills.name: Roaring Fire Armor
text: Arbor cloaks in its rage themself and its surroundings in a suit of flaming
armor. Up to 10 targets in 1 area (3m radius) around the Arbor Elder treat
their weapons as fire-type magic weapons (that still deal physical damage)
and gain +2 points of damage for 10 seconds (1 round). At the same time,
the target's Defense is reduced by 12 points.
This effect can be used only once per round, and it costs 10 MP.

description: This is the chief of the village of Arbors (see p. 81). At first glance, there is no difference from the young Arbor. However, their eye-like patterns have increased, and their skin shows bark-like cracks.
They are even more adept at magic, and their ability to control fire is also formidable.

In large Arbor villages, several elders may rule in the council. These settlements are very powerful and dangerous. The elders may serve as counselors to Drakes and other Upper Barbarous and are skilled at intelligence work.

name: Dark Troll Adept

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Magic
Convergence], [Magic Control], [Hawk Eye], [Universal Metamagic], and
[Wordbreak].

skills.name: Mana Strike = +13 damage
text: May deal an additional +13 damage to their next melee attack. At risk,
they take a -2 penalty to their Fortitude and Willpower checks.

skills.name: Dark Regeneration = 7 points
text: At the end of each round, a Dark Troll Adept recovers 7 HP. This has
no effect if the Dark Troll Adept is at 0 HP or lower or is under sunlight.

skills.name: Weakened
text: As long as a Dark Troll is under sunlight, it receives a -2 penalty to all
Accuracy and Evasion Checks.

description: This is a Troll priest (see p. 82) who is not only a skilled priest but also a capable warrior among the Dark Trolls (see p. 86).

Interestingly, Trolls are sworn to serve the gods rather than to fight themselves. They serve as judges of the divine battles within the Troll clan and preside over rituals. They can also serve as advisors and bless Troll officers, providing spell support to allies when confronted with powerful enemies.

name: Hill Giant
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Upper Body/Lower Body) Main Section: Upper Body

skills.name: War Cry/12 (19)/Willpower/Neg
text: The Hill Giant unleashes a mighty yell, causing fear in those who fail to
resist within a 10-meter radius around Hill Giant. This fear, treated as a
psychic effect, gives a -2 penalty to all Skill Checks for the next 30 seconds
(3 rounds).

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Hill Giant’s height prevents enemies from attacking it. The Upper Body
receives a +4 bonus to Evasion checks against melee attacks.
This effect disappears when the Lower Body falls to 0 HP or lower.

description: Standing around 5m tall, the Hill Giant is the smallest of the Giants (see p. 62). Not too bright either, a Hill Giant will chase down prey and attempt to eat just about anything once. While other barbarous do use the services of Hill Giants because of their immense power and strength, it's also fairly easy to exploit the poor giants, and more than a few end up as butts of jokes.

name: Bolg Assassinator

skills.name: Fast Action
text: During the first round of combat, if the monster wins initiative, it may
take two Major Actions that round.

skills.name: Shadow Sneak
text: Can leave, pass through skirmishes without movement blocking, or taking
Prepare to Withdraw action.

skills.name: Double Attack
text: It can attack the same target twice in one action with its Weapon.

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +6 points.

description: This is a Bolg (see p. 75) assassin who specializes in fast attacks. Their role is to target and strike the key commanders of the enemy army.

name: Diablo Lieutenant (Human Form)

skills.name: Tough Skin
text: Whenever it receives physical or magical damage of the bludgeoning
type, it is reduced by -3 points.

skills.name: Flight
text: Receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee attacks.

skills.name: Limited 2 Actions
text: The monster can perform two Major Actions in one round. However,
this is limited to one weapon melee attack and one [►Daemonic Eyes II]
once each.
It cannot use [🗨Cleave II] for that melee attack.

skills.name: Cleave II
text: It attacks with a weapon up to 5 characters within the skirmish in which it
resides.

skills.name: Daemonic Eyes II/Can’t
text: With a sharp look in its eyes, it makes enemies shrivel.
With “Range/Area: 1 (10m)/Target”, select any number of targets and
deal each of them 3 curse fixed damage.
Afterward, Diablo’s HP is restored by the sum of all applied damage dealt
to the targets.
Using this ability consumes 3 points of MP per character targeted.

skills.name: Instant Daemonshift
text: The character changes into the daemon form with Minor Actions or
during Combat Preparation. For the data, see Diablo Lieutenant (Daemon
Form). HP and MP are restored to their maximum values, and all effects
of magic, etc., are negated. In the turn in which this unique skill is
performed, only the Body section of the Daemon Form is treated as having
completed the Major Action, and the Head section can make it this turn.
[⏩△Instant Daemonshift] cannot be used for 3 hours immediately after
the [►Humanification] was used. Also, [►Humanification] cannot be
used for 1 hour immediately after [⏩△Instant Daemonshift] was used.

description: This is a more experienced and mighty Diablo (see p. 60). While Diablos are elite Barbarous who are expected to lead the Barbarous, these lieutenants are often assistants or rangers rather than corps commanders.
They will appear as servants of the more powerful Diablos if the former. If the latter, they will often lead a small number of powerful Barbarous to raid Humanoid settlements.
Their human and Daemon forms are not comparable to that of Cadets. In particular, the Daemon form is covered with poisonous gas so foul that it can even hurt the lieutenant themself.

name: Diablo Lieutenant (Daemon Form)
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Head / Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Tough Skin
text: Whenever it receives physical or magical damage of the bludgeoning
type, it is reduced by -3 points.

skills.name: Limited 2 Actions
text: The monster can perform two Major Actions in one round. However,
the monster must choose two different actions from the melee attack,
[►Daemonic Eyes II] or [►Spray of Evil].

skills.name: Daemonic Eyes II/Can’t
text: With a sharp look in its eyes, it makes enemies shrivel.
With “Range/Area: 1 (10m)/Target”, select any number of targets and
deal each of them 3 curse fixed damage.
Afterward, Diablo’s HP is restored by the sum of all applied damage dealt
to the targets.
Using this ability consumes 3 points of MP per character targeted.

skills.name: Evil Spray/14(21)/Willpower/Half
text: With “Range: Self" and "Target: 2-3 areas (10m Radius)", it releases a
cursed spray and deals 2d+11 curse magic damage to the target.
This effect can exclude any character from the target except itself. It never
removes itself, but the resistance is always treated as a success.

skills.name: Flight
text: Receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee attacks.
If the Body section falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be
used.

skills.name: Cleave II
text: It attacks with a weapon up to 5 characters within the skirmish in which it
resides.

skills.name: Humanification
text: It changes to the Human form. For data on the Human form, refer to
Diablo Lieutenant (Human Form). If the Body section has suffered HP or
MP damage or has been affected by magic or other effects, these are
carried over to the Human form. If its HP is less than 0, it immediately
falls unconscious.
[►Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately after
[⏩△Instant Daemonshift] was used. Also, [⏩△Instant Daemonshift]
cannot be used for 3 hours immediately after the [►Humanification] was
used.

name: Ogre Berserker

skills.name: Continuous Attack II
text: If an Ogre Berserker successfully hits a target in melee, they may make a
second attack. They can make a third attack against the same target if a
second attack hits.

skills.name: Power Strike II
text: An Ogre Berserker can deal an additional +12 damage on their next
attack. However, any Evasion Check made by the Ogre Berserker this turn
receives a -2 penalty.
This declaration should have been made at the time of the first attack. It
cannot be made during an additional attack from the [◯Continuous
Attack II].

description: Although they have no shapeshift ability and cannot cast spells, they are a subspecies of Ogres (see p. 83), boasting a strong body twice the size of a normal Ogre and formidable strength. Because of their low intellect, they are used by Ogres and Drakes, but as long as they can fight, Ogre Berserkers are happy.

name: Tannoz Veteran

skills.name: Fairy Magic 10 Level/Magic Power 12(19)
text: It can use earth, water/ice, wind, and dark types.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Magic
Convergence], [Magic Control], [Hawk Eye], and [Metamagic/Targets].

description: This is a mature and experienced Tannoz (see p. 84) fighter. They are skilled at fighting in the water, and their sharp pincers are sharp enough to easily pierce even the hardest armor.

name: Murcielago

skills.name: Flight
text: A Murcielago receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for
melee attacks.

skills.name: Swords of Protection Resistance
text: If the Murcielago is within the influence of Swords of Protection, the
Murcielago’s soulscars are treated as 2 points lower than it originally was.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Universal Metamagic], [Multi-Action], and [Rune
Master].

skills.name: Bonds of Love and Blood/14(21)/Willpower/Neg
text: Murcielago extract the blood of the character they have chosen to fight
for life, and offer their own bodily fluids to strengthen the bond between
them.
This ability can be used once a week during combat, and each time it is
used, Bonds of Love and Blood points will accumulate by one point. As
the points accumulate, the target will start to develop feelings for this
monster, eventually loving it like a partner and protecting it as such. The
target's love for the Murcielago will become stronger each time it receives
this ability (up to a maximum of 7 points).
Guidelines for the Number of Times Bonds of Love and Blood has been
Received and its Effects
Number
Effect Guideline
of Times
Respect and assist the wishes of this monster as much as
possible without affecting one's own life, property, position,
etc. If the monster becomes an enemy in battle, it will sabotage
combat activities as much as possible.
The desires of this monster should be given priority in all
aspects of life. The preservation of property, position, and
4 – 5 name is secondary. When the monster is an enemy in battle,
it does not take any active action at first but betrays its allies
the moment it is injured (meaning its HP is reduced).
This monster is considered a lover equal to one's own life. If
requested, one will offer all their life except their own without
thinking twice. If they are allies in a battle, they will betray their
allies without hesitation and join forces with this monster.
They come to think of this monster as everything that is life to
7 them. If they are told to die, they will kill themself without
hesitation.
This effect is permanent and can be used only once per week; even if the
resistance succeeds, the accumulated Bonds of Love and Blood points are
kept. Also, the target gets a bonus to all action checks equal to half of the
Bonds of Love and Blood points (rounded up) when the target is acting in
accordance with the monster's will (as determined by the GM).
This effect is curse type. Murcielago can have only one target under this
effect at the same time. If this effect is used once for a character and then
used on another character by the same monster, the character's Bonds of
Love and Blood points will immediately return to 0, and all effects will be
lost.

skills.name: Bat Shapeshifting
text: Murcielago changes its own appearance into a bat about 20 cm in length.
Or, it returns to its original form from the state of being a bat.
When in the form of a bat, the physical abilities of the bat will be
equivalent to its appearance (enough to fly as a bat), and all unique skills
will be ineffective. Also, the bat form is not treated as a character and is not
a target of any effect. If the character is changed during a battle, it can leave
the battlefield.
This ability can be used only once per hour, and unless this ability is used,
the shape never changes.

loot.item: The Lustrous Blood of Murcielago (2,000G/Red S)

description: Murcielago are serving the high Nosferatu (see p. 60), Barbarous, which look no different from a Humanoid.

In addition to their high fighting ability, they have the ability to shapeshift into bats. They are also resistant to Swords of Protection, and their abilities and appearance allow them to carry out important missions such as infiltrating Humanoid cities.
They are considered dangerous because they often treat those they have bonded with as "lovers" and use them as stepping stones to infiltrate or plot against them by forcing them to do as they wish.

name: Lesser Vampire
language: Trade Common, Barbaric, Nosferatu, Regional Dialect, Arcana

skills.name: Truespeech Magic, Spiritualism Magic 8 Level/Magic Power 11(18)
Gaze/13 (20)/Willpower/Neg
text: Lesser Vampire may attempt to paralyze with “Range/Area: 50m/Target”.
If the target fails to resist the Gaze, they are paralyzed for 10 seconds (1
round), cannot take any Minor Actions, or use active combat feats. If the
target's resistance roll is 16 or less, the target is instead charmed by the
Lesser Vampire and will move to aid and defend it for the next minute (6
rounds). This effect is treated as a psychic type.
This ability can be used only once per round.

skills.name: Vampire Bite/13 (20)/Evasion/Neg
text: The Lesser Vampire bites the target, dealing 2d+10 physical damage. The
Lesser Vampire heals HP equal to the applied dealt.
If the target is reduced to 0 HP or lower from this attack, they receive a -
10 penalty to their next Death Check. If the character fails this Death
Check, they receive an extra 5 soulscars and rise as a Blood Sucker.
Lesser Vampires lose 6 HP and MP per day (cumulative) that they do
not drain blood via [►Vampire Bite] and also cannot use their
[◯Regeneration] unique skill. These penalties immediately disappear
once the Lesser Vampire successfully drains blood via [►Vampire Bite].

skills.name: Regeneration = 7 points
text: At the end of each round, a Lesser Vampire recovers 7 HP. This does
not affect the Lesser Vampire at 0 HP or lower.

skills.name: Vampire Body
text: As long as a Lesser Vampire is under sunlight, it takes 7 magic damage at
the end of its turn and receives a -2 penalty to all Accuracy and Evasion
Checks. This damage cannot be reduced in any way. Additionally, the
Lesser Vampire cannot use their [◯Regeneration] or [◯Normal
Weapon Immunity] abilities.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Lesser Vampire receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for
melee attacks.

description: Immortalized by a Blood Kiss from an older Nosferatu (see p. 60), these Lesser Vampires are incredibly powerful, even among the Barbarous. Often, followers of Zeides were once humans that have fallen into the good graces of other vampires and left their humanity behind. Despite this, they are often stunning, and even their gaze can paralyze and fascinate lesser creatures.

Lesser Vampires must still drink blood daily to keep themselves at peak performance. The actual source of the blood can be any living being, but often, they will prey upon beautiful members of the opposite gender. Occasionally, they will even starve themselves to fit into society and get closer to their desired target, making the drinking all sweeter. Care has to be taken, however, as it is effortless to drain a target entirely and raise them as a subordinate Blood Sucker, and often a Lesser Vampire has a small retinue of followers.

Despite their powers, sunlight is the bane of the Lesser Vampire, reducing them to ash in a small amount of time. After only a few minutes outside during the day, all that will be left of the Lesser Vampire is a pile of ashes and possibly some clothing. Because of this, Lesser Vampires will be reluctant to move out of their roost during daylight hours.

name: Garuda
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Head / Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Continuous Attack II
text: If a Garuda successfully hits a target in melee, they may make a second
attack. They can make a third attack against the same target if the second
attack hits.

skills.name: Techniques
text: A Garuda can use the [Cat's Eyes], [Bear Muscle], and [Beetleskin]
Techniques.

skills.name: Turbulent Winds/15 (22)/Fortitude/Half
text: It creates turbulence in a 6m/20 radius around itself, dealing 2d +12 wind
magic damage to the targets and causing them to fall prone.
This unique skill can be used only once per turn, at the end of each turn.

skills.name: Wind-Edge Blade/15 (22)/Fortitude/Half
text: With "Range/Area: 2(30m)/Target", Garuda uses a blade made of feathers
to attack with, dealing 2d+15 slashing magic damage.

skills.name: Flight II
text: All sections receive a +2 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks. This unique skill is lost if the Body section is reduced to 0 or less
HP.

description: A 3m tall barbarous with a bird-like head and large wings on their back, Garudas are masters of the winds.

In fact, they are known as “Sky Kings” among the lower ranks of the Barbarous, and with good reason. They despise any others flying in what they consider their airspace and will often go out alone to drive out or kill the interlopers.

name: Quepala’marga’ula

skills.name: Truespeech Magic, Spiritualism Magic 12 Level/Magic Power 15(22)
Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control] [Metamagic/Targets], [Rune Master], and [Multi-Action].

skills.name: Poison/15(22)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Bite attack hits, the target is dealt additional 12 poison magic
damage.

description: This is a highest-ranking Quepala’ula (see p. 81). Although they are regarded as quite powerful among the Barbarous, they do not take their place as generals in the Barbarous army, preferring to hide in the dark and plotting. There are some Quepala’marga’ulas who prefer to dwell in Shallow Abyss.

name: Succubus

skills.name: Flight
text: A Succubus receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
