attacks.

skills.name: Magic (2 systems) 12 Level/Magic Power 16(23)
text: Succubus has mastered any two of Spiritualism Magic, Divine Magic, and
Summoning Arts at the 12th level.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Metamagic/Targets], [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Indecent Dreams / 16 (23) / Willpower / Neg
text: Within “Range: Caster” and "Target: All Areas (20m radius)/All" are put
to sleep, and show a lewd dream. Deals 2d points of curse damage to
target's HP or MP, immediately followed by sleep. The Succubus must
choose whether to target HP or MP for each use of [►Indecent Dreams]
and will regain HP or MP equal to the damage dealt.
This effect is both psychic + curse type. However, sleep brought by this
effect is treated as psychic (weak) type.

description: Barbarous, with a beautiful female form and bat-like wings, is commonly known as a “monster appearing in dreams”. She appears at night to the sleeping opposite sex and sucks their life force by giving them lewd dreams. The victim eventually weakens and dies. Females are called Succubus, and males are called Incubus.
They are often seen in the service of the Immortal Queen Zeides or the Mad God Laris.

name: Ogre Warlord
language: Trade Common, Barbaric, Ogre, Drakish, Arcana

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Magic
Convergence], [Magic Control], [Metamagic/Targets], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Mana Strike = +14 damage
text: An Ogre Warlord may deal an additional +14 damage to their next melee
attack. If they do, at risk, they receive a -2 penalty to Fortitude and
Willpower checks until their next turn.

loot.item: Royal Treasured Sword (8,000G/Gold Black White S)

description: Although they lack the shapeshift ability, Ogre Warlords are a superior species of Ogres (see p. 83), possessing physical and magical powers far superior to those of ordinary Ogres. Though not much different in appearance from an ordinary Ogre, they are sometimes adorned with crowns and necklaces and carry specially forged swords that prove their kingship.

name: Blood Troll

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: A Blood Troll can use the Combat Feats [Metamagic/Targets], [Multi-
Action], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Mana Strike = +17 damage
text: A Blood Troll may deal an additional +17 damage to their next melee
attack. If they do, at risk, they receive a -2 penalty to Fortitude and
Willpower checks until their next turn.

skills.name: Dark Regeneration = 10 points
text: At the end of each round, a Blood Troll recovers 10 HP. This has no
effect if the Blood Troll is at 0 HP or lower or is under sunlight.

skills.name: Weakened
text: As long as a Blood Troll is under sunlight, it receives a -2 penalty to all
Accuracy and Evasion Checks.

description: They are upper-level Dark Trolls and are in charge of leading the Trolls (see p. 82). They are always ready to fight without compromise to not disappoint their enemies.
Fighting is the highest priority in their life, and they teach other Trolls how to fight and defeat any opponent.

name: Onyx Basilisk (Human Form)
language: Trade Common, Barbaric, Basilisk, Drakish, Youma, Arcana

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Universal Metamagic],
and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Onyx Gaze/15(22)/Willpower/Neg
text: With "Range/Area: 2(50m)/Target", it stares at "Target: 1 Character" and
petrifies the target (Dexterity, Agility/-6) (see CR II, p. 329). Under this
effect, the target eventually turns into an onyx statue instead of a stone
statue. It is possible to cancel the effect with [Cure Stone].
If the target of this unique skill is the one who holds a mirror, and if
Willpower's success value is 4 or more points higher than the Target
Number, gaze can bounce off them, giving this effect to Onyx Basilisk
always affecting them without a check even if Onyx Basilisk is blindfolded.
This unique skill is of curse type.
This unique skill can be used only once per round.

skills.name: Stagnation Gaze/14(21)/Willpower/Neg
text: With "Range/Area: 2(30m)/Target", the monster stares at "Target: 1
Character" and prevents its movement. Target cannot take any Major
Action and any Minor Action for 10 seconds (1 round). However, if the
target can take multiple Major Actions, the number of Major Actions is
reduced by only one (still no Minor Action can be taken).

skills.name: Poison Blood/16 (23)/Fortitude/Neg
text: Anyone who deals damage to this monster in the same skirmish will
receive 2d+6 poison magic damage at the end of their turn.

skills.name: Monstrous Form
text: The monster transforms into its monstrous form. For data on the
monstrous form, see "Onyx Basilisk (Monstrous Form)". HP and MP are
restored to their maximum values, and all effects of spells and the like are
removed. When [►Monstrous Form] was activated Body section is treated
as if it made Major Action. The Head and Evil Eyes sections may take
Major Action on this turn.
[⏩△Instant Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately after
using [►Monstrous Form].

description: Onyx Basilisk is a higher-level of Basilisk (see p. 88) with an evil onyx eye. The petrification curse this Basilisk gives turns the victim into a black agate (onyx).
This monster also has the evil eye of stagnation as its second evil eye.

The transformed Onyx Basilisk is a large lizard over 5 meters in length, and its right and left evil eyes to shine in milky white and black. Unlike the rational Human form, Onyx Basilisk in this form moves with its emotions and lays waste to the beings in front of it.

name: Onyx Basilisk (Monst. Form)
language: Trade Common, Barbaric, Basilisk, Drakish, Youma, Arcana
sectionsNote: Sections: 4 (Right Evil Eye / Left Evil Eye / Head / Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Poison Blood/17 (24)/Fortitude/Neg
text: It is the same as the unique skill of Onyx Basilisk (Human Form), except
for a different target number.

skills.name: Onyx Gaze/16(23)/Willpower/Neg
text: It is the same as the unique skill of Onyx Basilisk (Human Form), except
for a different target number.

skills.name: Stagnation Gaze/15(22)/Willpower/Neg
text: It is the same as the unique skill of Onyx Basilisk (Human Form), except
for a different target number.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Universal Metamagic],
and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Standing Upright
text: If the HP of the Body is 0 or less, all other sections get a -2 penalty on
Evasion checks.

skills.name: Instant Humanification
text: It instantly transforms into Human form. Refer to Onyx Basilisk (Human
Form) for data on the Human form. If the Body section has suffered HP
or MP damage or has been affected by magic or other effects, these are
carried over to the Human form. If its HP is less than 0, it immediately
falls unconscious.
[⏩△Instant Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately after
using [►Monstrous Form].

name: Bolg Suppressor

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: Can make two Fist attacks each round, though each attack requires its
own Accuracy check. They may choose to attack different characters with
each attack.

skills.name: Counter
text: This is the same effect as the combat feat [Counter].

skills.name: Crushing Palm Strike (Fall)/17(24)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the target is hit by a Fist attack, the target will fall prone on failed
Fortitude check.

skills.name: Crushing Palm Strike (Withering)/17(24)/Willpower/Neg
text: If the target is hit by a Fist attack and fails the Willpower check, the target
may not speak or declare any Minor Action or active combat feats for the
next 10 seconds (1 round). This effect is of the psychic type.

skills.name: Pressure Point/17(24)/Willpower/Neg
text: Roll 1d. Bolg Suppressor hits the target with its powerful aura, receiving
10 fixed damage to its MP if it rolls "1-3" and to its HP if it rolls "4-6".
This effect can be used only once in 10 seconds (1 round) and consumes
10 points of its own MP when used.

description: It is a Bolg (see p. 75) fighter who has trained their body to the utmost limit and is filled with a strong presence beyond ordinary people's reach. Although they are hand-to-hand fighters, it is said that they can do more than an ordinary army just alone, and they are trusted by the upper barbarous as a trump card in local battles.
Blog Suppressors specialize in striking enemies with the bottom of their palms, knocking them down in the process. They then look down fiercely at their fallen opponent, defeating their spirit.

name: Hecatoncheires
sectionsNote: Sections: 8 (Upper Body / Arm x 6 / Lower Body) Main Section: Upper Body

skills.name: Swords Dance/Can't
text: The Hecatoncheires does a strange, flailing dance that deals “2d x
(Remaining Arms) + 5 Physical damage” to one target in the same skirmish.
This ability cannot be used when even one Arm has completed its Major
Action. Also, after this ability is used, Major Actions of all Arms are
completed.

skills.name: Limited Attacks
text: Due to the size of the Hecatoncheires, only two Arms can attack the
same target in 10 seconds (1 round).

skills.name: Power Strike II
text: They can deal an additional +12 damage on their next attack. However,
any Evasion Check made by them this turn receives a -2 penalty.

skills.name: Layered Protection
text: The Defense of Upper Body section is increased by +2 points for each
remaining Arm section.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Hecatoncheires’ height prevents enemies from attacking it. The
Upper Body receives a +4 bonus to Evasion checks against melee attacks.
This effect disappears when the Lower Body falls to 0 HP or lower.

description: This is a 12-armed giant (see p. 62) of about 6 meters in height. When fighting, they carry weapons on 6 arms and shields on the other 6. They value bravery and respect those who come at them fairly and squarely, but they are angry at those who act cowardly. Because of this, they are often entrusted with guarding important places such as the treasury and are not often seen outside.

name: Murcielago Latigo

skills.name: Flight
text: A Murcielago receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for
melee attacks.

skills.name: Swords of Protection Resistance
text: If the Murcielago is within the influence of Swords of Protection, the
Murcielago’s soulscars are treated as 2 points lower than it originally was.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Universal Metamagic], [Multi-Action].

skills.name: Mana Strike = +19 damage
text: May deal an additional +19 damage to their next melee attack. At risk,
they take a -2 penalty to their Fortitude and Willpower checks.

skills.name: Cleave II
text: It attacks with a weapon up to 5 characters within the skirmish in which it
resides.

skills.name: Bonds of Love and Blood/18(25)/Willpower/Neg
text: The same ability as of a Murcielago (see p. 96).

skills.name: Bat Shapeshifting
text: Murcielago changes its own appearance into a bat about 20 cm in length.
Or, it returns to its original form from the state of being a bat.
When in the form of a bat, the physical abilities of the bat will be
equivalent to its appearance (enough to fly as a bat), and all unique skills
will be ineffective. Also, the bat form is not treated as a character and is not
a target of any effect. If the character is changed during a battle, it can leave
the battlefield.
This ability can be used only once per hour, and unless this ability is used,
the shape never changes.

loot.item: The Lustrous Blood of Murcielago (2,000G/Red S) x 1d

description: Among the Murcielago (see p. 96), Latigo vampires are especially favored by Nosferatu (see p. 60). While Murcielago excel at seducing and cajoling Humanoids, Latigo vampires are known to be equally skilled and even better fighters.

They educate and direct the regular Murcielagos, serving as Nosferatu's close associates and personal guards, protecting them with their lives. They also boast of their overwhelming good looks and sometimes use them to discredit superior heroes in humanoid society or even to seduce and take them as their own servants.

name: Diablo Captain (Human Form)

skills.name: Tough Skin
text: Whenever it receives physical or magical damage of the bludgeoning
type, it is reduced by -3 points.

skills.name: Flight II
text: Receives a +2 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee attacks.

skills.name: Limited 2 Actions
text: The monster can perform two Major Actions in one round. However,
this is limited to one weapon melee attack and one [►Daemonic Eyes III]
once each.
It cannot use [🗨Cleave II] for that melee attack.

skills.name: Cleave II
text: It attacks with a weapon up to 5 characters within the skirmish in which it
resides.

skills.name: Daemonic Eyes III/Can’t
text: With a sharp look in its eyes, it makes enemies shrivel.
With “Range/Area: 2(30m)/Target”, select any number of targets and
deal 10 curse fixed damage each. Afterward, Diablo’s HP is restored by
the sum of all applied damage dealt to the targets.
Using this ability consumes 4 points of MP per character targeted.

skills.name: Barbarous and Daemons Strengthening
text: All Barbarous and Daemon monsters except for the Diablo Captain
within "Range: Self" and "Target: All Areas(30m Radius)/All" receive a +2
bonus on all action checks except Evasion checks, and the physical and
magic damage they cause is increased by +2 points.

skills.name: Instant Daemonshift
text: The character changes into the daemon form with Minor Actions or
during Combat Preparation. For the data, see Diablo Captain (Daemon
Form) (see the next page). HP and MP are restored to their maximum
values, and all effects of magic, etc., are negated. In the turn in which this
unique skill is performed, only the Head section of the Daemon Form is
treated as having completed the Major Action, and the Right Side and Left
Side sections can make it this turn.
[⏩△Instant Daemonshift] cannot be used for 3 hours immediately after
the [►Humanification] was used. Also, [►Humanification] cannot be
used for 1 hour immediately after [⏩△Instant Daemonshift] was used.

description: This is a Diablo (see p. 60) who has led an army through age and many combat experiences.

They are a skilled commander of Barbarous and Daemons and is a master of drawing out their strengths, sometimes leading the troops, but they are also devoted to the training of young Diablos. They have a broad perspective on the expansion of Barbarous as a whole. Therefore, they are not only at odds with Humanoids but also often engage in strategic bargaining and political dealings.
When transformed into the daemon form, they expose their true ferociousness and destroy their enemies with their fighting instincts.

name: Diablo Captain (Daemon Form)
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Right Side / Left Side) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Tough Skin
text: Whenever it receives physical or magical damage of the bludgeoning
type, it is reduced by -3 points.

skills.name: Limited 2 Actions
text: The monster can perform two Major Actions in one round. However,
the monster must choose two different actions from the melee attack,
[►Daemonic Eyes III] or [►Daemonic Cursed Rain].

skills.name: Daemonic Eyes III/Can’t
text: Same as for Diablo Captain (Human Form).

skills.name: Daemonic Cursed Rain/20(27)/Willpower/Half
text: First, the Head must spend 10 points of MP to use this ability. Then, roll
2d, and calculate the Intensity of the effect as "roll + 5".
The Diablo Captain receives fixed damage of Intensity points, and at the
same time, at "Range: Caster" and "Target: All Areas (30m Radius)/All"
receive “Intensity x 3” curse magical damage. Any character within this
range can be excluded from the target.

skills.name: Humanification
text: It changes to the Human form. For data on the Human form, refer to
Diablo Captain (Human Form). If the Head section has suffered HP or
MP damage or has been affected by magic or other effects, these are
carried over to the Human form. If its HP is less than 0, it immediately
falls unconscious.
[►Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately after
[⏩△Instant Daemonshift] was used. Also, [⏩△Instant Daemonshift]
cannot be used for 3 hours immediately after the [►Humanification] was
used.

skills.name: Flight II
text: All sections receive a +2 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If either the Right Side or Left Side section falls to 0 HP or lower, this
unique skill cannot be used.

skills.name: Cleave II
text: It attacks with a weapon up to 5 characters within the skirmish in which it
resides.

skills.name: Daemons Strengthening
text: All Daemon monsters within "Range: Self" and "Target: All Areas(30m
Radius)/All" receive a +2 bonus on all action checks except Evasion checks,
and the physical and magic damage they cause is increased by +2 points.

skills.name: Barbarous Strengthening
text: All Barbarous monsters (except this monster) within "Range: Self" and
"Target: All Areas(30m Radius)/All" receive a +2 bonus on all action checks
except Evasion checks, and the physical and magic damage they cause is
increased by +2 points.

name: Succubus Knight

skills.name: Flight
text: A Succubus receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Magic (2 systems) 15 Level/Magic Power 20(27)
text: Succubus has mastered any two of Spiritualism Magic, Divine Magic, and
Summoning Arts at the 15th level.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Universal Metamagic], [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Mana Strike = +20 damage
text: May deal an additional +20 damage to their next melee attack. At risk,
they take a -2 penalty to their Fortitude and Willpower checks.

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +12 points.

skills.name: Indecent Dreams/20 (27)/Willpower/Neg
text: Within “Range: Caster” and "Target: All Areas (20m radius)/All" are put
to sleep, and show a lewd dream. Deals 2d points of curse damage to
target's HP or MP, immediately followed by sleep. The Succubus must
choose whether to target HP or MP for each use of [►Indecent Dreams]
and will regain HP or MP equal to the damage dealt.
This effect is both psychic + curse type. However, sleep brought by this
effect is treated as psychic (weak) type.

description: Among Succubus (see p. 98), this Succubus Knights are especially good at fighting.
They have the ability to refine weapons, use scythes and swords, and wear tight silhouette armor. Their beautiful appearance mesmerizes and awe- inspires the viewer at the same time.

They love to attract the strong heroes and take particular pleasure in seducing them with their bewitching beauty, as well as in overpowering them with their fighting prowess, bringing them to their knees, and then sucking their energy out of them.

name: Vampire Tetrahedron

skills.name: Truespeech Magic, Spiritualism Magic, Divine Magic 14 Level/Magic
text: Power 21(28)

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Magic
Convergence], [Hawk Eye], [Universal Metamagic], [Double Cast],
[Wordbreak].

skills.name: Knowledge & Weakness Exploit/21(28)
text: Can make Sage Intelligence checks with a Standard Value of 21 (fixed
value of 28).
If this monster makes an attack against another character who is detected
as having a weak point, the effect of the attack is doubled.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Vampire Tetrahedron receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion
only for melee attacks.

skills.name: Regeneration = 12 points
text: At the end of each round, a Vampire Tetrahedron recovers 12 HP. This
does not affect the Vampire Tetrahedron at 0 HP or lower.

skills.name: Vampire Body
text: As long as a Vampire Tetrahedron is under sunlight, it takes 12 magic
damage at the end of its turn and receives a -2 penalty to all Accuracy and
Evasion Checks. This damage cannot be reduced in any way. Additionally,
the Vampire Tetrahedron cannot use their [◯Regeneration] or
[◯Normal Weapon Immunity] abilities.

skills.name: Fourth Dimensional Laws/22(29)/Willpower/Neg
text: It is a limited manifestation of a higher level of reason that is
incomprehensible to the human mind.
This skill affects in "Range/Area: 1(100m)/Target" affects "Target: 1
Character". Target will treat "5" or "6" as "0" for each dice rolled for the Skill
Checks for 10 seconds (1 round). So, Success Value can become even 1
or 0. If a dice roll is changed by an effect such as [Sword's Grace /Change
Fate], or if a dice roll is changed again, this effect will still work, so for
example “1,2” roll changed to “5,6” will result in 0+0= 0 result.
Even with this effect, the automatic failure still occurs only when "1, 1"
was rolled.
This effect can be used only once in 10 seconds (1 round) for the same
target, and consumes 5 MP to use.

skills.name: Vampire of the Matter Clan
text: If a Claws attack hits, the monster's HP will be restored by the applied
damage.
A target whose HP is reduced to 0 or less by Claws' attack suffers a -15
penalty on Death Checks. If such a target fails the Death Check, the
monster chooses one of the following three options: make the target a
vessel, make the target die, or scar the soul for 5 soulscars of the target and
turn it into Mad Blood (see p. 143).
Those that become Mad Bloods begin to act immediately afterward.
The vessels do not age the same as there are under the effect of
[Preservation] (see CR II, p. 142). They cannot take action, and no other
effect or damage is applied except for canceling this effect can affect them.
This effect is treated as a curse type effect with a Success value of 26. If the
effect is dispelled, the target is "dead" at the time of dispelling.
If Vampire Tetrahedron does not recover HP by [◯Vampire of the
Matter Clan] for 7 days, their HP and MP will be reduced by 12 points,
and they lose their unique skill [◯Regeneration]. This reduction will
accumulate every 7 days, but it will all be removed immediately when the
[◯Vampire of the Matter Clan] is used.

skills.name: Revival
text: When the HP of this monster becomes 0 or less, and there is a character
within a 100m radius who has become a vessel by the effect of [◯Vampire
of the Matter Clan], the monster will immediately take over the character's
body and revive itself. When this happens, the HP is restored to its
maximum value, but the MP inherits the current value of the Vampire
before revival.
The vessel character dies at this stage. To revive, the HP of the new
Vampire Tetrahedron must be reduced to 0 or less, and the corpse must
be retrieved (for example, if the Vampire dies by falling off a cliff, they may
resurrect out of the PCs' sight). If there are multiple vessels within the area
of effect, a character will be randomly selected from them to become the
new body.

loot.item: Glasses of the Immortal (3,500G/Gold Black White S) Golden Recording Glasses of the Immortal

description: Among the Nosferatu (see p. 60), there exists a Matter Clan of vampires who have spent many years studying as scholars. Like other clans, they focus on contracts, but their first priority is to pass on knowledge.

Despite their considerable proficiency in Barbarous, they do not like to exclude others from their work. They view almost everything as a research target, and their only concern is whether or not they can prove their own ideas through experiments or other means. They prefer to "preserve" the state of things so that their research targets will never cease, and they do not go around killing or destroying without careful consideration.

However, they will not tolerate any interruption that may interfere with their research and will try to eliminate it with their own abilities. They are also characterized by their arrogance and ruthlessness, and when it comes to the experiments they have in mind, they do not care about the lives of others.

name: Drake Count (Human Form)

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: A Drake Count (Human Form) can use the Combat Feats [Targeting],
[Magic Convergence], [Magic Control], [Universal Metamagic], [Hawk
Eye], [Multi-Action], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Techniques
text: A Drake Count (Human Form) can use the [Beetleskin], [Cat's Eyes],
[Recovery (9 pts.)], [Giant Arms], and [Sphinx Knowledge] Techniques.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Drake Count receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for
melee attacks.

skills.name: Mana Strike = +21 damage
text: A Drake Count may deal an additional +21 damage to their next melee
attack. If they do, at risk, they receive a -2 penalty to Fortitude and
Willpower checks until their next turn.

skills.name: Instant Dragonification
text: The Drake Count transforms into a dragon form, healing all HP and MP.
Any lingering magical effects are removed as well. For more information,
see the Drake Count (Dragon Form) stats. In the turn in which [⏩△Instant
Dragonification] is performed, only the Body section of Dragon Form is
treated as having completed the Major Action, and Wing sections can
make them on this turn.
[⏩Instant Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately after
using [⏩△Instant Dragonification]

description: One of the highest-ranking Barbarous, Drake Counts have a regal air about themselves that lesser Drakes (see p. 83) do not. While they may be the same as other Drakes physically, a Drake Count's appearance and mannerisms have that noble look about them, unconsciously showing off their status to other Barbarous. At the same time, Drake Counts are masterful combatants and tacticians, able to easily control thousands of Barbarous beneath them.

A massive beast, the dragon form of a Drake Count, is much larger than those of the Drake Barons underneath them. With glistening translucent green scales, its glory is only surpassed by its frightening combat unique skill.

name: Drake Count (Dragon Form)
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Body / Wing x 2) Main Section: Body

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: A Drake Count (Dragon Form) can use the Combat Feats [Targeting],
[Magic Convergence], [Magic Control], [Universal Metamagic], [Hawk
Eye], [Multi-Action], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Techniques
text: A Drake Count (Dragon Form) can use the [Beetleskin], [Cat's Eyes],
[Recovery (9 pts.)], [Giant Arms], and [Sphinx Knowledge] Techniques.

skills.name: Mana Strike = +21 damage
text: A Drake Count may deal an additional +21 damage to their next melee
attack. If they do, at risk, they receive a -2 penalty to Fortitude and
Willpower checks until their next turn.

skills.name: Radiant Breath/24 (31)/Fortitude/Half
text: Drake Count spits out a pure energy mass at "Range/Area: 2(50m)/Shot"
and explodes it at the point of impact, dealing "Target: 1 area (6m
Radius)/20" 2d+25 energy magic damage.
This unique skill cannot be used in consecutive turns.

skills.name: Instant Humanification
text: It instantly transforms into Human form. Refer to Drake Count (Human
Form) for data on the Human form. If the Body section has suffered HP
or MP damage or has been affected by magic or other effects, these are
carried over to the Human form. If its HP is less than 0, it is immediately
stunned.
[⏩△Instant Humanification] cannot be used for 1 hour immediately after
using [⏩△Instant Dragonification].

skills.name: Flight
text: A Drake Count (Dragon Form) receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and
Evasion only for melee attacks.
If one of the Wing sections falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot
be used.

skills.name: Decoy Attack II
text: It gains -2 to Accuracy checks, but the damage is increased by +8 on hit.
If the declared attack is evaded, the enemy receives a -2 penalty to Evasion
checks for the next 10 seconds (1 round). This effect is cumulative up to -
8 but is lost if the target fails an Evasion check even once.

name: Wolf
description: A simple Wolf, often appearing in packs of 3 to 5.
They are often tamed by Bolgs (see p. 75).

name: Giant Gadfly

skills.name: Flight
text: Receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee attacks.

skills.name: Constant Attacks
text: If an attack by a Giant Gadfly is evaded, the next attack by the Giant
Gadfly on that target will gain a +1 bonus to the Accuracy checks until end
of the monster’s turn.
This modifier is cumulative for all Giant Gadflies and has no upper limit.
However, it is lost once the Giant Gadfly hits or the last Giant Gadfly attack
of the round is avoided.

description: It is a gigantic fly with a body length of over 50 cm. They attack mainly animals, cutting them with their sharp mouthparts and sucking off the blood to fill their bellies.
They frequently act in herds. Such herds tend to target larger objects because of the ease of attacking them as a group.

name: Giant Lizard
description: A carnivorous giant lizard, its body, is about 2m long. Adventurers should be wary of lone Lizards, as their companions tend to wait in ambush for unwary stragglers.
In rare cases, there are those specimens with finer scales than usual. If enough of these scales can be harvested and brought to a skilled armorsmith, high-quality scale mail can be made.

name: Dolphin

skills.name: Underwater
text: It cannot move outside of the water and cannot act outside of the water,
but it does not suffer any restrictions or penalties for actions in the water.

description: This species of Dolphin grows to around 3m long and is highly intelligent, able to speak its own language. While Dolphins often live in groups out in the seas and open ocean, they will rarely come to the coast and attempt to make contact with Humanoids.

name: Purple Ant
habitat: Forests, Mountain, Cave, Grassland, Wilderness, Shallows

skills.name: Formic Acid/4(11)/Fortitude/Neg
text: Spit acid on “Target: 1 Character” at “Range: Touch,” dealing 2d-1
poison magic damage.

description: These giant ants are more than 1 meter long and covered with a purple shell. Carnivorous, they nest here and there in Alframe, and their ferocity in attacking at random makes them a threat to people.

They are often seen in Shallow Abysses, and their nests can be found where Shallows were found before. Abyssal shards are also sometimes found in the nests, and their connection to Abyss is being investigated.

name: Anaconda

skills.name: Entanglement
text: A successful hit from a Constrict attack entangles the target. In each
round, the Anaconda hits the entangled target automatically and makes all
Accuracy and Evasion Checks with a -2 penalty.
When the target tries to escape, use de-bonding (see p. 71).
While entangled by this unique skill, the Anaconda cannot attack other
characters. If the monster itself wants to release the target, it can do so with
a Minor Action.

description: A large snake, an Anaconda measures around 2m in length. Its preferred method of attack is to hide in trees as though it were a large vine, then drop down onto unsuspecting prey. The coils of an Anaconda can constrict and suffocate something as large as a cow. The skin of the Anaconda is prized for its capabilities when turned into leather, and adventurers are often sent to procure such skins.

name: Grey Lynx

skills.name: Continuous Attack
text: If a Grey Lynx successfully hits a target in melee, it may make a second
attack against the same target.

description: This large wildcat has grown to a size of 2m. The Grey Lynx is keen on hiding itself and avoids Human-sized prey, which leads children to think of these cats as myths.
While fur is not quite a luxury, there is still a steady enough demand for it. There may also be seeds from unknown plants stuck in the fur, some of which may yet still sprout.

name: Pack Leader

skills.name: Pack Command
text: Gives a +1 bonus to all Wolves’ Accuracy and Evasion checks in the
skirmish in which it resides. This effect is not cumulative, even if there are
multiple Pack Leaders.

skills.name: Aimed Attack
text: When attacking, the Pack Leader can gain a +1 bonus to Accuracy. This
ability has no effect on characters equipped with metal armor.

description: They are the leaders of the wolf pack. They are one size larger than a normal Wolf (see p. 106) and much more dangerous. However, the true fear lies in the fact that wolves led by a pack leader move in a more controlled manner than regular ones.
For novice adventurers, a pack of wolves led by a Pack Leader can be a considerable threat.

name: Vulture

skills.name: Flight
text: Receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee attacks.

description: A large bird of prey that typically lives in high mountains or canyons, the vulture has a wingspan that can reach up to 3 meters. With this, it can easily carry away both livestock and humans. Normally, vultures are content to fly high above, but when hungry, they will descend to catch prey and bring it back to their nest.

name: Sharp Nails

skills.name: Just Scratches
text: If the roll of the damage decision is 5 or less, the Sharp Nails gets a +1
bonus to Evasion checks for the following 10 seconds (1 round).

description: The monkey is small, measuring about 70 cm in length. It has long, thin claws on both hands, which it uses to pounce on and attack its prey.
These monkeys are brutal and vigilant, and they can be tricky, challenging, and distracting as they rip through their prey.

name: Giant Crab

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: Can make two Pincers attacks each round, though each attack requires its
own Accuracy check. They may choose to attack different characters with
each attack.

description: Measuring on average 2m, a Giant Crab uses its size, bulk, and powerful pincers to take down their prey. It's even said that some land-based animals have been caught and eaten by some Giant Crabs.

name: Dinos
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Head/Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Freezing Breath/5(12)/Fortitude/Half
text: Spits mass of cold air with “Range/Area: 2 (20m)/Shot” at “Target: 1
Character”, dealing 2d+2 water/ice magic damage.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Dinos' height prevents enemies from attacking them. The Head receives
a +4 bonus to Evasion checks against melee attacks.
When the Body falls to 0 HP or lower, this effect disappears.

description: This is a large false dragon, white-scaled, that inhabits the cold regions of the Alframe continent. It is about 3 meters long, with small forelimbs and hindlimbs for body support and a long tail for balance.
It has an organ that produces cold air in the body and can exhale it.
Their meat is edible and can be frozen and brought home using its cooling organs, making them the desired target for hunting.

name: Poisonous Spillbug

skills.name: Corrosive Fluid Secretion
text: If the monster is hit by a melee or ranged attack, the weapon or
ammunition will be affected by the corrosive fluid. If not cleaned with at
least 1 liter of alcohol within 24 hours, they will rot and become useless.
Magic weapons and ammunition are not affected by this effect.
If the attack was made with a natural weapon, the attacker must suffer 1d
poison magic damage for each hit.

skills.name: Venom Spray/5(12)/Fortitude/Half
text: Sprays poison fluid at "Target: 1 area(3m Radius)/5" with "Range: Caster."
The target receives 2d poison magic damage.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Curl Up
text: It curls up its body and defends itself with its outer shell. While curled
up, it gains +3 Defense points but cannot make a melee attack with its
Mouth.
Stretching a curled up body is also a Minor Action. The body can only
be curled up or stretched before the Major Action is executed.

description: It is a species similar to a bug with a total length of more than 1 meter. It prefers moist ground, such as swamps and deep forests where there is no sunlight. It constantly secretes poisonous body fluid, which it uses to weaken approaching small animals and prey on them.
Its poisonous shell can become a dangerous weapon if carefully processed and traded at a high price by some.

name: Lizard Fly

skills.name: Flight
text: A Lizard Fly receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

description: Lizard Flies appear to be larger than average lizards, ranging in size from about 50cm to 1m, with two pairs of thin, translucent wings on their back.
Carnivorous, they will stay buried under sand until prey comes near, then spring out and attack.

name: Crocodile
description: Giant beasts, Crocodiles, inhabit murky waters near rivers and swamps where they can hide from prey. Their speed while in water is incredible, and their jaws will crush any game caught within. Once dragged underwater, there is no escape.
It is said that Superior Crocodile Skins can be used for a number of goods, such as luxury bags and wallets.

name: Sandworm

loot.item: Green Sandworm Gem (200G/Gold Red A) x 1d

description: A giant snake-like creature that lives in the sand may have up to one-fifth of its body covered in a hard exoskeleton. Older Sandworms often have gems in their hide, formed from the sand and pressure. The green gems carry a high price in markets, while the clear gems have value when crushed into an abrasive polishing powder.
Some of Bolgs (see p. 75) seem to have tamed Sandworms and use them in battle.

name: Dark Sweeper

skills.name: Slime Vomit/6(13)/Fortitude/Half
text: In "Range/Area: 1(10m)/Shot," spits out a mass of water mixed with a
sticky substance to "Target: 1 Character" to attack.
The target suffers "2d+5" water/ice magic damage and takes a -2 penalty
on Evasion checks for a total of 3 minutes (18 rounds). The penalty to
Evasion check is not cumulative and is removed if the target wipes off the
sticky water with a Major Action.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

description: It is a giant water spider about 2 meters long. Although it can swim underwater, its main means of transportation is to walk on the water using its water-repellent legs dexterously.
They nest under bridges or underground in places where water flows and prey on fish and other aquatic animals.

name: Tiger

skills.name: Fast Action
text: During the first round of combat, if Tiger wins the initiative, it may take
two Major Actions that round.

skills.name: Continuous Attack
text: If a Tiger successfully hits a target in melee, it may make a second attack
against the same target.

description: A four-legged carnivore with black and orange stripes. A ferocious feline, these large cats are hunting experts alone, hiding with their striped camouflage and striking unexpectedly. Their fur is prized by fashion enthusiasts, and high-quality pelts can fetch a good price at the market.

name: Iron Turtle

skills.name: Shell Guard
text: The Iron Turtle can retract into its shell, increasing its Defense by +10
for 10 seconds (1 round).

skills.name: Cover I
text: The effect is the same as the combat feat [Cover I] (see CR I, p. 255).

description: A large turtle, ranging anywhere from 1 to 3 m in size, gets its name because its shell is as hard as iron. These turtles are fairly docile, slow to move, and unlikely to cause any harm. However, because their shell is used in a variety of crafts, overfishing has led to a decline in their population and the Iron Turtle is becoming harder to find in the wild.

name: Calvert Worm

loot.item: Green Sandworm Gem (200G/Gold Red A) x 1d

description: It is a sub-species of the Sandworm (see p. 110), and its territory includes muddy rivers and dark marshes. They are green and brown in color and move freely through the mud.

name: Grizzly Bear

skills.name: Double Attack
text: A Grizzly Bear can make two Claw attacks.

skills.name: Bear Hug
text: If the Grizzly Bear successfully hits with both attacks from [►Double
Attack], it will hold the target, and the target will not be able to move or
make melee or ranged attacks. Each round during the Grizzly Bear’s turn,
the held target is hit automatically by the Grizzly Bear, dealing 2d + 16
damage.
When the target tries to escape, use de-bonding (see p. 71).
While entangled by this unique skill, the Grizzly Bear cannot attack other
characters. If the monster itself wants to release the target, it can do so with
a Minor Action.

skills.name: Power Strike
text: They can deal an additional +4 damage on their next attack. However,
any Evasion Check made by them this turn receives a -2 penalty.

description: A large bear with grey-brown fur, Grizzlies can stand on their hind legs to intimidate would-be predators, standing around 2-3m tall. In the summer, they will rarely appear to those wandering in the wilderness, but as the seasons change, they will attack livestock to build up bulk for their winter hibernation. Grizzlies are especially dangerous during the springtime, as they are ravenously hungry after hibernation.

Bear paws, specifically the right paw, are used as ingredients in high-end cuisine, as the right paw is used to scoop honey. It is said that honey has infused itself into the bear's skin, giving the paw an almost sweet, gamey flavor. The left paw, however, is rarely used and often discarded as there is little demand for it.

name: Crimson Maggot

skills.name: Bloodsucking
text: If a Bite attack hits, the monster's HP is restored by a value equal to the
applied damage.

skills.name: Cannibalism
text: Within "Range: Touch," this monster preys on other Crimson Maggots
"Target: 1 Character".
The target dies immediately. At the same time, the monster’s HP is
restored to its maximum value.
For the next 3 minutes (18 rounds), the Crimson Maggot using this effect,
gains a +1 bonus to Accuracy checks and +2 points to damage. This effect
is cumulative up to 4 times (Accuracy check +4, damage +8).

skills.name: Splashing Bodily Fluids/Can’t
text: If this monster dies (including when it is targeted by [►Cannibalism]), it
sprays hot bodily fluids to "Target: 1 area(3m Radius)/5" at "Range: Caster"
and deals 1d fire magic damage.

description: This maggot is a larva that has grown to about 1m to 1m 50cm in length without becoming an adult. They are reddish-black in color and move with surprising agility.
It has a symbiotic relationship with Fossil Chrysalis (see p. 114) and preys on small animals that approach it.
In times of crisis, they tend to eat the allies around them, enhancing their abilities.

name: Plain Centipede
sectionsNote: Sections: 2-5 (Head/Body x 1-4) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Deadly Poison/8(15)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Jaw attack hits and deals 1 applied damage, it deals additional 2d+6
poison magic damage to the target.

skills.name: Decoy Attack I
text: It gains -2 to Accuracy checks, but the damage is increased by +2 on hit.
If the declared attack is evaded, the enemy receives a -1 penalty to Evasion
checks for the next 10 seconds (1 round). This effect is cumulative up to -
4 but is lost if the target fails an Evasion check even once.

description: This is a giant centipede that appears on the plains of the Alframe continent. It mainly feeds on animals on the plains, but in the Dorden region, it has been observed to frequent the vicinity of railroad tracks. Studies have shown that they move along the tracks by licking the track water and oil spilled by trains, earning them the nickname "Railway Centipedes.” This habit is thought to be a way for them to replenish some nutrients, but this has not been proven with certainty. When they are large, they are not much bigger than a train and often block the railroad tracks and are requested to be taken down.

name: Petroviper

skills.name: Petropoison/7(14)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Bite's attack hits and deals more than 1 point of applied damage,
the target will gain Petrifaction effect (Dexterity, Agility/-6) effect (see p.
71). This effect is poison type.

description: It is a serpent with a dangerous poison that gradually petrifies its prey. Poison is mainly used to weaken its prey. However, it can also be used as a weapon against powerful enemies, and it will not stop attacking until it has completely petrified its prey.

name: Sabertooth Tiger

skills.name: Double Bite
text: When dealing damage with a Bite attack, the damage is rolled twice and
added during damage calculation.

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +6 points.

description: Similar in appearance to a regular tiger, the Sabertooth Tiger has two enormous, very sharp canine teeth that give it its name. These fangs are said to be strong enough to easily penetrate metal armor.

name: Giant Eagle

skills.name: Flight
text: A Giant Eagle receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for
melee attacks.

skills.name: Dive Attack
text: Giant Eagle dives down from a high altitude down on the unsuspecting
prey.
The Accuracy check is increased by +2, and the damage is +4 points. At
risk, the Giant Eagle receives a -3 penalty on the Evasion checks.

loot.item: Feathers of the Bird of Prey (400G/Red A)

description: This huge eagle is 3 meters in length and over 5 meters in height. It preys on animals as large as a human adults by weakening them with its sharp claws and taking them to its nest.
Sometimes flying Barbarous train them and keep them as pets.

name: Fossil Chrysalis
sectionsNote: Sections: 4 (Chrysalis / Tentacle x 3) Main Section: Chrysalis

skills.name: Block
text: The same as [Block] Combat Feat (see CR II, p. 202).

skills.name: Chrysalis Body
text: It is immune to critical hits from edged weapons and slashing-type attacks.
It also reduces all magic damage it suffers by -6 points.

skills.name: Soporific Scent/9(16)/Fortitude/Neg
text: It releases a soporific scent, putting all the characters in the skirmish it
resides to sleep.
Poison and psychic (weak) type countermeasures are effective against this
effect (for example, this effect can be removed with damage to HP or MP).
If the target is protected or resistant to both types, the target may choose
either type.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Cover I (Chrysalis only)
text: Has the combat feat [Cover I] (see CR I, p. 256). The Cover is limited to
the Chrysalis section.

skills.name: Long Tentacles
text: It can attack with Tentacle with "Range/Area: 1(10m)/Target".

description: This gigantic chrysalis, about 3 meters long, is often found in old ruins. Because of its huge size, when it is found, it is often only exposed partly in a ruin’s room, and its full extent is rarely revealed.

The body surface of the chrysalis is so hardened that it could be mistaken for a mineral. Moreover, it can move while still in its pupal state, making it dangerous to be caught in its movement. Black tentacles extend from the tip of the chrysalis, and while the body remains motionless, the chrysalis uses the tentacles to defend itself.
It is said that they hatch when some conditions are met, but there is no reported case of witnessing the moment of hatching.
They never appear alone but are always surrounded by several to a dozen Crimson Maggots (see p. 112) living in symbiosis.

name: Forest Kong

skills.name: Swinging
text: It hangs from a branch or other object above its head. The monster
receives no penalty due to poor footing until the beginning of the next turn.
It also gains a +1 bonus to Accuracy checks and has its Damage reduced
by -2 points.
This ability can only be used in environments with something to hang
overhead, such as a forest.

description: This giant ape is found in forests throughout the Alframe continent. They are about 2m 50cm long, and their arms are more developed than their legs. They use their arms and legs to move more quickly than they look. They are so strong that they can easily snap off an ordinary tree with their arms.

name: Crash Bear

skills.name: 2 Actions
text: Can perform two Major Actions in one round.

skills.name: Throw
text: If the Claws attack hits, it slams the target into the ground and causes it to
fall prone.

skills.name: Fall On/Can’t
text: This ability can only be used if the target is character prone.
The target receives 2d+18 physical damage.

description: These giant bears appear in forests and low mountains. They are known to be fierce and dangerous. They are especially dangerous in the fall before hibernation. Still, suppose they fail to hibernate and are active during the winter. In that case, they can be so dangerous that adventurers must be immediately dispatched to their habitat area.

name: Sea Serpent
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Head / Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Underwater Specialization
text: Can move in water without penalties and restrictions. Conversely, all Skill
Checks are subject to a -2 penalty on the ground.

skills.name: Fire Breath/9 (16)/Fortitude/Half
text: Spits out a fireball with "Range: Caster" and deals 2d+5 fire magic damage
to "Target: 1 area (4m Radius)/10".

skills.name: Entanglement II
text: A successful hit from a Sea Serpent attack entangles the target. Each
round, the entangled target is dealt 2d+8 physical damage and makes all
Accuracy and Evasion Checks with a -2 penalty.
The monster can use [◯Entanglement II] to entangle multiple characters
with multiple hits and can attack other characters while entangling.
When one of the targets tries to escape, use de-bonding (see p. 71).

skills.name: Long Body
text: The Head section can make a Bite attack with "Range/Area:
1(10m)/Target".
When the Body falls to 0 HP or lower, this effect disappears.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: The Sea Serpent's height prevents enemies from attacking it. The Head
receives a +4 bonus to Evasion checks against melee attacks. When the
Body falls to 0 HP or lower, this effect disappears.

loot.item: Shining Parasitic Shellfish Shell (1,000G/Gold Red S)

description: A giant ocean snake, a Sea Serpent, can measure up to 20m long, causing sailors to believe they had encountered an aquatic dragon. Under normal circumstances, they are solitary monsters, content to eat fish but will attack boats when desperately hungry. There are subspecies of Sea Serpents that can live in freshwater, and some cities have even enshrined a Sea Serpent as the embodiment of a water god.

name: Fake Angler
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Back / Tail) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Natural Mimicry/16/Danger Sense/Neg
text: It disguises itself as an island by floating only its back on the surface of the
water. While mimicking, characters cannot perform a Monster Knowledge
check on this monster. If a character approaches it unintentionally, they
need to make a Danger check with Target Number 16, and if it fails, they
will be surprised (see CR I, p. 144). Mimicry will be automatically ended
once the monster starts to act.
This monster cannot be detected with [Sense Magic].

skills.name: Dizzying Light/10 (17)/Willpower/Neg
text: Within “Range: Caster,” it shines a lantern on the forehead and confuses
"Target: All Areas (30m Radius)/All".
The target will appear to be out of position or distance from all characters,
including Fake Angler, for 10 seconds (1 round), and when attempting to
use a ranged attack or ranged effect, the target must roll 1d after
determining the target, and if the roll is "1 or 2", the target cannot be
properly targeted, and the action must be canceled. If they cancel the
action, ammunition, MP, and consumables will not be lost (and the target
forfeits their action for the turn).
If this effect is used, it costs 10 points of MP.
This effect is psychic type.

skills.name: Spine Fin Poison/11(18)/Fortitude/Neg
text: A target hit by a Spine Fin attack and suffering from more than 1 point of
applied damage to HP will suffer an additional 7 points of poison magic
damage.

skills.name: Tail Sweep
text: The monster can use its tail to attack up to 5 targets in the same skirmish.
An Accuracy check is made on all characters at once, and damage is
determined individually.
This attack cannot be used in consecutive rounds.

description: A giant anglerfish, about 5 to 7 meters long, it can be found in the coastal areas of the Alframe continent.
On its back are piles of ruins and building junk, which at night or from a distance may appear to be island structures.
Among the Barbarous, the Lizardmen are particularly knowledgeable about the ecology of this monster, and there are reports that they treat it as a nest or base, or use it to approach the coast.

name: Frost Panther

skills.name: Snow and Ice Mastery
text: On snow and ice, it has no penalties due to poor footing.

skills.name: Mimicry/16/Danger Sense/Neg
text: It blends its white body into the snowfield. While mimicking, characters
cannot perform a Monster Knowledge check on this monster.
If a character approaches it unintentionally, they need to make a Danger
check with target number 16, and if it fails, they will be surprised (see CR
I, p. 144). Mimicry will be automatically ended once the monster starts to
act.
This monster cannot be detected with [Sense Magic].

skills.name: Triple Attack
text: Frost Panther can attack the same target with three attacks.

description: This is a dangerous large predator of the cat family that roams the snowfields. Its pure white fur is almost invisible in the middle of the day. The skin provides more than enough warmth to keep the monster waiting for its prey in the snow for hours.
Because of its whiteness and warmth, its fur is valuable as the finest clothing material.

name: Giant Boar
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Head / Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Trample
text: A melee attack is applied to the targets within "Range/Area:
1(25m)/Breakthrough", and a melee attack is applied to each target by any
one section of this monster.
Once this ability is used, all sections will complete the Major Action.
This ability cannot be used if the HP of the Body section is 0 or less.

skills.name: Full Speed Rush
text: This ability can only be used in a melee.
Giant Boar rampages around and leaves the melee. It changes position
to an adjacent area in the backward direction (Simplified Combat) or to
any coordinates within 25m front or back (Standard Combat, Advanced
Combat).

description: These huge boars, which live in forests and mountains and reach more than 5 meters in length, are omnivores and are feared as demolishers of the environment because of their appetite for devouring anything and everything they can find and the wildness that they can rampage about on their huge bodies. They are extremely belligerent and territorial and will react with fierce hostility to anyone who approaches them.

name: Noisy Rattlesnake
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Head / Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Poison/11(18)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Bite attack hits, it deals additional 8 points of poison magic damage
to the target.

skills.name: Counter
text: This is the same effect as the combat feat [Counter].

skills.name: Strength Burst
text: It is ready to make a move. The monster receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy
checks and a -1 penalty to Evasion checks until the beginning of its next
turn.

skills.name: Noise Disturbance/Can’t
text: The sound made by the Tail disturbs mental concentration. The Tail
gives a -4 penalty to Spellcasting checks and Performance checks for
"Range: Caster" and "Target: All areas (50m radius)/All".
This effect has "Resistance: Can't," but it does not extend to characters
that cannot hear (see CR II, p. 71).

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: It can make two Tail attacks each round, though each attack requires its
accuracy check. They may choose to attack different characters with each
attack.

description: This type of rattlesnake boasts a vast body that can reach nearly 10 meters in length and a body thickness of over 20 centimeters in diameter. The intimidating sound they make with their tails is so loud that it is said to send anyone who hears it into a panic.

name: Brafotes
sectionsNote: Sections: 4 (Head / Body / Wing x 2) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Gale Breath/11(18)/Fortitude/Half
text: With "Range/Area: 2(30m)/Shot”, it exhales a violent wind in "1 area(3m
Radius)/5", dealing 2d+8 wind magic damage to the target.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Tail Sweep
text: The monster can use its tail to attack up to 5 targets in the same skirmish.
An Accuracy check is made on all characters at once, and damage is
determined individually.
This attack cannot be used in consecutive rounds.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • Impossible
text: Its body hinders the attack.
The Head section cannot be attacked, whether melee or ranged. When
the Body falls to 0 HP or lower, this effect disappears.

skills.name: Flight II
text: All sections receive a +2 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
This unique skill is lost if either Wing section is reduced to 0 or less HP.

description: It is a monstrous bird without feathers, with a wingspan of an adult of 7 to 10 meters. It has a reptilian-like body and is said to be a kind of pterosaur. They are ferocious; when they catch their prey, they go on a rampage and kill, pecking it. After the meal, it often becomes a paradise for carrion-eating animals. Such animals can be seen running in flocks on the ground, following this monster bird soaring in the sky.
Its membrane is prized as a material for leather goods.

name: Sky Whale
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Body / Tail) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Ultrasonic Attack/12 (19)/Fortitude/Neg
text: With "Range/Area: 2(30m)/Shot", the target is hit with a highly directional
ultrasonic blast that paralyzes the enemy. Target will have -2 on all action
checks for 30 seconds (3 rounds). This effect is not cumulative.
A character who is deafened is immune to this effect.

skills.name: Mist Breath/13(20/Fortitude/Half
text: With "Range/area: 2(20m)/Shot" and “Target: 1 area (5m Radius)/15" is
dealt 2d+12 water/ice magic damage.
In addition, a target that fails a resistance check suffers a -2 penalty on
Accuracy checks and Evasion checks for 10 seconds (1 round).
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Tail Sweep
text: The monster can use its tail to attack up to 5 targets in the same skirmish.
An Accuracy check is made on all characters at once, and damage is
determined individually.
This attack cannot be used in consecutive rounds.

description: These flying whales live in the vicinity of the Floating Masses. They are white and can grow up to 15 meters in length. They usually hide among clouds and are not easily spotted.
They prey on small flying birds and rarely attack humanoids.

name: Marsavra
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Body / Tail) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Body Press/11(18)/Fortitude/Half
text: The Marsavra’s body leaps up, carrying all the weight on its belly.
All characters in the skirmish it resides are dealt 2d+18 physical damage.
To use this ability, all sections (Head, Body, and Tail) must be able to
make a Major Action, and at least one must perform a Major Action. Then,
the Major Action of all sections is completed when this ability is used.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Fire Breath/13(20)/Fortitude/Half
text: Spits out a fire mass at "Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot", dealing 2d+12 fire
magic damage to “Target: 1 Character”.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Potbelly Defense (Attack Obstacle = Impossible • +4)
text: Extends belly to prevent attacks on the head. For 10 seconds (1 round)
after this ability is used, the Head section cannot be the target of melee
attacks and gains a +4 bonus on Evasion checks against ranged attacks.

skills.name: Continuous Attack
text: If the section successfully hits a target in melee, it may make a second
attack against the same target.

description: This large, fat, balloon-like reptile inhabits the south-central part of the Alframe continent. It is about 8 meters long and prefers arid land, but its body surface resembles that of a crocodile and is also covered with hard scales. Some call it crocodile skin, but it is superior to crocodile skin and is used as a material for leather products.

With a voracious appetite, any animal they see is prey for them, as large as a horse. When they find their prey to be a threat, they will spit out the fire to weaken it, and then, bouncing their whole body, they will try to finish it off.

name: Red Helm
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Head / Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: All-Out Attack
text: A Head can deal an additional 8 damage on its next attack. However, any
Evasion check made by this section this turn receives a -3 penalty.

skills.name: Cowering Eyes/12(19)/Willpower/Neg
text: Stares at one character in close proximity, filling them with fear.
One character in the same skirmish area receives a -2 penalty to Accuracy
and Evasion checks for 10 seconds (1 round), and the physical and magical
damage it inflicts is reduced by 4 points.
This effect is psychic type. This effect can only be used once per 10
seconds (1 round).

skills.name: Double Attack
text: Can attack twice with the Paws of both hands.

skills.name: Bear Hug
text: If the Red Helm successfully hits with [◯Double Attack], it will hold the
target, and the target will not be able to move or make a melee or ranged
attack. Each round, the held target is hit automatically by the Red Helm,
dealing 2d + 24 damage.
When the target tries to escape, use de-bonding (see p. 71).
While entangled by this unique skill, the Red Helm cannot attack other
characters. If the monster itself wants to release the target, it can do so with
a Minor Action.

skills.name: Intimidating Posture
text: Stands up and spread their arms wide to intimidate the target.
For 10 seconds (1 round), the Head section gains a +1 bonus to Accuracy
checks for melee attacks and +2 damage. At the same time, the Body
section takes a -2 penalty to its Evasion checks.
This effect can only be used once in 10 seconds (1 round).

description: The Korgana region is home to a huge bear that measures over 3 meters in length. Its body fur is almost blackish gray, and the area around its head and shoulders is discolored reddish black from the fresh blood of its prey.
These bears are extremely ferocious and belligerent. They will attack any creature that unknowingly enters their territory as prey.
There have been numerous reports of Humanoid and Barbarous beings killed, and surrounding villagers warn travelers and merchants to flee as fast as possible if they find traces of these bears.

name: Desert Scorpion
sectionsNote: Sections: 4 (Body / Right Pincer / Left Pincer / Tail) Main Section: Body

skills.name: Many Legs
text: It is not subject to penalties due to poor footing.

skills.name: Hide in the Sand
text: If the character approaches within 15 meters of Desert Scorpion, if they
fail the Danger Sense check with target number 18, they will receive a
surprise attack (see CR I, p. 144).

skills.name: Dusting Sand
text: For 10 seconds (1 round), all attacks against all sections of this monster
have a -1 penalty on Accuracy checks against them and Evasion checks
against attacks from them. Characters with Magic perception are not
affected by this.
To use its ability, 5 points of HP must be consumed.

skills.name: Decoy Attack II
text: It gains -2 to Accuracy checks, but the damage is increased by +8 on hit.
If the declared attack is evaded, the enemy receives a -2 penalty to Evasion
checks for the next 10 seconds (1 round). This effect is cumulative up to -
8 but is lost if the target fails an Evasion check even once.

skills.name: Dead Angle Attack
text: If the Body section is the target of a melee attack, an Accuracy check by
Tail can be performed instead of an Evasion check of the Body section.
See [Counter] for the detail of the process, CR II, p. 209. In failure, the
Body section suffers damage as with [Counter] feat.
This ability can only be used once per 10 seconds (1 round).

skills.name: Poison/13 (20)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Tail attack inflicts 1 or more applied damage, it inflicts 10 poison
magic damage to the target.

description: It is a giant scorpion that inhabits the deserts of the Alframe continent. Its body length, including the tail, exceeds 10 meters.

These lords of the desert usually lurk in the depths of the sand. When it recognizes an intruder in its territory, it approaches the intruder from the sand and kills it with a single strike of its deadly tail.

The shells are valuable as armor and building materials. Still, few people attempt to kill a living Desert Scorpion to steal it, instead obtaining it by searching for its rotting carcass in the desert or by picking up anything that falls by chance.

name: Hydra
sectionsNote: Sections: 8-10 (Body / Neck x 7-9) Main Section: Neck (All)

skills.name: Regeneration = 10 points
text: At the end of each round, each section of Hydra recovers 10 HP. This
has no effect if the section has 0 HP or lower.

skills.name: Fire Weakness
text: A section that suffers fire-type damage will not gain the effect of
[○Regeneration] for that round.

skills.name: Head Reviving
text: The body can wake the Neck section that has 0 HP or less. Its HP
becomes 1, and the Head can act immediately afterward.
Using this ability will consume 20 points of HP of the Body section.
Hydra cannot use [⏩Head Reviving], which would reduce the HP to 0 or
less.

skills.name: Limited Attacks
text: The Neck can only make two Bite attacks against the same target during
a single round.

skills.name: Long Neck
text: Bite attacks can attack at any character within “Range: 1(10m)”, ignoring
skirmishes.

skills.name: Poison Breath/13 (20)/Fortitude/Half
text: With “Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot", spits poison at "Target: 1 Character,”
dealing 2d+7 poison magic damage.
Hydra can use this unique skill only two times in total per round. Also,
the same Neck cannot use this unique skill in consecutive turns.

skills.name: Substitution
text: When the Body suffers damage from a melee or ranged attack, the Neck
can take damage instead. The damage to the Body is applied as-is to the
Neck (without recalculation). This unique skill can only be used once per
round for each Neck.
Hydra cannot use this unique skill against wide-area or multiple-target
attacks, even if they are melee or ranged attacks.

description: It’s a beast with numerous snakeheads, about 10 meters long. Each head has an independent ego and each prey on instinct. They usually emerge from swamps and lakes and attack animals in the lakeshore with only their heads protruding. The number of heads of hydra is often reported to be 7-9, but various accounts suggest that the number may vary, and each individual is thought to have a different number of heads.
When the body is attacked, all heads concentrate on this enemy. Hydra has an exceptional regeneration ability and is said to be able to revive heads repeatedly unless the wound is burned.

name: Murder Hornet

skills.name: Flight
text: A Murder Hornet receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for
melee attacks.

skills.name: Vital Strike
text: If the 2d roll determining damage is 9 or more, the damage is increased
by +8 points.

skills.name: Deadly Poisonous Needle/14(21)/Fortitude/Half
text: If the Needle hits, it deals 2d+6 poison magic damage.

skills.name: Murderous Wing Noise/13(20)/Fortitude/Neg
text: The Murder Hornet flaps its wings at high speed and sprays deafening
noise to "Target: 2-3 areas (10m radius)/All" within "Range: Caster", which
interferes with the concentration. The targets lose their hearing, and at the
same time, suffers a -2 penalty to Spellcasting check and action checks.
This effect is of psychic type. Also, it cannot be used for consecutive
turns.

description: Enormous bees, each one measuring a staggering 2 meters, roam the forests and grasslands of the northern Alframe continent. These majestic creatures hunt larger animals and build nests so massive that they could easily be mistaken for flying boulders.

So great is their weight that ancient structures and towering trees alike are said to have collapsed under their burden. But it is not just their size that is awe-inspiring. The needle on their abdomen is equally massive, nearly 20 cm in length, and coated with a deadly poison that can blind with a single touch.

name: Swamp Worm
sectionsNote: Sections: 5 (Mouth / Body x 3 / Tail) Main Section: Body (All)

skills.name: Swamp Monster Body
text: Damage from blunt weapons is treated as if Defense were 5 points higher.

skills.name: Bloodsucking
text: If the Mouth attack hits, the HP of any one section of this monster is
recovered by a value equal to the applied damage. Which section is
recovered can be selected after each attack and after all the damage
determination processes are completed. However, the section with HP
below 0 cannot be selected.

skills.name: Fluid Eruption/16(23)/Fortitude/Neg
text: With "Range: Caster" and "Target: 1 area (3m Radius)/5", it spurts out
bodily fluids and is used to blind the target.
If the target fails resistance, it becomes blind. This state can be removed
with an effect that cures blindness or by the target wiping its face with a
Major Action.
This unique skill can only be used when the HP of the Body section is
less than half of the maximum value (rounded up), and when used, it
consumes 10 HP. The body section can lower its HP to 0 or lower, with
this ability becoming disabled.

skills.name: Foot Scooping/12(19)/Danger Sense /Neg
text: Tail crawls underground and attacks the feet of the target. With “Range:
Touch,” Tail makes up to 5 characters fall prone. This effect only applies
to bipedal characters with only one section.

description: This is a giant earthworm that inhabits the swamps of the Alframe continent. The length of the body, from the mouth to the tip of the tail, is about 20 meters, with the largest exceeding 30 meters.

It is said that when they leave the swamp where they were born while still young and move to a spring or pond filled with fresh water, they dig up the bottom of the water and turn it into a muddy swamp, making it their new home.

name: Megaloceros

skills.name: Adapted to Snow
text: Megaloceros is not subject to adverse modifications for poor footing due
to snow, etc. or cold weather.

skills.name: Ice Deer Rationale
text: Megaloceros have a lot of experience in combat, and they judge the
combat situation correctly and act accordingly.
In judging the actions of combat, treat it as “Intelligence: Average”.

skills.name: Summon a Snowstorm/15(22)/Fortitude/Half
text: Megaloceros swings its antlers in complex gestures, creating a blizzard.
This unique skill has “Range: Caster” and deals 2d+12 water/ice magic
damage to "Target: 1 area (Radius 6m)/20".
If the value of the target's resistance check for this effect is lower than the
value of this unique skill by 3 or more, the target cannot take a Minor
Action for 10 seconds (1 round).
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns, and it consumes 10 MP
when used.

skills.name: Ice Shards/16(23)/Fortitude/Half
text: Antlers become covered with ice, and it throws it. It deals 2d+14 water/ice
magic damage to “Target: 1 Character” to “Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot”.
This unique skill can only be used once per round, and costs 6 MP.

description: This white-haired deer is revered as the guardian god of the snowfields and hail. From the time they are born, their antlers continue to grow, and by the time they reach adulthood, they are over one meter long.

As the antlers grow, they become harder and more translucent, giving them a mineral-like appearance. The antlers create cold air around them, and can be wielded to create snowstorms or freeze moisture in the air to form ice cubes.

name: Lunoicos
sectionsNote: Sections: 4 (Head / Front / Back / Tail) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Light Protection
text: It protects itself with a light covering its entire body. A character who
makes a melee attack against this monster, regardless of success or failure,
suffers 6 energy-fixed damage for each attempt.
This monster illuminates an area of 2 to 3 areas (10m Radius) centered
on itself.

skills.name: Light Ray/16(23)/Fortitude/Half
text: It attacks by firing a huge beam of energy light from its horns.
With “Range/Area: 2(30m)/Line" dealing 2d+12 energy magic damage.
This effect cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • +4
text: The Head cannot be attacked in melee. Against any ranged attacks, Head
receives a +4 bonus to Evasion checks.
This effect disappears when either Front or Back section falls to 0 HP or
lower.

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +12 points.

skills.name: Tail Swing
text: The monster can use its Tail to attack up to 5 targets in the same skirmish.

description: A giant reptile walks on all four legs covered with glowing scales. The glowing scales are believed to be caused by microscopic insects living symbiotically on the body's surface. They receive nutrients from the main body of Lunoicos and protect them from approaching foreign enemies by strongly glowing.
Lunoicos themselves are herbivores and do not actively attack other organisms. However, they have learned to harness the power of their symbionts and tend to confront danger rather than flee from it.

After the death of the Lunoicos, the symbionts reduce their activity to an extremely low level to survive. The scales become pale and luminescent, which lasts for a long time. This makes them highly prized as accessory materials. Each individual has a slight difference in the light's hue, making it collectible to enthusiasts.

name: Roc
sectionsNote: Sections: 7 (Head / Body x 2 / Wing x 2 / Leg x 2) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Continuous Attack
text: If a Roc successfully hits a target in melee, it may make a second attack
against the same target.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • Impossible
text: The huge Roc’s Body hinders attacks.
The Head of the Roc cannot be attacked with melee and ranged attacks.
This unique skill is lost when the Body section has 0 or less HP.

skills.name: Windstorm/18 (25)/Fortitude/Neg
text: The Roc flaps its wings, creating high winds dealing 2d+12 physical
damage within “Range: Caster” to “Target: All Areas (30m Radius/All”.
To use this ability, both Wing sections must be ready for Major Action.
Also, when this ability is used, the Major Action of both Wing sections is
completed.
This unique skill cannot be used in consecutive turns.

skills.name: Flight II
text: All sections receive a +2 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
This unique skill is lost if the Wing sections are reduced to 0 or less HP.

skills.name: Clutch
text: If the Talon attack hits, the target is grabbed; the target can no longer
move and can only perform melee attacks against the Leg that is grabbing
it.
Roc cannot attack the target Leg has grabbed except with the section it
has grabbed ([►Windstorm] also cannot hit the target). However, the
Talons of Leg section will automatically hit.
When the target tries to escape, use de-bonding (see p. 71). If the
monster itself wants to release the target, it can do so with a Minor Action.

description: A monstrous bird whose wingspan reaches 30m, the Roc is a wondrous sight to see. They live in the higher altitudes of most mountain ranges, though their massive form and vivid coloring can be seen from quite far away. With their massive talons, they can grab even mature cows and fly away with them, let alone a full-grown humanoid.

name: Blazing Mammoth
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Head / Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: 2 Actions
text: Can perform two Major Actions in one round.

skills.name: Fire Shower/19(26)/Fortitude/Half
text: Raising its snout high, it blows fireballs. The fireball deals 2d+25 fire
magic damage to "Target: 1 area(3m Radius/5" within "Range: Caster."
This ability can only be used once every 20 seconds (2 rounds).

skills.name: Throw/17(24)/Evasion/Neg
text: The Blazing Mammoth attempts to grab a “Target: 1 Character” within
“Range: Touch.” If successful, the target is thrown to the rearguard area of
their faction (Simplified Combat) or in any direction chosen by this
monster at 30m (Standard Combat) and falls down, taking 45 points of fall
damage.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Blazing Mammoth’s height prevents enemies from attacking it.
The Head receives a +4 bonus to Evasion checks against melee attacks.
This effect disappears when the Body section falls to 0 HP or lower.

skills.name: Trample with Both Feet
text: The Blazing Mammoth may Trample twice during the same turn but
must attack two different characters.

skills.name: Flame-clad/Can’t
text: The body surface of the Body section is always covered with fire. Any
character in the same position (area, coordinate) as this monster will
receive 6 fire magic damage at the end of this monster's turn.
This ability is lost when the HP of the Body section becomes less than 0.

skills.name: Burning Rage
text: The damage caused by [◯Flame-clad] is increased by +2 points for 3
minutes (18 rounds). This bonus is accumulated up to 3 times (max +6
points).
To use this ability, the monster must spend 5 points of HP. Also, it can
use this ability only once per round.

loot.item: Crimson Lotus Ivory Tusk (6,600G/Gold Red S)

description: This huge elephant-like animal continuously emits fire from its entire body and stands about 6 meters tall. It is adapted to volcanic regions, and the fire on its skin is not emitted from its own body but is ignited by rubbing its body against the surrounding magma to keep the fire going.
When angered, they secrete a viscous liquid from their skin, increasing the intensity of their flames.

name: Tyrant Regilex
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Body / Tail) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Might of the Tyrant/23(30)/ Willpower/Neg
text: This unique skill is treated as an effect of "Range: Caster" and "Target: All
Areas (100m Radius)/Space".
All characters in the area of effect, except Tyrant Regilex itself, must
perform Willpower at the beginning of their turn. If they fail, they suffer a
-2 penalty on all action checks for the next 10 seconds (1 round) due to
instinctive fear.
This effect is of the psychic type.

skills.name: Enormous Body
text: Tyrant Regilex's body is too large. Some attacks will not reach the enemy
in front of it. The Tail section melee attacks cannot be used to attack targets
that have been attacked by Head or Body sections. The same is true vice
versa.

skills.name: Continuous Attack
text: If a Tyrant Regilex successfully hits a target in melee, they may make a
second attack against the same target.

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +20 points.

skills.name: Claws
text: If the Claws attack hits, it should make two damage decisions, dealing
them both to the target.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • +4
text: The giant body hinders attacks.
The Head section gains a +4 bonus to Evasion checks against melee and
ranged attacks.
This effect disappears when the Body section falls to 0 HP or lower.

skills.name: Power Strike III
text: They can deal an additional +20 damage on their next attack. However,
any Evasion Check made by them this turn receives a -2 penalty.
