Within “Range/Area: 2(50m)/Shot” deals to the "Target: 1 area(6m
Radius)/20" 2d+20 magic damage.
The type of damage is chosen upon usage between fire, water/ice, and
lightning.

skills.name: Targeting & Hawk Eye
text: Stray shots cannot occur. It also can aim through the shielding.

skills.name: Gun
text: The Main Battery is a gun weapon that has a “Range: 2(30m)” and a
maximum magazine of 3. The Machine Gun is a gun weapon that has a
“Range: 1(10m)” and a maximum magazine of 6.

skills.name: Reload
text: Fully reloads the Main Battery and Machine Gun of that section.

skills.name: Volley
text: To use this ability, the weapon must have at least 3 bullets loaded, and 3
bullets are consumed at the same time.
The success value of the Accuracy check is set to 30, with the same
damage as a regular attack.
The same Dragon Fortress may only perform one [►Volley] per round
against the same target.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • Impossible
text: The Dragon Fortress's size hinders attack.
The Head cannot be attacked, whether melee or ranged. This effect
disappears when any Body section falls to 0 HP or lower.

skills.name: Stranded
text: If the HP of all Body sections is reduced to 0 or less, the Head sections
receive a -4 penalty for Evasion checks.

skills.name: Flight II
text: All sections receive a +2 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
This unique skill is lost if any Wing section is reduced to 0 or less HP.

loot.item: Rare Magical Components (900G/Black White A) Mysterious Magitech Components (2,400G/Black
Trove of Magical Components (7,600G/Black White S) Newly Discovered Magical Components

description: A large construct in the shape of a dragon, the Dragon Fortress is a huge machine, measuring around 50m long and 15m high. Able to fly at high speeds, its weapons are able to cause destruction on a massive scale. It is thought to be the top of the line when it comes to mobile defense and comes outfitted with a wide variety of weapons. It is an existence that brings together the highest level of technology in Magitech Civilization, and the leaders of each country are searching for their whereabouts.

name: Colossus: Knight
sectionsNote: Sections: 4 (Right Upper Body / Left Upper Body / Front Lower Body / Rear Lower Body) Main Section: None

skills.name: Mechanical Body
text: It is immune to criticals from edged weapons.

skills.name: Mana Coating (4)
text: Reduces magic damage received by -4.

skills.name: Colossus Trample
text: Colossus: Knight attacks with "Area: Breakthrough".
All targets within range will be hit with Colossus: Knight, one of the
sections’ Melee Attacks. All section Accuracy checks gain a +2 bonus, and
damage is increased by +6.

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: It can make two Spear attacks each round, though each attack requires its
Accuracy check. They may choose to attack different characters with each
attack.

skills.name: Stranded
text: If the HP of the Front Lower Body or Rear Lower Body section is 0 or
less, Right Upper Body and Left Upper Body sections suffer a -2 penalty
on the Evasion check.
If both of them have 0 or less HP, the penalty is -4.

skills.name: Eradicating Ray/19(26)/Fortitude/Half
text: The Front Lower Body fires ray of light at "Range/Area: 2(50m)/Line",
dealing "2d+20" energy magic damage.
This unique skill cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Emergency Maintenance
text: It restores its own body. This effect restores the HP of one of the sections
by 2dx5 points.
This effect cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Smoke Cover
text: he monster creates a cloud of smoke around it, making it difficult to see.
For 10 seconds (1 round), the monster's Evasion, Fortitude, and Willpower
checks for all sections of this monster are increased by +2 against characters
who are in another area (Simplified Combat) or 10m or more away
(Standard Combat, Advanced Combat) from Colossus: Knight.

loot.item: Colossus Blue Core (8,000G/Gold Black White S) Mysterious Magitech Components (2,400G/Black
Trove of Magical Components (7,600G/Black White S)

description: This is a Colossus (see p. 64), a figure that is relatively small figuratively speaking, although its overall height is over 10 meters. Designed for mobility, it has a warrior-like appearance of a Centaur, with a horse-like lower body and an armed humanoid upper body.

Its main role was to forcefully trample armies and break enemy formations with its long spears and rushing power. Equipped with destructive ray weapons, it was difficult to approach even from close range.

The Colossus may roam the wilderness or deserts in search of enemies, but it is reported to ignore only small numbers of opponents. It may be sleeping in ruins, attacking those who enter. When it awakens, it heads straight for its destination, causing serious damage to settlements and towns along the way.

Some Colossi were defective, or the hangars were targeted by the Barbarous, and if found in ruins, Colossi should be neutralized or destroyed as soon as possible. However, there have been past tragedies where people have awakened them by trying to destroy them, and now Knights still roam the surrounding lands.
Mythical Beasts

name: Achlis
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Front/Rear) Main Section: Front

skills.name: Intimidating Cry/3(10)/Fortitude/Neg
text: The Achlis makes an intimidating cry and causes enemies around it to
panic. Within “Range: Caster” and “Target: 1 area (3m Radius)/All," targets
suffer a -1 penalty on Accuracy, and Evasion checks for 10 seconds (1
round).
This effect can be used only once per round and cannot be used in
consecutive turns.

skills.name: Standing Upright
text: If the HP of the Rear is 0 or less, Front section gets a -2 penalty on
Evasion checks.

description: This Mythical Beast is about 2 meters long, with white fur and a llama- like appearance. It is characterized by small horns sprouting from both of its foreheads and jointless hind legs. The creature is highly sensitive and can become aggressive when influenced by the emotions and intentions of others.

name: Deela Harpy

skills.name: Enchanting Song/3 (10)/ Willpower/Neg
text: Deela Harpy sings a song with “Range/Area: 2(20m)/Target” to “Target:
1 Character”. The target obeys Deela Harpy's commands in the song's
lyrics.
The commands must be in a language that the target understands. The
commands must be simple, and the target will not obey any commands to
harm themselves.
This effect is treated as psychic type (weak).

description: A mythical beast, combining the appearance of a bird with that of a beautiful woman. Quietly interacting with Humans since the Magic Civilization period, Deela Harpy now lives deep in mountains and forests. If one happens to know either the Arcana or Elven languages, it is quite possible to converse with Deela Harpy.

Often mild-mannered, a Deela Harpy avoids fights with Humanoids unless there is a compelling reason to do so. In addition, some prefer reading to talking, and some carry manuscripts of books dating back to the Magic Civilization period.

name: Kamawet

skills.name: Underwater Specialization
text: Can move in water without penalties and restrictions. Conversely, all
action checks are subject to a -2 penalty on the ground.

description: Kamawets are sea-based mythical beasts, similar in appearance to a dragon without wings. Only a few meters long, they are mild-mannered and rather friendly, and are able to coexist with humanoids quite easily. Subsisting on a mostly fish diet, they rarely travel outside of the water. Sometimes, it even can carry humanoids on its back.

name: Hellhound

skills.name: Fire Breath/5 (12)/Fortitude/Half
text: A Hellhound breathes fire in a “Range: Touch”, dealing 2d + 4 fire magic
damage to up to 3 targets.
This unique skill cannot be used in consecutive rounds.

description: Hellhounds are large dogs with jet-black fur, often seen spitting gouts of flame. It is sometimes found in and around "Shallow Abyss," which is why it is also called “Watchdogs of Hell”.
Rarely, a red stone with a faint heat may be found inside its body.

name: Thunderbird
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Body/Wing x 2) Main Section: Body

skills.name: Thunderclap/6 (13)/Willpower/Half
text: Summons lightning with “Range: Self” and “Target: 1 area (6m
radius)/20” and deals 2d+4 lightning magic damage to the target.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Thunderbird receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for
melee attacks.
If one of the Wings falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be
used.

description: A huge bird cloaked in lightning, a Thunderbird's body shines brightly in the sky. Even amid combat, the electricity arcing off of one of these great birds is rather intense.

Thunderbirds often do not stay in one territory for long and are difficult to track down for any purpose. Only rarely does a Thunderbird settle down and create a nest, and more often than not it is due to spawning.
They may lay eggs in Shallow Abysses for self-preservation, which can create dangerous beasts for intruders.

name: Pegasus

skills.name: Flight
text: A Pegasus receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Poison/Disease Immunity
text: When the mount is subjected to a poison or disease-type effect or
damage, it can always be resisted as "Resistance: Optional."

description: A white horse with wings on its back, a Pegasus is a rare sight due to its somewhat skittish personality. The image of a Pegasus is popular in folktales and legends, and it is said that riding one is like running in the sky. They do not simply allow anyone to ride them, so the few adventurers and aristocrats seen on a Pegasus have just that much more prestige.

The wild species lives mainly in rugged mountains, but it is a popular Mythical Beast for riding and is also kept by the Rider's Guilds. It is rare to find adventurers and nobles who keep them privately.

name: Ratatoskr

skills.name: Razor Wind/7(14)/Willpower/Half
text: Creates razor wind, which deals 2d+3 wind magic damage to up to 3
characters at "Range/Area: 2(30m)/Target".
If this unique skill is used, 3 points of MP are consumed for each target
character.

description: This mythical beast is about 50 cm long and takes the form of a squirrel. It has a long central tooth that is half its own length. It is mischievous and tries to get in between Humanoid and other mythical beasts with whom it is close and to cause discord by spreading lies.

name: Varg

skills.name: Coordination
text: A Varg gains a bonus to their Accuracy equal to the number of other
Vargs (of any type) in the same skirmish area, up to a maximum of +4.

skills.name: Power Strike I
text: A Varg can deal an additional 4 damage on their next attack. However,
any Evasion Check made by them this turn receives a -2 penalty.

loot.item: Beautiful Mythical Beast Hide (800G/Gold Red A)

description: This mythical beast is about 2 meters tall and resembles a huge wolf. Its coat color is a gradation of black to white, with varying degrees of intensity, but mostly gray.

They have their own language consisting of howls, and they excel at hunting by using it to hunt down their enemies and coordinate their attacks. They are generally belligerent and have a primitive but unique culture centered on hunting.

Because of the way they are, they joined Dalkhrem's army during the War of the Gods, and even today, they are often seen as friends of the barbarous, and some of the barbarous have Varg as their mount, especially close to species are Bolgs, Ogres, Trolls, and Lycanthropes.
However, the relationship between Vargs and Barbarous is only as equal partners. It is said that if they are forced to be one-sidedly slavery, they will bite the Barbarous’ head off at that moment.

name: Emerald Raccoon

skills.name: Fairy Magic 6 Level/Magic Power 9(16)
text: Can use earth, water/ice, wind, and light types.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude [Prerequisite: Unique Skill Release]
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Metamagic/Number].

description: It is a Mythical Beast with green body hair of about 2m in length, inhabiting the forested areas of the Alframe continent, and looks like a raccoon dog. It can communicate with the same level of intellect as humans. It has a mild-mannered character and is a mediator between multiple Animals and Mythical Beasts in the forest ecosystem.
If a Humanoid or a Barbarous is trespassing on the territory of the Animals in the forest, they may use their magical powers to solve the problem.

name: Unicorn

skills.name: Fairy Magic 6 Level/Magic Power 8(15)
text: Can use earth, water/ice, light, and dark types.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Hawk Eye], and [Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Healing Horn/10 (17)/Fortitude/Neg
text: It touches the "Target: 1 Character" with a horn to heal the target's HP by
50 points. If the Fortitude check was the favorable result in the success
value comparison, the target will also be completely cured of any poison,
disease, curse, petrification, etc. that it has been subjected to. It is also
possible to apply this effect to itself.
However, this effect does not apply to constructs and magitech characters.
Furthermore, if the character touched by the horn is undead, not only is it
immune to the aforementioned effects, but it must also perform a Fortitude
and, if it fails, suffer magic damage of 50 points.
A character can only receive this effect once per day. In the case of a
character with multiple sections, each section can be affected up to once
per day.
Using this unique skill consumes 10 points of MP.

skills.name: Horn of Mana
text: If the Unicorn's MP reaches 0, it dies instantly, its horn crumbling into
useless dust.

loot.item: Unicorn Horn (Remaining MP x 300G/Gold Red A –

description: Unicorns are elegant creatures, horses with long, iridescent spiraling horns on their forehead. They are intelligent but very skittish, only appearing to human maidens and even then, quite rarely.
They are hunted by both outlaws and Barbarous for their horn, which can cure diseases and heal wounds even after it is removed from the Unicorn.

The horn has the entirety of the Unicorn's MP stored in it, and when cut it retains the Unicorn's current MP (killing the Unicorn in the process) and can be used as a Unicorn Horn (see CR II, p. 233 or ET, p. 150).

name: Antar

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control].

skills.name: Wrath of the Forest
text: It expresses anger at those who disturb the forest.
For 3 minutes (18 rounds), its Accuracy and Spellcasting checks get a +1
bonus.
This ability can be used only when its HP is less than half. After using this
ability, Antar cannot cancel the effect by itself and will not stop fighting until
it eliminates the enemy.

description: It is a mythical beast that looks like an antelope. Its mouth resembles a human-like shape, and it can speak humanoid languages.
Its goal is to protect the deep and quiet environment of the forest. When an invasion occurs in their territory, they will try to guide invaders out of the forest and, if impossible, eliminate them.
In some cases, they have been seen spending time with Humanoids and others who have chosen to live in symbiosis with the forest.

name: Amphisbaena
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Head x 2) Main Section: None

skills.name: Poison/10 (17)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Bite hits, it deals 8 poison magic damage to the target.

skills.name: Poisonous Gas Breath/10 (17)/Fortitude/ Half
text: Within “Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot" spits out poison gas in "1 area(3m
Radius)/5", dealing 2d poison magic damage to the targets.
This ability cannot be used for consecutive turns.

description: It is a two-headed poison snake with a head at each end of its body. It has bat-like wings, but they degenerate, and it cannot fly. It moves by rolling around like a wheel, with one head clamped onto the other.
In addition to having a poisonous bite, it is also known to breathe poisonous gas, and some scholars believe that, like Wyvern, it may have some connection to dragons.
Preferring cold climates, they mainly live in caves. There, they wait for prey to wander in and then kill and eat them with poisonous gas.

name: Griffon
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Body/Wing x 2) Main Section: Body

skills.name: Continuous Attack
text: If a Griffon successfully hits a target in melee, they may make a second
attack against the same target.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Griffon receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If one of the Wings falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be
used.

description: A mythical beast with the head and wings of an eagle and the body of a lion. Griffons are surprisingly agile in the air for their bulk and often nest in holes dug into cliffsides. A Griffon is attracted to and tends to collect shining objects, such as precious metals and gemstones. If they find an intruder trying to steal their shinnies, a Griffon will attack violently. Rarely some Griffons understand the common trade language.

name: Tilgris
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Front / Back) Main Section: Front

skills.name: Double Attack
text: Can make two Claws attacks with one Major Action.

skills.name: Lightning Breath/10(17)/Fortitude/Half
text: It spits lightning with “Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot" to "Target: 1 area (3m
Radius)/5.” It deals “2d+9” lightning and water/ice magic damage.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Long Tail
text: Tail attacks can be made with "Range/Area: 1(10m)/Target".

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +7 points.

description: It is a Mythical Beast similar to a tiger, with red and black tiger stripes on its fur. However, it is two times larger than an ordinary tiger.

It is characterized by a partially hardened skin from the forehead to the back that makes it appear armored. Tilgris, in addition to its sharp fangs and claws, uses its tail skillfully and mercilessly to attack its enemies. In addition, Tilgris has the ability to spit lightning breath, which has been described as “like a lightning cloud descending directly from the sky.”
They are territorial and exclusive, and it is considered very dangerous to venture into their territory.

Although they are often regarded as violent because of their ecology, they are also known to be as intelligent as humans. Although they cannot speak, they can understand human languages and are not easy to trap.
On the other hand, they are also known to be very faithful to their fellow humanoids, and some of them have developed friendships with humanoids and act as mounts in the Rider's Guilds.

name: Brutal Varg

skills.name: Coordination
text: A Brutal Varg gains a bonus to their Accuracy equal to the number of
other Vargs (of any type) in the same skirmish, up to a maximum of +4.

skills.name: Rage
text: When another Varg (of any type) in the same skirmish is defeated, the
Brutal Varg gains a cumulative +2 bonus to damage for 10 seconds (1
round).
The GM decides when a Varg is defeated (incapacitated or dead).

skills.name: Power Strike I
text: A Varg can deal an additional 4 damage on their next attack. However,
any Evasion Check made by them this turn receives a -2 penalty.

loot.item: Beautiful Mythical Beast Hide (800G/Gold Red A)
Silver-white Mythical Beast Hide (3,600G/Gold Red S)

description: It is one of the larger Vargs (see p. 176) and more ferocious than the regular Varg. Only a Barbarous with recognized strength will be allowed to ride on its back.

name: Ringing Rain Deer

skills.name: Special Spellsong /9(16)/All areas (50m Radius)
text: Uses spellsong [Nostalgia](see CR II, p. 193), [Lullaby]. Once this unique
skill is used, it cannot be used for the next 30 seconds (3 rounds). After
using either spellsong, 30 seconds (3 rounds) must elapse before the
subsequent use of either special spellsong.

skills.name: [Finale: Breath of the Meadows]/9(16)
text: In the "Range: 2(60m)," up to 3 characters heal their HP by "2d+7" points.
This effect does not work on undead, constructs, and magitech characters.
This unique skill cannot be used in consecutive turns. Also, once a
character has been affected, it cannot be affected for the following hour.

loot.item: Light Sounding Bell (200G/Gold Red Black A) x 1d
Clear Sounding Bell (2,680G/Gold Red Black S)

description: It is a mythical beast looking like a reindeer, with many nut-like bells with altered horns attached to various parts of the big horns. By shaking its head, the bells on the horns ring, creating spellsongs.
Cautious, they seldom appear in front of anyone except those they trust. When an intruder comes to their territory, they try to drive them away with spellsongs.
When acquired as loot, their bells may be used as materials for musical instruments, sacred treasures, ritual implements, etc.

name: Catoblepas

skills.name: Petrified Hoofs/12 (19)/Willpower/Neg
text: Catoblepas stares at 1 character with “Range/Area: 2(50m)/Target” and
“Area: Target”. On failed save target is petrified (Dexterity, Agility/-6) (see
This effect is treated as a curse type.
This unique skill can be used up to twice per round, but targets must be
different.

loot.item: Petrifying Hoofs (1,200G/Gold Red Black S) x 2

description: It is a mythical beast about 3 meters long with the head of a pig and the body of a buffalo. Its eyes are iridescent and shiny, and it petrifies people by looking at them, regardless of their intentions. It can sense its surroundings even while blinded, so it usually lives with its eyes closed.

Self-righteous and solitary, it regards anyone who approaches them as an enemy. Its skin has power that repels evil, and in rare cases, the effect remains even after death and can be sold for a high price.

name: Chimera
sectionsNote: Sections: 5 (Lion's Head / Goat's Head / Dragon's Head / Body / Wings) Main Section: Heads (All)

skills.name: Techniques
text: They may use the [Cat's Eyes], [Beetleskin], and [Recovery (5 points)]
Techniques.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Universal Metamagic], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Flame Breath/11(18)/Fortitude/Half
text: With "Range/Area: 2(50m)/Shot", it spits fire at "Target: 1 Character" and
deals 2d+10 fire magic damage.

skills.name: Cursed Poison/11(18)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Snake’s Bite attack hits and deals at least 1 point of applied damage,
the target's Accuracy check will be reduced by -2. This effect is not
cumulative.
This effect is treated as a curse type and is permanent. This effect can
also be removed with a spell such as the [Remove Curse], but it is
automatically removed if the Body section that bestowed the curse falls to
0 HP or less.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Chimera receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks. If Wings falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be used.

description: Chimera is fearsome in appearance, with the heads of a lion, goat, and dragon, the body of a snake used for a tail, and the wings of a massive bat on its back. Their origin is unclear, but it can only be assumed that a crazed wizard from the Magic Civilization period came up with this beast as part of some deranged experiment.

With multiple heads comes incredible intelligence, and Chimeras excel in cunning strategy. They are also ruthless and will offer hope to their opponents only to snatch it away at the last second. Chimeras also tend to have Undead and Constructs under their control and will have each head sleep at different times, making them formidable opponents to take advantage of. However, Chimeras tend to be overconfident, and it is said that this hubris may be their downfall.

name: Python
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Body / Tail) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Poison/12 (19)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Bite hits, it deals 8 poison magic damage to the target.

skills.name: Poison Spray/11(18)/Fortitude/Half
text: Within “Range/Area: 2(30m)/Shot" spits poison on "Target: 1 Character",
dealing 2d+9 poison magic damage.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Poisonous Fog/11(18)/Fortitude/Half
text: A poisonous mist is constantly emitted from the body.
At the end of this monster's turn, all the characters in the same position
(area, coordinate) as the Body section suffer 2d+6 poison magic damage.

skills.name: Tail Sweep
text: The monster can use its tail to attack up to 5 targets in the same skirmish.
An Accuracy check is made on all characters at once, and damage is
determined individually.
This attack cannot be used in consecutive rounds.

loot.item: Venom of the Woe Serpent (1,000G/Red S)

description: It is a poison snake, always spreading poison and noxious gases. Its total length is about 10 meters, but its thick body, covered with black and purple scales, makes it quite a presence.
They intensely hate Humanoid, Barbarous, and all other creatures with intelligence, and once they encounter one, they will never relent in their attacks until they have completely defeated it.

name: Cockatrice

skills.name: Continuous Attack II
text: If a monster successfully hits a target in melee, it may make a second
attack. It can make a third attack against the same target if a second attack
hits.

skills.name: Petrifying Beak/11 (18)/Willpower/Neg
text: If the Beak attack hits, the target becomes Petrified (Agility/-12) (see p.
This effect is the curse type.

skills.name: Techniques
text: They may use the [Beetleskin], [Meditation], and [Recovery (5 points)]
Techniques.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Cockatrice receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

description: Resembling a giant chicken with the legs and tail of a lizard, a Cockatrice is a dangerous beast, able to petrify anyone with its beak. Standing taller than most humanoids, Cockatrices are often hostile to anyone they perceive as threatening them or their nest. However, they absolutely hate Basilisks with every fiber of their being and will break off combat with others to attack one on sight.

name: Great Varg

skills.name: Rage
text: When another Varg (of any type) in the same skirmish is defeated, the
Brutal Varg gains a cumulative +2 bonus to damage for 10 seconds (1
round).
The GM decides when a Varg is defeated (incapacitated or dead).

skills.name: Final Reprimand
text: When its HP falls to 0 or below, it emits a cry that inspires and empowers
surrounding Vargs. All Vargs (of any type) within "Range: Caster" and
"Target: All areas (30m radius)/All" gain a +4 bonus to Accuracy checks
and +4 to Damage until the end of their next turn.
This effect is not cumulative.

skills.name: Power Strike II
text: A Great Varg can deal an additional +12 damage on their next attack.
However, any Evasion Check made by them this turn receives a -2 penalty.

loot.item: Beautiful Mythical Beast Hide (800G/Gold Red A)
Silver-white Mythical Beast Hide (3,600G/Gold Red S)

description: This is one of the strongest Vargs (see p. 176), reaching over 2.5 meters in height. If in a herd, they act as leaders. As a mutual recognition of strength, they often carry the Dark Trolls on their backs.

name: Draconet
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Body / Wing x 2) Main Section: Body

skills.name: Flame Breath/11 (18)/Fortitude/Half
text: Spits fire at "Target: 1 area(3m Radius)/5" within "Range/Area:
2(20m)/Shot" and deals 2d+15 fire magic damage.
This unique skill cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: All-Out Attack
text: A Wing can deal an additional 8 damage on its next attack. However, any
Evasion check made by this section this turn receives a -3 penalty.

skills.name: Flight II
text: A Draconet receives a +2 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If one of the Wings falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be
used.

description: “Draconet” is a name used for dragons 100 years or younger, and a Draconet's attitude reflects its immaturity. Often angry, they will destroy their environment until they either run out of energy or have leveled their surroundings. However, it is possible to communicate with a Draconet when they are in a good mood.

As with older dragons, Draconets tend to hoard things with a significant amount of stored mana, including magical items, Sword Shards, and even whole Swords of Protection. They loathe to give up any of their hoards but may be convinced if there are appropriate replacements for the items to be taken. While the most common Draconets breathe fire, there are subspecies that can also exhale ice, lightning, or poison.

name: Gurangatch
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Front / Back) Main Section: Front

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: It can make two Front Legs attacks each round, though each attack
requires its accuracy check. They may choose to attack different characters
with each attack.

skills.name: Fairy Magic 10 Level /Magic Power 12(19)
text: It can use water/ice, wind, light, and dark types.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting],
[Metamagic/Targets], and [Wordbreak].
[Multi-Action] can be declared when the monster uses [►Twin Strike &
Double Attack], and it can cast the spell after the second Accuracy check.
Monster instead can use [►Twin Strike & Double Attack] after it casts the
spell, but not after using [►Jaw Bite].

skills.name: Jaw Bite/13(20)/Danger Sense/Neg
text: It feints with its arms and attack by biting with its jaws.
Within "Range: Touch" deals with a “Target: 1 Character” 2d+25 physical
damage.
This unique skill cannot be used in consecutive turns. Once a character
becomes a target of this effect, they gain a +4 bonus on Danger Sense
checks to resist this effect until the end of combat.

skills.name: Furious Tail
text: In response to the threat to its own life, it becomes furious.
If the current HP of Front is less than 70 points, the Tail damage is
increased by +2 points; if it is less than 40 points, another +2 points (total
+4 points); if it is less than 15 points, another +4 points (total +8 points).

skills.name: All-Out Attack
text: A Tail can deal an additional 8 damage on its next attack. However, any
Evasion check made by this section this turn receives a -3 penalty as a risk.

description: It is a mythical beast inhabiting the sea and rivers, with the first half of its body as a crocodile and the second half as a fish.

It circulates in a large territory and attacks violently against those it perceives to be violating its territory. As a result, its territory is a place where there are few dangerous predators. Therefore, it is called the guardian of marine life by fishermen and others who live in the sea. However, they are rarely seen. In some areas, a folk song says, "They live hard and sleep at the bottom of the sea.”

name: Kujata
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Front / Back) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Fairy Magic 12 Level/Magic Power 15(22)
text: Can use earth, water/ice, wind, and light types.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Hawk Eye], [Universal Metamagic], [Rune Master], and
[Wordbreak].

skills.name: Limited Weather Control
text: Kujata can change the weather and temperature in a 10 km radius
centered on itself. The weather can be selected from clear skies to heavy
rain/heavy snow with 100 mm of rainfall per hour, cloud cover, and rainfall
(snowfall). Fog and haze can also be added. This effect works only in
mountainous areas and is also limited to the weather-temperatures that can
occur in that location and season.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • +4
text: Kujata size hinders attack.
The Head cannot be attacked in melee. Against any ranged attacks, Head
receives a +4 bonus to Evasion checks.
If the HP of either the Front or Back falls to 0 or lower, this unique skill
changes to [○Attack Obstacle = +4 • None (only +4 bonus to Head’s
Evasion against melee attack)]. And if both HPs fall to 0 or lower, the
unique skill is completely lost.

description: It is a mythical beast in the form of a huge hairy buffalo that emits blue phosphorescent light. It has two humps on its back, which crystallize over time and are known to yield high-quality garnets and rubies.
Legend has it that they are the embodiment of the will of the mountain itself and that they have the power to control the climate of the mountain where they live, albeit to a limited extent.
In many mountains, they are revered as mountain saints, and Kujata himself behaves as such. Although strict in nature, Kujata is basically mild- mannered.
Because of the constant approach of back gem hunters, Kujata’s reaction to Humanoids, Barbarous, and some Mythical Beasts tends to be one of wariness and caution.

name: Lesser Dragon
sectionsNote: Sections: 4 (Head / Body / Wing x 2) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Truespeech Magic, Spiritualism Magic 10 Level/Magic Power 14(21)
Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Universal Metamagic], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Flame Breath/15(22)/Fortitude/Half
text: With "Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot", spits fire at "Target: 1 area (6m
Radius)/20", dealing 2d+20 fire magic damage.
This unique skill cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Techniques
text: They may use the [Strong Blood], [Beetleskin], and [Recovery (7 points)]
Techniques.

skills.name: Tail Sweep
text: The monster can use its tail to attack up to 5 targets in the same skirmish.
An Accuracy check is made on all characters at once, and damage is
determined individually.
This attack cannot be used in consecutive rounds.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • None
text: The Lesser Dragon size hinders attack.
The Head cannot be attacked with Melee Attacks. When the Body falls
to 0 HP or lower, this effect disappears.

skills.name: All-Out Attack
text: A Wing can deal an additional 8 damage on its next attack. However, any
Evasion check made by this section this turn receives a -3 penalty as a risk.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Lesser Dragon receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for
melee attacks. If any Wings fall to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot
be used.

description: A young dragon, less than 500 years, yet older than a Draconet. Even though it is relatively young for a Dragon, Lesser Dragons tend to be around 10m long, so any sort of melee attack on the head is nigh impossible.

Able to spit flames and cast spells while flying over the skirmish, a Lesser Dragon's offensive power is second to none. Because of this, Lesser Dragons tend to be very self-centered and overconfident, looking down on others they consider “lesser creatures.” Lesser Dragons look to hoard treasure and valuables, just like any other dragon.

Any brave adventurer (or adventuring party) that can kill a Lesser Dragon will not only earn the title “Dragon Slayer” but will have access to the vast hoard that the dragon had acquired. Additionally, very rarely do dragons have Dragon Eggs inside their bodies, which are incredibly valued on their own due to their use in several magical experiments.

name: Sphinx
sectionsNote: Sections: 4 (Head / Body / Wing x 2) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Mana Resistance
text: Reduce all Magic Damage Sphinx receive by -5.

skills.name: Knowledge Incarnate & Weakness Exploit
text: Sphinx can make Sage Knowledge checks with a standard value of 20. In
this case, it knows combat feat [Sage's Wisdom].
Sphinx deals double damage to other monster weak points it detected.

skills.name: Magic (All Systems) 13 Level/Magic Power 19 (26)
text: It mastered all magic system at 13levels.
For Fairy Magic, it can use all types of magic up to rank 13.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: The Sphinx can use all Combat Feats that are "Use: Wizard-Type Classes"
and [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Hawk Eye], [Metamagic Master],
[Marionette], [Mana Save], [MP Save/All Wizard-Type Classes], and
[Wordbreak].

skills.name: Riddle/20 (27)/Adventurer Level + Intelligence Modifier/Neg
text: The Sphinx can ask “Target: 1 Entire Character” within “Range/Area:
2(100m)/Target” a riddle. This Riddle cannot be prevented even if the
target is deaf or dumb. On fail, the target cannot move or perform Major
Actions or Minor Actions for 30 seconds (3 rounds). This effect is of curse
+ psychic type.
This unique skill can be used only once per round.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Against any melee attacks, Body sections receive a +4 bonus to Evasion
checks.
This effect disappears when the Body section falls to 0 HP or lower.

skills.name: Flight
text: All sections receive a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If any of the Wings fall to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be used.

description: The Sphinx is a mythical beast about 5m tall, with the body of a lion, the wings of an eagle, and the face of a beautiful human woman. Highly intelligent and powerful wizards in their own right, Sphinxes can speak any language and cast the most known magic spells, regardless of Class. Sphinxes are often seen serving as gatekeepers for ancient magicians, welcoming those who can answer their riddles as friends of the magician. However, failing to come up with the correct response will lead to a dire fate.

name: Greater Dragon
sectionsNote: Sections: 5 (Head / Body / Wing x 2 / Tail) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Truespeech Magic, Spiritualism Magic 15 Level/Magic Power 20 (27)
Magic Aptitude
text: The Greater Dragon can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action],
[Targeting], [Magic Convergence], [Magic Control], [Universal
Metamagic], and [Rune Master].

skills.name: Flame and Brilliant Breath/22 (29)/ Fortitude/Half
text: Within "Range/Area: 2(50m)/Shot", spits out breath to "Target: 1 area (6m
Radius)/20" and deals magic damage to the target. In this case, the monster
can arbitrarily choose one of the following two types, which differ in
damage and type.
Flame Breath: Spits out the fire, dealing 2d+30 fire type.
Brilliant Breath: Spits out an energy mass, 2d+24 energy type.
This ability cannot be used in consecutive turns (whichever breath is used,
neither breath can be used in the next turn).

skills.name: 2 Actions
text: Can perform two Major Actions in one round.

skills.name: Wordbreak
text: Greater Dragon uses [Wordbreak] combat feat using Head’s Magic
Power.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • None
text: The Greater Dragon's size hinders attacks.
The Head of the Greater Dragon cannot be attacked with melee attacks.
This unique skill is lost when the Body section has 0 or less HP.

skills.name: Flight II
text: All sections receive a +2 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If one of the Wings falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be
used.

skills.name: All-Out Attack
text: A Wing can deal an additional 8 damage on its next attack. However, any
Evasion check made by this section this turn receives a -3 penalty.

skills.name: Tail Sweep
text: The monster can use its tail to attack up to 5 targets in the same skirmish.
An Accuracy check is made on all characters at once, and damage is
determined individually.
This attack cannot be used in consecutive rounds.

description: It is a mature dragon, about 2,000 years old. Its total length is nearly 20 meters, and its strength rivals that of the armies of great nations. For this reason, most people think of them more like a natural disaster than an enemy to be defeated.
They are sensitive and will not tolerate any interference. They will direct all of their dragon clan to destroy unwanted intruders if they come to their territory uninvited.
They are also well known in history and magic but often cannot remember the details of incredibly old matters and may add fictional details to fill those gaps.

name: Elder Dragon
sectionsNote: Sections: 5 (Head / Body / Wing x 2 / Tail) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Truespeech Magic, Spiritualism Magic 15 Level/Magic Power 28 (35)
Magic Aptitude & Breath Aptitude
text: The Elder Dragon can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting],
[Magic Convergence], [Magic Control], [Universal Metamagic], and [Rune
Master].
When declaring [Multi-Action], it can select not only the combination of
"Melee Attack and Spell Cast" but also the combination of "Melee Attack,
[►Flame and Brilliant Breath], or "Spell Cast and [►Flame and Brilliant
Breath]" with one Major Action.

skills.name: Flame and Brilliant Breath/28 (35)/ Fortitude/Half
text: Within "Range/Area: 2(50m)/Shot", spits out breath to "Target: 1 area(6m
Radius)/20" and deals magic damage to the target. In this case, the monster
can arbitrarily choose one of the following two types, which differ in
damage and type.
Flame Breath: Spits out the fire, dealing 2d+40 fire type.
Brilliant Breath: Spits out an energy mass, 2d+30 energy type.
This ability cannot be used in consecutive turns (whichever breath is used,
neither breath can be used in the next turn).

skills.name: Wordbreak
text: Elder Dragon uses [Wordbreak] combat feat using Head’s Magic Power.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • None, Magic Obstacle = -4
text: The Elder Dragon's huge body poking through the clouds hinders the
attack.
The Head of the Greater Dragon cannot be engaged in melee combat.
And if a character casts a spell targeting the Head section or other character
in the same section caster gains a -4 penalty on the Spellcasting check.
This unique skill is lost when the Body section has 0 or less HP.

skills.name: Flight II
text: All sections receive a +2 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If one of the Wings falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be
used.

skills.name: All-Out Attack
text: A Wing can deal an additional 8 damage on its next attack. However, any
Evasion check made by this section this turn receives a -3 penalty.

skills.name: Sweeping Attack
text: Elder Dragon makes a Tail attack against all enemies in the same
skirmish.
This unique skill cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Improved Aimed Attack
text: When attacking, the Elder Dragon can gain a +4 bonus to Accuracy but
receives a -8 penalty for damage dealt.
This cannot be declared when performing an [►Sweeping Attack].

description: It is a legendary dragon. Its age ranges from several thousand to tens of thousands of years old, and although it is still alive, its references can be found in histories and myths of ages past. It is more like a divine being than a mythical beast, and is comparable to a Minor God, as they can be worshiped in some areas.
If anyone has ever managed to defeat it, this deed will be passed down from generation to generation.
There are some common abilities and characteristics among the Fairies.
There are two kinds of Fairies, the ordinary Fairies, and the Olden Fairies, and there are some differences between them.
Common Abilities of All Fairies ◯Invisible Against Runefolk
Runefolk cannot see fairies. This unique skill is omitted from the individual data. ◯No Loot
Fairy does not leave any loot, and the loot field is omitted from their data.
Common Abilities of Normal Fairies ◯Type: **/Magic Power X(Y)
Monster data with this unique skill indicates this is a normal fairy.

Every normal fairy has one of the following types: earth, water/ice, fire, wind, light, or dark. Then, they can use Fairy Magic of that type up to the rank of their monster level. They cannot use any other type of magic or basic Fairy Magic. Fairy does not receive any damage or disadvantage by the effect of its type. Fairies of the dark type have Psychic Immunity. Light type fairies don’t have any immunities. ◯Knowledge = Fairy Tamers

Characters with the Fairy Tamer class automatically succeed in the Monster Knowledge check against fairies without rolling any dice (learning the Sage class and the original success value are required to know the weak point). This unique skill is omitted from the individual data.
Common Abilities of Olden Fairies ◯Olden/Type: A & B/Magic Power X(Y)
Monster data with this unique skill indicates this is an olden fairy.
An olden fairy has multiple types, and can cast Fairy Magic of each type up to its own level. It cannot use Basic Fairy Magic.
It also has both immunities caused by each type.
In order to summon an olden fairy with [Summon Fairy] magic, the Fairy Tamer must have all its types selected. Fairy Tamer Cannot Automatically Identify
Even if a character has the Fairy Tamer class, a Monster Knowledge check is required to know the abilities and data of the olden fairy.

name: Bannik

skills.name: Water Body
text: Blunt weapons treat the Bannik's Defense as 3 points higher.

skills.name: Fire Vulnerability
text: When Bannik is hit by Fire-type damage, it takes an extra 3 damage.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: A Bannik can use the Combat Feat [Metamagic/Distance].

skills.name: Healing Hot Spring
text: The Bannik can change water into a hot spring at the optimal temperature
for bathing at a rate of 2 MP per 50 liters of water to be changed.
Soaking in the waters for an hour will recover 5 HP and MP, but staying
longer than an hour will not recover any more.

description: A spirit that takes the appearance of a nude woman, Banniks are subservient fairies found around hot springs and other naturally occurring warm water. They only wish to see cleanliness and may even offer to create a hot spring in order to help travelers wash away dirt and grime. However, Banniks are known to become irrationally angry if someone dirty refuses to head to a hot spring and will lash out in anger.

name: Will-o'-Wisp

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feat [Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Light Protection
text: A Will-o'-Wisp takes -3 less magic damage, regardless of type.

skills.name: Healing Space
text: 1 area (3m Radius) around this monster is surrounded by gentle healing
light. The character within this space gains an additional 2 HP when being
healed.

description: Will-o'-Wisp is a spherical fairy about 10cm in diameter that emits a misty light. It is weak, but it often surrounds other fairies and fairy tamers as if to protect them. They are usually harmless and rarely fight other than in self- defense.

name: Ainsel

skills.name: Fire Dance/5(12)/Willpower/Half
text: Within "Range: Touch" wraps the "Target: 1 Character" in fire dust,
dealing 2d+2 fire magic damage. In addition, the target takes a -2 penalty
to Evasion checks for 10 seconds (1 round).

description: These fairies take the shape of beautiful girls, with a part of their hair resembling a flame. They live in groups of three to five near sources of fire. They are curious and fond of people, and will be friendly towards anyone who treats them kindly. However, they will never forgive those who are hostile or betray them, and will try to burn them with fire.

name: Swarm of Muryans

skills.name: Wind Vulnerability
text: When the Swarm of Muryans is hit by Wind-type damage, it takes an
extra 3 damage.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: A Swarm of Muryans can use the Combat Feat [Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Swarm
text: A Swarm of Muryans is immune to criticals.
In addition, Throw or similar attacks deal no damage and have no effect.
The maximum applied damage from magic with "Area: Target" and
"Target: 1 Character" is limited to 1 point.
If this monster is in melee, the combat feat [Targeting] or [Magic Control]
loses its effect when it targets or includes a character or a melee area (the
center point in Standard Combat) in the skirmish where it exists.

skills.name: Swarming Attack/Can't
text: Countless Muryans crawl up and bite. The Swarm of Muryans deals “2d
+ 1/5th of remaining HP (rounded down)” of physical damage to "Target:
1 Character" within "Range: Touch."

skills.name: [Finale: Summer Vitality]/5(12)
text: With "Range: 2(30m)", [Finale: Summer Vitality] is used to heal HP of
"Target: 1 Character" by 2d+3 points. This effect does not work on undead,
constructs and magitech characters.
This ability cannot be used in consecutive turns. Once a character is
affected, it cannot be healed again by this monster.

description: What appears to be an ant at first is really an exceedingly small earth fairy, dressed in a dark hat and coat. Muryans are tiny fairies that travel in swarms and will typically be seen as a part of a large group, rather than individually. Because of their small size, they tend to avoid conflict when possible and are rather easygoing. If a group of Muryans sees someone who's not having a good time, they will try and put on a little song and dance to bring some cheer.

name: Vila

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: Vila can use the Combat Feats [Targeting] and [Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Inviting Dance/7 (14)/Willpower/Neg
text: This effect is of the psychic type and lasts for 3 minutes (18 rounds).
Within "Range/Area: 1(10m)/Target", Vila shows a dance to "Target: 1
Entire Character". If that character fails to Willpower, the character will
perform the same movement and actions on their turn that they saw Vila
do immediately prior to turn before this unique skill was used.
For example, if the character sees Vila make a melee attack, the character
will attempt to execute a Fist (Punch) attack on the target of Vila's attack.
In this case, Accuracy checks and damage decisions are made with the
character's stats. If a character is seen Vila using Fairy Magic, the character
should cast the same Fairy Magic spell (with the same target, etc.) using the
character’s Magic Power. If the character cannot cast this Fairy Magic spell,
they only imitate vocalization and just waste Major Action on this attempt
to cast.
When a character with multiple sections is affected by this effect, any one
of the sections mimics Vila's action. The other sections do not act (except
for movement).

description: Vila is a fairy in the form of a human-sized girl who appears near water sources.
Some say that Vilas's beautiful figure and voice lure men through dance to become their lovers, while others fear that those captivated by her dance will be lured into the water and drowned.

name: Echo

skills.name: Flight
text: An Echo only receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: Echo can use the Combat Feats [Targeting] and [Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Echo
text: Echo should be in the same position where they ended her previous
round to use this ability. Also, it cannot be used in a round in which Echo
moved with Normal Move or Full Move.
Echo reproduces only one "Spell with Chant", "Spellsong", "Finale", or any
other unique skill that uses sound or voice that was cast from the end of
the previous Echo's turn to the beginning of Echo’s current turn. The
original user's values and abilities are retained in reproducing the effect,
and the rolls and range (area) are also the same. However, the specific
target of the effect is redefined arbitrarily by this monster (as if it had used
it).
When using this ability, Echo consumes "Level (adventurer level, monster
level) x 2" points of HP and MP of the original effect (no MP consumption
is required for the original user at this Echo reuse). Also, regardless of the
type of the original effect, the use of this ability is a Major Action.

description: She is a wind fairy who lives in a mountainous area and takes the form of a small girl. She is shy and does not show herself often, but if you call her, she is sure to return your call.
She is good at imitating voices and has the ability to reproduce exact sounds and voices.

name: Shade

skills.name: Flight
text: A Shade only receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feat [Universal Metamagic].

skills.name: Dark Mind/8 (15)/Willpower/Neg
text: The Shade attempts to wrap the minds within “Range: Caster” and
“Target: All Areas (30 Radius)” in shadow, preventing them from taking
any deliberate action. Those who fail to resist cannot move or perform
Minor or Major Actions for 30 seconds (3 rounds).
This effect is treated as a psychic type.

description: Dark fairies standing around 30cm tall, Shades are cloaked entirely in darkness. However, if one could see through and see the actual appearance of a Shade, they appear to be tall, almost gaunt fairies wearing well-made clothing created entirely out of temporary darkness. Shades rarely occur in areas with a high population, preferring more rural areas.

name: Sprite

skills.name: Light Protection
text: A Sprite takes 5 less damage from all Magic effects, regardless of type.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Sprite receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feat [Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Flash/8 (15)/Fortitude/Neg
text: The Sprite unleashes a bright flash of light within “Range: Caster” and
“Target: All Areas (30 Radius)/All”. Those who fail to resist will receive a
-2 penalty to all Accuracy and Evasion checks for 30 seconds (3 rounds).
This effect is not cumulative.
This unique skill can be used only once per round.

description: Fairies of light, Sprites are similar to Shades in size and stature, only around 30cm tall and glowing with a bright light. Their actual appearance is that of a slim blonde woman dressed in a robe of white light, though the light given off by the robe is enough to obscure this view. To restore one's vitality, having the aid of a Sprite is quite crucial for Fairy Tamers. However, Sprites are incredibly shy and rare in public areas.

name: Menehune

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting],
[Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Exclusive Spell [Mud Spot]
text: Casts exclusive Fairy Magic [Mud Spot].

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +6 points.

description: Menehune is a fairy who is about half the height of a human but has a muscular and strong body. They are good-hearted fairy who likes to help others and is good at civil engineering work.

Although they do not often appear in public, if you find them, it is said that if you wish for construction work while offering their favorite food, shrimp, as an offering, they will fulfill your wish during the night.

name: Undine

skills.name: Water Body
text: Blunt weapons treat the Undine's Defense as 3 points higher.

skills.name: Fire Vulnerability
text: When Undine is hit by Fire-type damage, it takes an extra 3 damage.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Metamagic/Targets], [MP Save/Fairy
Tamer].

skills.name: Water Gun/9(16)/Fortitude/Half
text: With "Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot", the monster sprays water jet from both
palms at "Target: 1 Character", dealing 2d+6 water/ice magic damage and
making it fall prone.

description: Water fairies that have become stronger with time and mana, Undines appear as beautiful humanoid women (often humans and elves). Often seen in larger bodies of water, they have also been sighted in rivers and are very curious about travelers on the water. However, their curiosity may occasionally be dangerous, as Undines tend not to know that other races can drown in water.

They dislike ugly people on the water and try to deliberately sink their vessels, so they can't be seen on the water. However, an even more hated enemy is those who would pollute water sources. These people, the Undines, actively and aggressively try to drown to protect themselves and their habitat.

name: Cait Sith

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: Echo can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Hawk Eye], and [Universal
Metamagic].

skills.name: Service/11(18)
text: The skill allows entertaining guests. Cait Sith can use this success value
11(18) for non-combat Dexterity or Intelligence-based skill checks.

description: Cait Sith is an olden fairy. It is an upright, cute cat-like creature, about one meter long. They like to help anyone in need. They can easily learn languages, and once they hear a language, they can use it within a short period of time.

name: Salamander

skills.name: Water/Ice Vulnerability
text: When the Salamander is hit by Water/Ice-type damage, it takes an extra
3 damage.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feat [Universal Metamagic].

skills.name: Flame Breath/8(15)/Fortitude /Half
text: With "Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot", spits fire at "Target: 1 Character",
dealing 2d+9 fire magic damage.

description: Salamanders are 2m long lizard-like fairies drawn to flames and fire and tend to live in areas with higher temperatures than usual. Because of this tendency, they're driven to burn everything around them, and there's often charcoal strewn about their lairs. However, despite being drawn to fire, Salamanders aren't aggressive, though they are still dangerous when not threatened.

name: Sylph

skills.name: Wind Body
text: Edged weapons treat Sylph's Defense as 3 points higher.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Sylph receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Earth Vulnerability
text: When the Sylph is hit by Earth-type damage, it takes an extra 3 damage.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting] and [Metamagic/Distance].

skills.name: Gale Breath/9(16)/Fortitude/Half
text: With "Range/Area: 2(30m)/Shot”, breathes a mass of compressed air to
"Target: 1 area (3m Radius)/5", dealing 2d+6 wind magic damage.

description: Whimsical wind fairies Sylphs appear to travelers as half-transparent humanoids, often choosing to appear as either humans or elves. They are not malicious, but sometimes their pranks may be dangerous, such as flying around a mountaineer trying to climb. Sylphs prefer to fly freely wherever they want, though occasionally, some will follow a group of travelers that appreciate their pranks.

name: Gnome

skills.name: Wind Vulnerability
text: When the Gnome is hit by Wind-type damage, it takes an extra 3
damage.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Metamagic/Targets] and [MP Save/Fairy
Tamer].

skills.name: Quake/10 (17)/Fortitude/Neg
text: Within “Range: Caster" can cause a localized earthquake and makes
"Target: all areas (30m radius)/All" fall prone down. Targets cannot get up
for 1 minute(6 rounds).
Characters not touching the ground are immune to this unique skill.

description: An earthen fairy, Gnomes are tiny in stature, typically appearing as 1m tall bearded older men. However, there are also female and child Gnomes, though they do not usually appear outside Gnome settlements. The older male Gnomes will fight fiercely to protect these other Gnomes. Because of this, Gnomes have a reputation for valuing strength in the face of adversity and watching friends and family.

name: Cu Sith

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feat [Multi-Action] and [Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Terror Roar/12(19)/Willpower/Neg
text: It roars in “Range: Caster.” A character who is within “Target: All Areas
(20m Radius)/All” a 20-meter radius and fails to Willpower suffers a -2
penalty to all checks for 3 minutes (18 rounds). This effect is of psychic
type.
This ability can only be used once per round, for a total of three times
per day.

description: Cu Sith are fairies in the form of large dogs, covered with long green fur, and are said to act as guard dogs for the fairies, often appearing with other fairies or guarding the entrances to their hiding places.
Because of this role, they are very paranoid about visitors. When they perceive you as an enemy, they will attack you mercilessly.

name: Dryad

skills.name: Fire Vulnerability
text: When Dryad is hit by Fire-type damage, it takes an extra 3 damage.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Universal Metamagic] and [MP
Save/Fairy Tamer].

skills.name: Mesmerize/12 (19)/Willpower/Neg
text: With "Range/Area: 30m/Target", it whispers sweet words to "Target: 1
Character" and mesmerizes it. This effect only works if the target is a male
character, and the target thinks Dryad is his beloved lover and acts to
protect her.
The character in this state considers any attack on Dryad to be an offense
and tries to defeat these offenders with all his might. This effect is of psychic
type and lasts only while the character is within "Range: 2(30m)" from
Dryad.

skills.name: Tree Assimilation
text: The Dryad can step into a chosen tree within touch distance and hide
inside, becoming invulnerable to attacks. In this state dryad, she will also
be unable to use melee attacks or [►Mesmerize] on new targets (although
she still can cast spells and maintain the effect of [►Mesmerize]).
Burning a tree where a Dryad is hiding will force the Dryad out.
Otherwise, exiting a tree is also a Major Action.

description: These tree fairies take the shape of a beautiful yet mysterious woman with long, flowing green hair wrapped around her limbs. Often appearing nude, Dryads are known to be man-charmers and will have a pile of bodies at the base of their tree. These corpses of men they had mesmerized, providing fertilizer in death as they did protection in life. There are stories of men who have escaped the clutches of a Dryad by threatening to cut their tree down.

name: Puck

skills.name: Wind Body
text: Edged weapons treat Sylph's Defense as 3 points higher.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Puck only receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Earth Vulnerability
text: When the Sylph is hit by Earth-type damage, it takes an extra 3 damage.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feat [Universal Metamagic].

skills.name: Distant Voice
text: The range of the Puck's spells is doubled. When using
[Metamagic/Distance], this unique skill doubles the spell's range before the
Combat Feat is applied.
In Simplified Combat, magic with "Range: 1" becomes "Range: 2".

skills.name: Windfall
text: The wind carries Puck. At the beginning of its turn, it moves the Normal
Move distance (up to the adjacent area in Simplified Combat and up to
33m in Standard Combat). After that, Puck can still move and use actions.
This does not count as their movement for the turn, so if the Puck takes a
Limited Move, they may still cast a spell on that turn.
This unique skill cannot be used in consecutive turns.

description: A Puck is a tree spirit that looks like a small boy dressed in green clothes and a hat. Often seen flying around, they are happy fairies who love music and will often sing or whistle along to a tune they enjoy. Pucks are often talkative to the performers and generally friendly, but they are also quite mischievous and will prank mountain climbers just as quickly.

name: Frau

skills.name: Ice Body
text: If Frau takes damage from a blunt weapon, it is treated as if Frau had
additional 5 points of Defense.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Frau receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Fire Vulnerability
text: When Frau is hit by Fire-type damage, it takes an extra 3 damage.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feat [Universal Metamagic].

skills.name: Cold Storm/10(17)/Fortitude/Half
text: Frau creates a cold storm within “Range: Caster.” Within "Target: 1 area
(6m Radius)/20", they deal 2d+8 water/ice magic damage. A target that fails
resistance is frozen for 30 seconds (3 rounds) and suffers a -2 penalty to
Accuracy and Evasion checks. This penalty is not cumulative. This unique
skill cannot be used on consecutive turns.

description: Frau is an ice fairy in the form of a woman. It has pure white hair and a half-transparent body. It is said to seduce men who climb snowy mountains and freeze them to death, but it is also said to help travelers in distress in some regions.

name: Caron

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], and [Universal Metamagic].

skills.name: Wave of Hatred/15(22)/Willpower/Neg
text: Within "Range: Caster" and "Target: 1 area (6m Radius)/All” causes
hatred to grow in targets' hearts.
The target cannot cast spells and other unique skills that target other than
themself for 30 seconds (3 rounds), except those that directly deal damage.
Anything that causes some effect simultaneously as the damage is allowed,
along with any collateral effects.
This effect is of the psychic type.

description: They are a fairy that looks like a translucent adult male with a solid physique. They have long hair and a long beard and wear only a loincloth around their body. They can speak, but they only swear intrinsically, making communicating difficult.

name: Domovoy

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Hawk Eye], [Universal Metamagic].

skills.name: Exclusive Spell [Ash Burn]
text: Casts exclusive Fairy Magic [Ash Burn].

skills.name: House Guardian
text: Only Domovoy, that has taken up residence in a house, has this ability.
Those that have been moved or summoned from outside do not have this
ability.
The Domovoy lives in a house and guards it. The scope of the house
here is defined by the GM but is broad enough to include the entirety of
the housing complex; if it is an underground labyrinth, then the entire
labyrinth, unless there are obvious structural changes.
Domovoy has a Five Senses perception of everything within the scope of
this house. As long as it is within the range of the house, Domovoy can
manipulate the furnishings and equipment at will, as long as it does not
cause direct damage to the character. Doors open (or close) on their own,
candlesticks are suddenly lit, a table is inscribed with a puzzling message or
any number of other strange incidents can be triggered. It can also make
only its own voice heard from nowhere.
The following [►Furniture Projectile] unique skill can be used only
within the house.

skills.name: Furniture Projectile/Various/Evasion/Neg
text: The target must be a place or condition where the [○House Guardian] is
active. Conversely, Domovoy itself can choose the target of this unique skill
wherever it is located, as long as it is within the range of the ability of the
[◯House Guardian] (so anyone within the house).
Domovoy throws a piece of furniture at the 1 target character and deals
physical damage. If the furniture is attached to a wall or floor, it cannot be
thrown, but if it is attached to metal fixtures, it can be thrown. The distance
from the furniture to the target must be in the line of fire, and the Accuracy
check and the physical damage of the hit will vary depending on the
furniture.
Furniture Range from Furniture Accuracy Damage
About the size of a large chest 5m※ 11(18) 2d+16
Furniture about 1m cube 10m 12(19) 2d+12
Small items about 30 cm cube 20m 13(20) 2d+8
※ This is for Standard Combat, Advanced Combat. For Simplified
Combat it will be "Range: Touch".

skills.name: Leaving House
text: This effect may only occur while [◯House Guardian] is active.
In many cases, the Domovoy, the "guardian of the house," also protects
its inhabitants and considers them as targets for its own protection. In such
cases, when all the inhabitants are gone permanently (including death, of
course) or when the inhabitants have committed a severe betrayal of
Domovoy, Domovoy, in his grief or anger, may start a fire in the "house,"
he is guarding and bury it.
If there is a creature inside when a fire is started, Domovoy tries to lead
it out by making full use of the ability of [◯House Guardian]. As long as
the creature follows the guidance, it can escape safely without any damage,
but if they ignore the guidance, it will be engulfed in fire and must take 2d
points of fire magic damage every 10 seconds (1 round).

description: Domovoy is a fairy of gentle disposition and has the appearance of an old man covered in thick body hair, including a long gray beard.
They hide in fireplaces and basements, secretly protecting the house and its inhabitants.

It is said that if a Domovoy loses the inhabitant it is supposed to protect or it was betrayed by them, it will start a fire. However, it does not always happen, and whether or not it does depends strongly on the character and feelings of the individual Domovoy. In this sense, it can be said that the probability of it occurring is higher when a long-time resident disappears or when it is betrayed.

On rare occasions, a Domovoy may be found alone in abandoned houses, having lost the inhabitant he was supposed to protect. It is said that if you guide them to their new home and its inhabitants with a lit firewood or torch, you will receive their deepest gratitude.

description: Fylgja is a fairy in the form of a young girl just before coming of age. She wears light armor, and her entire body is enveloped in a pale light. Although she has no wings, she can fly freely in the sky and has been seen dancing in the wind.
They prefer strong humanoids (regardless of gender). When they find one they like, they become their guardian fighting for them.
The problem is that these women are thoughtless and prefer to settle everything by force. When this happens on battlefield, the worst-case scenario is that they immediately turn on the enemy.

it wants to change into, but the specific appearance afterward is fixed for

women.
This ability can only be used once daily and lasts up to 1 day. Peri can

description: Peri has a beautiful female figure, a fire fairy who lives in the secluded regions and high mountains where humanoids and barbarous are not likely to visit.
The large joints of its arms and legs and other parts of its body are covered with orange-colored fire making it dangerous-looking to approach.

Basically, Peri prefers solitude. They are usually cold to visitors to their habitat, or they hide and try not to get involved. However, she may develop a romantic interest in a humanoid male on rare occasions.

In such a case, the Peri will secretly pursue the man, disguise her appearance as that of the opposite race, and seduce him. She then takes him back to her place of residence, never to rerelease him to live with him.

They are the guardians of the realm of the fairies and warn those who approach them with a loud and awe-inspiring voice. They wield a single- armed weapon, a club, a flail, or an axe without mercy if not heeded.

She is tolerant of all living beings and grants them the benefits of Fairy Magic as much as they desire. However, she is strict against those who harm nature or seek senseless death. After warning them by making her whole body glow strongly, she tries to get rid of them.

Some humanoids and barbarous worship Muspell as if it were a Minor God.

During 3 minutes (18 rounds), the target forgets the actions that they are
casually performing. The target must roll 1d to perform Minor Action
during the effect duration. If the roll is "1-3", the target cannot perform the
action because they cannot remember the procedure, which should be
easy. A Minor Action that fails in this effect may not be tried again during
its turn. Casting spells with Minor Actions and the use of Techniques are
considered different Minor Actions if they have different names. If an
Evocation fails once, another Evocation cannot be used in the same turn.
This effect is a "Curse + Psychic" type.
Using this unique skill consumes 10 MP.

skills.name: Disruption of Consciousness/16(23)/Willpower/Neg
text: This unique skill can only be attempted with the target under the
[►Oblivion] effect. When the effect of this ability occurs, [►Oblivion]
ends.
The "Range: 1(10m)" stares at the "Target: 1 Entire Character" and
disrupts concentration.
During the duration of the effect, the target may be momentarily
unconscious. The target must roll 1d at the beginning of each turn. If the
roll is "1-2", the target cannot move or operate at all during the turn.
This effect is a "Curse + Psychic" type.
Using this unique skill consumes 15 MP.

skills.name: Amnesia/16(23)/Willpower/Neg
text: This unique skill can only be attempted with the target under
[►Disruption of Consciousness] effect. When the effect of this ability

Lethe stares at "Target: 1 Entire Character" with "Range: 1(10m)" and
make it lose its memory.
The target immediately loses all their memories and falls comatose. The
comatose state lasts for 1 hour, after which the target awakens
spontaneously but does not regain their memories.
The comatose state is a psychic type and can be awakened by the
[Awaken] spell. No need to compare the different values.
On the other hand, the memory loss effect is permanent of the "curse
+psychic" type. To cancel it, a comparison of difference values is required.
Using this unique skill consumes 20 MP.

description: Lethe is a woman with long, wet, and supple hair that is rumored to exist. She is said to always have a sad expression on her face and to take away the memories of those she likes in order to make them her attendants.

She is called the Mother of Fairies and guards the secluded regions where they live.

When such a gifted man dies, the Skadi will take the corpse away, and it is said that the body is stored in the Skadi's ice palace deep within the snowy mountains.

However, they are quite temperamental and can run down from a mountain past a village in a rage. The wind they create in these situations can easily destroy the village with little effort.
