This effect is not cumulative and is of the poison type.

description: Imps are small hairless daemons with brown skin, bat-like wings, and a tail pointed like a spear. Often used as messengers for the Daemons, Imps are typically sent to help others who may do the work of the Daemons. As such, seeing an Imp nearby may mean stronger Daemons are not far off.

name: Erbirea

skills.name: Mana-inhibiting Poison/4(11)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the claw attack hits, the target's Magic Power is reduced by -1 for 10
seconds (1 round). This effect is poison-type.

description: This is a shrimp-faced daemon, spotted in and around Shallow Abysses, about the size of a Human child, with thick, short limbs and dull indigo skin.
Although not much of a threat on their own, they can appear in large numbers at once, and often the Adventurers' Guild is asked to exterminate these monsters.

name: Nuzumal

skills.name: Greenblood Curse/4(11)/Willpower/Half
text: Nuzumal with a “Range: Touch” deals 2d+2 curse magic damage to
“Target: 1 Character”. Using this ability consumes 4 points of its HP and
MP each.

description: Nuzumal is a small daemon, about 1.2 meters tall. Its green skin resembles that of amphibians, and its head is also reminiscent of a frog, with large protruding eyes and a wide, side-slit mouth.
The green blood they shed has cursed power that burns the skin of those it touches.
It is said that they like humidity, lives in swamps and other places, and attack in groups, dragging their poor victims with them.

name: Aetherbeast
description: Beasts from another world, Aetherbeasts are loyal to and follow around other daemons. Often taking the appearance of a much larger wolf, they will savagely bite any who threaten them. While the stats given are for this particular form, GMs may also use other stats to represent other Aetherbeast forms.

name: Abyss Minions
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Right / Left) Main Section: None

skills.name: Flight
text: Abyss Minions receive a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for
melee attacks.

skills.name: Twin Daemons
text: At first glance, the Right and Left sections are indistinguishable. If the
character performs a melee attack, a ranged attack, or a "Target: 1
Character" spell or effect on one of these sections, roll 1d. If the result is 1-
2, the opposite section, which is different from the targeted section, will be
affected. If both sections are targeted at the same time, this effect does not
occur.
This ability is lost when the HP of either Right or Left sections falls to 1
or less.

skills.name: Cross Strike/7(14)/Evasion/Neg
text: It attacks with melee attack 1 character simultaneously dealing 2d+10
physical damage.
This ability cannot be used when Major Action has been completed for
either Right or Left section. Also, if it uses this ability, the Major Action of
both sections will be completed.

description: Daemon's spires are seen flying around in the sky, mainly in Shallow Abyss.

They look like two small, winged child-like Daemons connected by their long intertwined tails. The two are never separated and are therefore recognized as a single Daemon. Their consciousnesses seem to be completely synchronized, and their coordinated attacks are as threatening as those of a skilled swordsman with two swords.
There have been reports of seeing three or more bodies connected by a tail, but the possibility of misidentification or assumption has not been ruled out, and the information has yet to be confirmed.

name: Kekkubak

skills.name: Fairy Magic 3 Level /Magic Power 5(12)
text: It can use Earth and Fire types.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting].

skills.name: Spell Echo/Can’t
text: Within “Range: Caster” and “Target: All Areas (Radius 30m)/Space,”
Kekkubak creates a mysterious space is created in which it repeats spells.
For 10 seconds (1 round), when all characters in the affected area cast a
spell with "Target: 1 Character", another target 1 character is selected at
random at the same time.
A random character is selected from the characters existing within the
effect's area, excluding the original target and ignoring the spell’s original
range and shielding. If the spell is expanded by [Metamagic/Targets], this
effect repeats for each target.
Using this unique skill costs 5 points of MP.

description: This is a Daemon that can use Fairy Magic. It is approximately one meter long and looks like a thin old man, but its face resembles that of a bird of prey.

It can create a space that mysteriously reverberates magic and delights in disrupting it. It casts Fairy Magic, which is believed to be different in principle from the Fairy Magic used by Humanoid and others.

name: Agare

skills.name: Attitude Control
text: Agare cannot fall prone.

skills.name: Multi-Legged Attack & Twin Strike
text: Agare can make two Leg attacks each round. They may choose to attack
different characters with each attack.
If the second attack is made as a risk, it gains a -2 penalty to Evasion and
Willpower.

description: This Daemon looks like a human without a body from the waist down. Instead of legs, it has four pairs of long, jointed legs from its flanks and moves in a spider-like form.

Its head is red and enlarged, but it has no eyes or ears and perceives everything with its nose. In combat, it attacks by thrusting its legs, but when it concentrates on attacking, it slows down and creates an opening.

name: Nazrak
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head/Tentacle x 2) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Intimidating Gaze/6(13)/Willpower/Neg
text: Nazrak stares at “Target: 1 Character” within “Range/Area: 2
(20m)/Target” and is terrified it. The target takes a -2 penalty on all action
checks for 10 seconds (1 round).
This effect is of the psychic type.

skills.name: Frenzied Gaze/6(13)/Willpower/Neg
text: Nazrak stares at “Target: 1 Character” within “Range/Area: 2
(20m)/Target” and drives it temporarily crazy. The target receives a +2
bonus to any action check for 3 minutes (18 rounds), but it loses 5 points
of HP at the end of its turn. This may result in a zero or negative HP. If
the target becomes unconscious, the effect is automatically removed.
This effect is of the psychic type.

skills.name: Tail Sweep
text: It can attack up to 3 characters that can be reached with Tentacle attacks.
The Accuracy check should be rolled once, and if multiple characters are
hit, the damage is determined individually.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Nazrak height prevents enemies from attacking it. Head receives a +4
bonus to Evasion checks against melee attacks.
If any of the Tentacle sections have 0 HP or less, this effect is lost.

description: This 5-meter-long daemon is found mainly in and around Shallow Abysses. It is octopus-shaped with only two tentacles, its body is the head, and it has only one huge eye without eyelids.
A daemon tends to remain where it is thought to have been summoned or come through and does not significantly shift where it is active.

name: Movkira
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Chest / Belly) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Bloodsucking/Can’t
text: When a Tentacle attack hits, it deals 3 fixed damage to the target in
addition to the normal physical damage. At the same time, Head section’s
HP is recovered by 3 points.

skills.name: Fasten with Many Legs/8(15)/Evasion/Neg
text: Within "Range: Touch" captures "Target: 1 Character" with its eight legs
and tightens them. The target is dealt “2d + Chest section’s HP/5 (rounded
up)” physical damage.

skills.name: Hallucinogenic Poison Needle/6(13)/ Fortitude/Neg
text: The target of the needle attack will hallucinate and lose their judgment.
The target cannot use weapon attacks, cast spells, or other unique skills
that might make any section of this monster a target, or include any section
of this monster as a target, or make any section of this monster a target,
even if probable, for the next 10 seconds (1 round). If the target has
multiple sections, this effect is applied to all sections.
This effect of poison type.

loot.item: Poison Stinger with Intact Poison Sac (800G/Red A)

description: This is a spider-like Daemon with a complex purple pattern on its belly. Numerous tentacles extend from the jaws of the spider, and when connect, they drain the life of a living being. Tail needles have a poison that makes the target hallucinate.

name: Zalbard

skills.name: Flight
text: A Zalbard receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

skills.name: Flame Breath/9(16)/Fortitude/Half
text: A Zalbard breathes a gout of flame with “Range/Area: 1(10m)/Shot” at
“Target: 1 Character”, dealing 2d+8 fire magic damage.

description: It is a bright red lower Daemon with cortical wings and big horns. It is over 3 meters tall and has flaming red eyes. It can fly with its wings on its back and sometimes attacks with fire from the sky. It is often encountered in ruins and is estimated to be one of the most frequently summoned and used Daemons during the Magic Civilization Period.

name: Xenu
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Head / Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Xenu height prevents enemies from attacking it. Head receives a +4
bonus to Evasion checks against melee attacks.
If the Body section has 0 HP or less, this effect is lost.

description: This Daemon has the head of an anteater and the torso of a strong human male. Its whole body is reddish gray, and it is covered with feathers, which allow it to fly. It prefers to observe Humanoids and Barbarous who live a hedonistic and momentary life.

name: Doubleburg

skills.name: Double Attack
text: With the claws of both hands, it makes two attacks on 1 character. This
unique skill cannot be used on a character copied by [►Portrait].

skills.name: Portrait
text: It captures the appearance of the observed target and turns into it. If the
target is only seen at a glance, its appearance and personal belongings can
be matched. If the target can be perceived for 1 minute (6 rounds), it can
learn its language and imitate its tone and gestures so precisely that even a
close human cannot detect it. If it is taking the form of this unique skill, a
Monster Knowledge check cannot be performed on it unless Detect check
was made before.
This unique skill does not copy the target's class or unique skills. All the
data during the battle will be the monster's data. Attacks made by the
target's appearance are made by the monster's physical weapon (Claws),
even though it looks like the target's weapon is doing them.
A copy of a character in multiple sections appears to have the
corresponding number of sections. Still, only the Main Section (or one of
them in the case of multiple sections) is treated as Doubleburg. Other
sections do not perform any action. If this section is targeted and attacked,
the effect is automatically given to the monster. If the effect targets more
than one section simultaneously, the excess will do nothing, but at the same
time, it will be automatically found that the section does not exist. Detect
check is needed to find the actual section.
The [►Portrait] can be ended with Minor Action or during Combat
Preparation.

description: It is a black daemon of about the same size as a human. The face has a red, open mouth with a straight slit, but no other visible features exist.
This monster can shapeshift into the creature it perceives, then kills it and replaces it. It often enters into Humanoid and Barbarous societies.

Doubleburg's purpose is unknown, but they are said to be sent by the Daemons to learn about the intelligent life forms in the world of Raxia. They actively use their ability to transform, perhaps to advance their observations into the psychology of individuals and groups, and attempt to create doubt and confusion in cities and communities.
They are similar to Ogres and are considered more dangerous because they cannot be blocked by Swords of Protection.

name: Argagis

skills.name: Continuous Attack
text: If a monster successfully hits a target in melee, it may make a second
attack against the same target.

skills.name: Ball Roll
text: Argagis increases its Defense by +3 points and movement by +15m. At
the same time, its damage is reduced by -3.

skills.name: Cover I
text: Can use [Cover I] combat feat (see CR I, p. 256).

skills.name: All-Out Attack
text: A Slam can deal an additional 8 damage on its next attack. However, any
Evasion check made by this section this turn receives a -3 penalty as a risk.

description: Argagis is a Daemon that resembles an armadillo covered with a hard shell. It is characterized by its extreme strength and sturdiness. Its defense is further strengthened by its rounded back, which forms a considerable sphere that crushes its enemies. It does not have a high intellect and often follows other Daemons as a guard.

name: Grunel
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Body / Tail) Main Section: Body

skills.name: Truespeech Magic , Divine Magic 7 Level/Magic Power 10(17)
Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Mana Strike = +10 damage
text: A Grunel may deal an additional +10 damage to their next melee attack.
If they do, they receive a -2 penalty to Fortitude, and Willpower checks
until their next turn.

skills.name: Entangling Tail
text: A successful hit from a Tail entangles the target. In each round, the
entangled target is hit automatically by the Tail and makes all Accuracy and
Evasion Checks with a -2 penalty. This penalty is not cumulative.
When the target tries to escape, use de-bonding (see p. 71).
While entangled by this unique skill, the Tail section cannot attack other
characters. If the monster itself wants to release the target, it can do so with
a Minor Action.

description: A humanoid daemon with bronze skin and a height of about 3m, Grunels have long tails that they treat like whips.

Some individuals may have magic weapons as well (increasing both Accuracy and damage by +1), and with their aptitude for magic, it is assumed that the Grunel handmade this weapon. If a Grunel with a magic sword is killed, the sword is automatically looted. The GM may decide the sword's type at their own discretion.

Oddly enough, Grunels have been seen in the company of Grassrunners. It is not quite sure what the relationship between the two races is, and neither side is willing to talk about it. However, this has led to the rumor that Grassrunners come from another world.

name: Jinune

skills.name: Red Eye Menace/9(16)/Willpower/Neg
text: Stares at “Target: 1 Character” within “Range/Area: 1(10m)/Target”,
filling them with fear. A target who fails the resistance check suffers a -2
penalty on Accuracy and Evasion checks for 10 seconds (1 round).
This effect can be used only once per round. It also consumes 5 MP
when used.

skills.name: Vital Strike
text: If the 2d roll determining damage is 9 or more, the damage is increased
by +6 points.

description: This Daemon resembles a black horse that is about 5 meters in length. It has red eyes and a 1-meter-long black horn on its forehead.
It is brutal and ruthless and prefers to lure and trick lone Humanoids with its words.

name: Sihalus
sectionsNote: Sections: 4 (Head / Right Side / Left Side / Tail) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Semi-Transparent Body
text: The whole body is semi-transparent.
This monster does not create any shielding, even if it is on the battlefield.
Also, it is invisible to characters in a different area (Simplified Combat) or
at a distance of more than 10 meters (Standard Combat).

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], and [Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +5 points.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • +4
text: The giant body hinders attacks.
The Head section gains a +4 bonus to Evasion checks against melee and
ranged attacks.
This effect disappears when either Right or Left Side section falls to 0 HP
or lower.

skills.name: Tail Sweep
text: The monster can use its tail to attack up to 3 targets in the same skirmish.
Accuracy check should be made once; if multiple characters are hit,
damage should be determined individually.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Curse of Translucency/9(16)/Willpower/ Neg
text: Within "Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot", the monster shoots an invisible wave
from the tip of the Tail at "Target: 1 Character". The target gains the
[◯Semi-Transparent Body] unique skill. This effect is permanent of a
curse type.

description: It is a Lesser Daemon with a semi-transparent, reptilian-like appearance. It is about 4m long and attacks its opponent with a long bright red tongue.
Because of their ecology, they are very rare to find, and those that are found are almost without exception preyed upon.

name: Dark Bully

skills.name: Continuous Attack II
text: If Dark Bully successfully hits a target in melee, they may make a second
attack. They can make a third attack against the same target if a second
attack hits.

skills.name: Fatigue Poison/9 (16)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If a Claw attack deals at least 1 point of applied damage, the target's
Evasion is reduced by a -1. This effect is poison type and lasts for 1 hour.
It is cumulative if the same effect is applied within the duration.

skills.name: Shadow Cross
text: During Normal Move, it temporarily disappears and appears in any
shadow at the destination. In the absence of light, it can appear from
anywhere in the darkness.
It does not suffer any movement blocking and is free to leave the
skirmish.
This ability cannot be used in consecutive turns.

description: Standing at 2m tall, the Dark Bully appears entirely in shadow. A long claw grows from each hand instead of fingers, giving the appearance of the scythes of the god of death. It also has a powerful Continuous Attack unique skill and is recognized as a fearsome assassin.

name: Terror Beast

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: A Terror Beast can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action] and
[Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Dreadful/9(16)/Willpower/Neg
text: Anyone who sees the Terror Beast receives a -2 penalty to all Skill Checks
due to fear for 10 seconds (1 round). A Willpower check against this effect
must be made at the beginning of each character's turn. This effect is of a
psychic type.

skills.name: Corrosive Poison/11(18)/Fortitude/Neg
text: The target is poisoned if the Bite attack deals at least 1 point of applied
damage.
A poisoned character immediately suffers 2d-5 poison magic damage
(minimum 0) and continues to suffer the same damage on each of its turns
(no Fortitude check is needed). This effect lasts as long as it is not cured
but is not cumulative.

skills.name: Regeneration = 10 points
text: At the end of each round, Terror Beast recovers 10 HP. This has no
effect if Terror Beast has 0 HP or lower.

description: The Terror Beasts are considered the higher form of the Aetherbeasts.

It is about the size of a cow and four-legged, but it has a horrifying and bizarre appearance, and its body is constantly decomposing and regenerating. It emits an unpleasant odor, and those who see it can be weakened by fear.
They often follow other daemons and are known to act in groups. Their fangs are poisonous, and those that are bitten will surely die as their bodies slowly rot.

name: Godbell

skills.name: Complete Invisibility
text: Godbell is always invisible. See rules for invisibility (see CR II, p. 69).

skills.name: Invisible Assassin/20/Danger Sense/Neg
text: If a character approaches a location where this monster is lurking, they
need to make a Danger Sense check with target number 20. If they fail,
they will be taken by surprise by this monster.

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: A Godbell can make two Claws attacks each round. They may choose to
attack different characters with each attack.

skills.name: Space Warp
text: The monster can move 2 meters through the space itself without being
affected by any obstacles or magic effects. There must be no other objects
or characters at the destination.
Note that this ability has a very limited effect in combat (it is meaningless
in Simplified Combat, and even in Standard Combat, the distance is
insufficient to get past the skirmish).

description: Godbells are Lesser Daemons, also known as “formless daemons.” They are completely invisible, even after death, so their true appearance is unknown. Their unique skills, however, allow Godbells to be extraordinary assassins.
It is feared as a Daemon that is difficult to counter since it can permeate space and can slip through walls to surprise its enemies.

name: Shabalay

skills.name: Amorphous Body
text: Immune to criticals from edged weapons.

skills.name: Daemonic Droplets
text: An attack with Droplets is treated as a Shooting Attack with a "Range:
20m”. If the target is hit, the Defense is treated as half (rounded up).

skills.name: Red Droplets/11(18)/Fortitude/Half
text: Droplets begin to fly around the Shabalay.
All targets in the same skirmish area as the monster are dealt 2d+8 poison
magic damage. Using this effect consumes 10 points of MP.

description: This Daemon is a stubby, reddish-black, irregularly shaped creature with a number of small arms and legs.
Instead of using its legs or feet as it should, it moves by crawling. It does not speak any language but seems to have enough intellect to understand what others say.

name: Ragnakang
sectionsNote: Sections: 4 (Head / Body / Wing x 2) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Metamagic/Targets], and
[Wordbreak].

skills.name: Techniques
text: They may use the [Cat's Eyes], [Beetleskin], [Bear Muscle], and [Strong
Blood] Techniques.

skills.name: Deadly Poison /11(18)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If a Bite attack hits and deals 1 or more points of applied damage, the
target receives extra 2d+8 poison magic damage.

skills.name: Convulsive Poison/10 (17)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Tail attack hits, the target receives a -1 penalty to any Skill Checks
for 1 minute (6 rounds). This effect is cumulative.
This effect is of the poison type.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Against melee attacks Head sections receive a +4 bonus to Evasion
checks.
This effect disappears when the Body section falls to 0 HP or lower.

skills.name: Flight
text: All section receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If one of the Wing sections falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot
be used.

description: It is a daemon that appears as an upright dragon with enormous membranous wings. When a Ragnakang fully extends its neck, it stands around 5m long and will use that long neck and tail in combat. Thoroughly infused with poison, a Ragnakang is dangerous to touch, let alone engage in combat. Some still stand guard at the entrances to old ruins, and such places have seen no intrusions because of the Ragnakang's diligence.

name: Selassaroui

skills.name: Gem-Smashing
text: Gems throughout the body shatter with each wound, injuring the
opponent.
Any target that hits with a melee attack or applies a "Range: Touch" effect
to this monster takes "1d+2" points of fixed damage each time.

skills.name: Multi-arm Stance
text: The monster can have up to four Jeweled Spears, one for each arm.
When two or more spears are held, the Selassaroui can perform a
combination of Melee Attack and [►Jeweled Spear Throw] up to two
times in total. In this case, it can choose the second attack method and
target after seeing the result of the first roll.
This monster already has 4 spears at the start of combat. If it loses one due
to [►Jeweled Spear Throw], it can create a new one with [⏩Create Jeweled
Spear]. With only one spear, it can only make one melee attack or
[►Jeweled Spear Throw].

skills.name: Jeweled Spear Throw/13(20)/Evasion/Neg
text: The Selassaroui attacks by throwing a spear in its hand.
Throw has "Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot" at "Target: 1 Character" and deals
2d+13 physical damage.
Jeweled Spear will be shattered and lost regardless of the result of the
attack.

skills.name: Create a Jeweled Spear
text: Creates a Jeweled Spear in hand. This effect can be used only once per
round and costs 8 MP.

description: This Daemon takes the form of a muscular human about 2 meters in length, with two pairs of four arms. Countless sharp gem fragments protrude from its body.
It can produce jeweled spears from its own body and use them as weapons. However, approaching the spear will result in injury from the sharp gems protruding from its body.
These Daemons may appear as soldiers of Greater Daemons.

name: Mahatiga
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Body / Wings) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Metamagic/Targets], and
[Multi-Action].

skills.name: Mana Strike = +12 damage
text: May deal an additional +12 damage to their next melee attack. At risk,
they take a -2 penalty to their Fortitude and Willpower checks.

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: It can make two Claws attacks each round, though each attack requires its
Accuracy check. They may choose to attack different characters with each
attack.

skills.name: Flight
text: All section receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If the Wings section falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be
used.

skills.name: Wind-Edge Blade/12(19)/Fortitude/Half
text: With "Range/Area: 2(30m)/Target", Mahatiga uses a blade made of
feathers to deal with dealing 2d+12 slashing magic damage.
This ability costs 6 MP.

description: This is a daemon with the head of an elephant and the body of a raptor, frequently seen in Shallow Abysses.
They prioritize offering sacrifices to the god they believe in, and the more brutal the sacrifice, the better. They believe that the act of fighting is itself an offering to the gods.

name: Melbiz
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Upper Body / Lower Body) Main Section: Upper Body

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: A Melbiz can make two Claws attacks each round. They may choose to
attack different characters with each attack.

skills.name: Acid Saliva/12(19)/Evasion/Neg, Underwater/Can't
text: The Melbiz spits a gob of acid with “Range/Area: 2(20)m/Shot” and
“Target: 1 Character” and deals 2d+7 poison physical damage. In addition,
the target's armor and defense are damaged.
If the target is a character that has PC data, the Defense of any equipped
armor or shield chosen by the target must be reduced by -1.
This effect is cumulative, and if Defense becomes 0, it will be completely
destroyed. Armor with reduced Defense can be repaired by paying 10%
(up to 90%) of the armor's price for each reduction.
Each time a character with the monster data is affected by this effect, its
Defense is reduced by -1. The effect is cumulative but only down to 0.
Defense is restored by +1 point per day.
If this ability is used underwater, the acid will dissolve and spread in the
water, having "Range: Caster" "Target: 1 area (5m Radius)/15” “Resistance:
Can't” and deal 2d poison magic damage. This form of attack cannot be
evaded but also does not damage armor.
This unique skill cannot be used on consecutive turns.

description: Melbiz is a Lesser Daemon adapted to water, sporting shiny green scales and a dorsal fin. Standing just slightly taller than an average human at 2.5m tall, they are adapted to the water and will sneak into civilized lands through rivers and canals. High-ranking daemons will often use a contingent of Melbiz to spearhead an attack, coming from the water to attack unsuspecting cities.

name: Ezerve
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Body / Tail) Main Section: Head

skills.name: White Skin
text: The physical and magical damage of the lightning and energy type is
reduced by -3 points.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use Combat Feats [Universal Metamagic], [Targeting], [Hawk
Eye], [Magic Convergence], [Magic Control], and [Multi-Action].

skills.name: Breath of Endless Sleep/Optional
text: Spits white breath on up to 5 targets of Ezerve’s choice within “Range:
Caster”, sapping life from them.
The targets are placed in a state of suspended animation and are treated
as if no time has elapsed.
A character in this state is indistinguishable from a corpse.
If the character knows about this ability (they have prior knowledge of the
ability, or have successfully performed a Monster Knowledge check on this
monster), they can perform a Detect check with Target Number 20 on a
corpse that they strongly suspect is under this effect, and if successful, they
can detect that the corpse is in a state of suspended animation under this
effect.
This ability is treated as “Resistance: Can't” for targets with 0 or less HP.
This ability requires 10 minutes to use. It also consumes 30 MP when
used.
This effect is treated as a poison and curse type with a Success Value of

skills.name: Flash of a Magic Blade
text: Makes a Melee Attack against the target in the same skirmish area where
this monster is located (as a declared action).
This effect cannot be performed on consecutive turns and costs 8 MP.

skills.name: Painful Strike
text: If the 2d roll of the damage roll is 10 or more, the damage is increased
by an additional +9 points.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4・+4
text: The size of the body hinders attacks.
The Head section gains a +4 bonus to Evasion checks against melee
attacks and ranged attacks.
If the HP of the Body section falls to 0 or below, it loses this ability.

skills.name: Sucking Needles/13 (20)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If the Needles attack hits and deals 1 or more points of applied damage,
the MP of all sections is restored by 5 points.
If the MP of a section is more than half of the maximum value, the MP
of that section is not recovered.

skills.name: Point Needle/13 (20)/Willpower/Half
text: Throws a needle at the target character within “Range: 10m” and deals
2d+8 curse magic damage. Using this effect consumes 5 MP.

description: This Daemon is about 4 meters long and resembles a beautiful woman wearing a white cloak. Her hair and face are also white, while only the tip of her tail and her eyes are golden. The mantle is not a garment but skin that shimmers around her body like velvet.

Ezerves are rational and aggressive, preferring to work alone and not getting along with others. They can breathe a white substance that puts creatures into a state of suspended animation. The creature in this state is indistinguishable from a corpse, and after a funeral or other ceremony is held for it as if it were dead, the creature likes to cause despair by informing Humanoids of its true state.
Additionally, creatures put into suspended animation may be used as offerings for summoning other Daemons or as a Daemon Seminarium.

name: Cerberus
sectionsNote: Sections: 4 (Head x 3 / Body) Main Section: Heads (All)

skills.name: Three Breaths
text: Mouth spits one of the following breaths: Fire Breath, Blizzard Breath,
or Noxious Breath. All of them have “Range: Caster” and “Target: 1 area
(6m Radius)/20” around the head.
Head can choose any breath to use (or whether to attack with Bite without
using breath). If more than one head breathes the same kind of breath, it
is treated as a single attack with increased success value. If two heads
breathe the same breath, the breath's success value has a +2 bonus, and the
calculated damage is increased by +4. If all three heads breathe the same
breath, the success value has a bonus of +4, and the calculated damage is
increased by +8.
1: Fire Breath/11(18)/Fortitude/Half
Head exhales fire, dealing 2d+12 fire magic damage to the affected
targets.
2: Blizzard Breath/10 (17)/Fortitude/Half
Head spits out a blizzard, dealing 2d+8 water/ice magic damage to the
targets and reducing their Defense by -5 points for 30 seconds (3 rounds).
This Defense reduction is non-cumulative and does not reduce Defense
below 0.
3: Noxious Breath/9(16)/Fortitude/Half Head spits poison, inflicting 2d+6
poison magic damage to the targets, and they incur a -3 penalty to their
Evasion checks for 30 seconds (3 rounds). This effect is not cumulative.

skills.name: Techniques
text: May use the [Beetleskin] and [Bear Muscle] Techniques.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Against melee attacks Head sections receive a +4 bonus to Evasion
checks.
This effect disappears when the Body section falls to 0 HP or lower.

description: A three-headed daemon dog, a Cerberus is really more the size of a horse. Able to conjure up breath weapons of fire, ice, and poison, it can be a dangerous foe in combat. Also known as the Watchdog of Hell, Cerberuses are typically seen guarding something, whether the entrance to a labyrinth, a vault inside, or something else. While its intelligence is that of an average dog's, a Cerberus will remain loyal to its orders and will fight to the death to carry them out.

name: Sallytegane
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Body / Wings) Main Section: Body

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting], and
[Metamagic/Targets].

skills.name: Strange Smell/13(20)/Fortitude/Neg
text: All the body's holes within “Range: Caster” emit a foul odor. All
characters in the same position (area, coordinate) as the Body section
receive a -2 penalty to Willpower for 3 minutes (18 rounds).
This ability can be used only once per round, and when used, it consumes
5 MP of the Body section and can be used only once per round.
This effect is of a disease type.

skills.name: Flight
text: All sections receive a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If the Wings section falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be
used.

skills.name: All-Out Attack
text: Wings can deal an additional 8 damage on its next attack. However, any
Evasion check made by this section this turn receives a -3 penalty.

skills.name: High Mobility
text: The skin covering the wings is peeled off, exposing the flesh and
increasing mobility. For 3 minutes (18 rounds), the bonus to Accuracy
checks and Evasion checks from [◯Flight] for all sections is increased to
On the other hand, the Defense of Wings section is reduced by -4.
This effect can be used only when the Wings section's HP is 40 or less,
and once it is used, it cannot be canceled by the monster’s will.

description: This is a white, Lesser Daemon, about 3m long, in the shape of a white bug, with four beautiful bird feathers. Its white body surface, including its wings, is not covered with feathers but rather hard rocks.
Its body emits an intense odor that pierces the nose.
It is said that it is arrogant and always looks down on others, especially those who give it orders, and that it will always rebel.

name: Holgrad

skills.name: Truespeech Magic, Spiritualism Magic, Summoning Arts 12 Level
text: /Magic Power 15(22)

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Hawk Eye], [Magic
Convergence], [Magic Control], [Universal Metamagic], [Multi-Action].

skills.name: Mana-binding Fog/15(22)/Willpower/Temporary
text: Within "Range/Area: 2(30m)/Target" will cause the black mana to cling
to the "Target: 1 Character" and inhibit the casting spell.
The target has all Magic Power reduced by -5 for 3 minutes (18 rounds).
This effect cannot be used in consecutive turns and costs 10 MP.

skills.name: Mana Strike = +15 damage
text: May deal an additional +15 damage to their next melee attack. At risk,
they take a -2 penalty to their Fortitude and Willpower checks.

description: Holgrad is a Daemon whose entire body is composed of black mist (see p. 5). It looks like a silhouette of a woman wearing a shimmering cloak or a deformed figure with numerous tentacles fluttering in the air.
It is familiar with many systems of magic and has a strong attachment to them. It is furious when magic is used in front of it and takes the initiative in eliminating and weakening enemy magicians.

name: Lunzemase

skills.name: 2 Actions
text: Can perform two Major Actions in one round.

skills.name: Sparkling Fibers
text: It isn't easy to see Lunzenmase from a distance. A character who is more
than "Range: 1 (10m)" away from this monster receives a -2 penalty on
checks (Accuracy check, Spellcasting check, Performance check, etc.)
when making ranged attacks, casting a spell, finale, and other unique skills
that require visibility of this monster.

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: Can make two Weapon attacks each round, though each attack requires
its Accuracy check. They may choose to attack different characters with
each attack.

skills.name: Abyss Blade
text: If the target is hit by a Weapon attack, the target's Defense is halved for
that attack (rounded up). At risk, the monster takes a -1 penalty to Evasion
checks.

description: This Daemon wears a giant wooden mask reminiscent of a shield and has a body that looks like layers of strong fibers bound together. The mask is decorated with a pattern of straight lines that affect the creature's spirit if one tries to look at it.
As sparkling fibers make it difficult to see Lunzemase, powerful weapon attacks mercilessly reap the lives of creatures while dazzled.

name: Foregone
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Body / Legs) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: A Foregone can use the Combat Feats [Metamagic/Targets], [Multi-
Action], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: A Foregone can make two Claws attacks each round. They may choose
to attack different characters with each attack.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • +4
text: Foregone size hinders attack.
The Head cannot be attacked in melee. Against any ranged attacks, Head
receives a +4 bonus to Evasion checks.
When the Body falls to 0 HP or lower, this effect disappears.

skills.name: Kneel
text: If the HP of the Legs section is less than 0, the Body section receives a -
2 penalty on Accuracy and Evasion checks.

description: A Lesser Daemon, Foregones are 6m tall giants, with red-black skin, with one horn protruding from their forehead and the lower body of a goat.

name: Rigogan

skills.name: Targeting & Hawk Eye
text: It is possible to select a character in a melee area as a target for the "Area:
Line" effect without causing misfiring.
It also can aim through the shielding.

skills.name: Bow
text: Makes a Shooting Attack with a Bow at "Range: 2(50m)". Accuracy check
and damage are the same as in the normal attack.

skills.name: Heavy Bow/17(24)/Evasion/Neg
text: Rigogan draws its bow and fires with terrible force. Shooting attack with
"Range/Area: 2(50m)/: Line", those failing Evasion checks suffer "2d+20"
physical damage.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Rapid Fire Bow/17(24)/Evasion/Neg
text: Makes Shooting Attack with “Range: 2(20m)” on any 5 targets, dealing
"2d+13" physical damage.

skills.name: Final Arrow/19(26)/Evasion/Neg
text: If this monster's HP is 0 or less, its body thorns will scatter in the
explosion. Within "Range: Caster" and "Target: All areas (30m radius)/All"
targets are hit by "2d+20" points of physical damage.
This ability can be activated only once, after which the monster dies
automatically.

description: It is a Daemon with a huge bow; its entire body is covered with numerous hard thorns. This Daemon pulls out these spines by itself and uses them as arrows.

Unusually for Daemons, it prefers a fair fight. It prefers to avoid making a surprise attack and always start a fight when they can see each other. However, they have no hesitation in opening battle with an opponent who has only melee weapons, calling out from a distance of 50 meters, saying, "Come on, let's play it fair" (the argument being that it is worse to have no means of a long-range attack and may wait for them searching a bow).

name: Vangiga
sectionsNote: Sections: 7 (Body / Eye Hand x 2 / Ear Hand x 2 / Nose Hand / Mouth Hand) Main Section: Body

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Magic
Convergence], [Magic Control], [Hawk Eye], [Universal Metamagic],
[Rune Master], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Long Arms
text: Hands can do melee attacks with "Range/Area: 1(10m)/Target".

skills.name: Sight Augmentation
text: The Body section gains a +2 bonus to Evasion checks for each healthy
Eye Hand section.

skills.name: Hearing Augmentation
text: This monster gains a +2 bonus to Fortitude and Willpower checks for
each healthy Ear Hand section.

skills.name: Memorize the Smell
text: If Nose Hand performs an Accuracy check, regardless of the success or
failure of the check, Body and Nose Hand sections gain a +2 bonus to
Accuracy checks against the target. This effect is not cumulative and is
removed when the Nose Hand section HP becomes 0 or less.

skills.name: Bloodsucking
text: When a Bite attack hits, the HP of any one section of this monster is
recovered by the same value as applied damage. The monster can choose
which section to heal after each attack, and applied damage is calculated.
However, the section whose HP is 0 or less cannot be selected for heal.

description: It is a Greater Daemon with a monkey-like appearance, but instead of the usual shoulders and arms, it has six long arms sprouting from its back. On the palm of each arm, there are facial parts such as eyes and ears (the original face also has eyes and noses).
As additional sensory organs, these hands give them high perception and make them adept at avoiding danger.
It is said that this Daemon is the type of person who plans each action. When this Daemon appears in Shallow Abyss, it is said to be filled with countless traps and tricks.

name: Dreadbar
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Upper Body / Front / Rear) Main Section: Front

skills.name: Regeneration = 10 points
text: At the end of each round, each section of the Dreadbar recovers 10 HP.
This has no effect if the section has 0 HP or lower.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Magic
Convergence], [Magic Control], [Universal Metamagic], [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Mana Strike = +17 damage
text: May deal an additional +17 damage to their next melee attack. At risk,
they take a -2 penalty to their Fortitude and Willpower checks.

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: A Dreadbar can make two Bite attacks each round. It may choose to
attack different characters with each attack.

skills.name: Blizzard Breath/16(23)/Fortitude/Half
text: The Dreadbar vomits a mass of cold air with “Range/Area: 2(30m)/Shot”
in “Target: 1 area (Radius 6m)/20”, dealing 2d+15 water/ice magic damage.
This unique skill cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Tail Swing
text: A Dreadbar can use its Tail to attack up to 5 targets in the same skirmish.

description: Dreadbar is a bizarre daemon with a giant crocodile's lower body and a human's upper body. It has crocodile skin and large horns and uses spears and other weapons. It is 5m tall and 10m in length.

Dreadbar prefers to be near water, such as oceans and rivers and sometimes makes underwater ruins it's home. It is very powerful and can use high-level Divine Magic. It sometimes has other Daemons, such as Melbiz, as its subordinates. Gilmen sometimes worship it as a god.

At first glance, the human-like section appears to be its main section, but Dreadbar's brain is housed inside its crocodile-like front. When it speaks, its voice emits from the mouth of its upper body, which resembles a human, so that an uninformed opponent will not realize where its main section is.

Although they have high intellect, they are brutal and enjoy killing, so if you encounter them, you will not be able to avoid a fight. They are sometimes found sealed as guardians in the underwater ruins of Ancient Magical Civilization.

name: Doppelganger
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Upper Body / Lower Body) Main Section: Upper Body

skills.name: Shapeshift
text: The Doppelganger can change its shape into another's, with the quality of
the transformation based on the time the Doppelganger has observed the
target. A quick glance at a target allows the Doppelganger to copy the
target's physical appearance, including any belongings. One minute's
observation (6 rounds) allows for copying the target's tone and mannerisms,
while one hour's observation gives a complete copy of the target's abilities
and memory. This last transformation will also allow the Doppelganger
access to any Classes and spells the target may have learned. This unique
skill lasts until the Doppelganger reverts to its base form, taking Major
Action to do so.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: A Doppelganger can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic
Convergence], [Magic Control], [Metamagic/Targets], [Multi-Action],
[Rune Master], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Against melee attacks Upper Body section receive a +4 bonus to Evasion
checks.
This effect disappears when the Body section falls to 0 HP or lower.

description: One of the Greater Daemons, a Doppelganger's base form is that of a black-skinned giant 3m tall. A single red line splits the face where its mouth would be, but its face is otherwise featureless. This Daemon has the ability to shapeshift into the target it has observed, and its usual method is to kill the target, take its place, and enter the Humanoid society to plot secret evil, causing suspicion and confusion in the society.

name: Barusa Biyone
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Body / Legs) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Margin of Strength
text: The [►Blizzard Breath], [🗨Power Strike II], and [⏩Mobile Form]
abilities are not used until any section has less than 100 HP.

skills.name: Blizzard Breath/18(25)/Fortitude/Half
text: The Barusa Biyone vomits a mass of cold air with “Range/Area:
2(30m)/Shot” in “Target: 1 area (Radius 6m)/20”, dealing 2d+20 water/ice
magic damage.
This unique skill cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Soul Freezing Roar/17(24)/Willpower/Neg
text: Barusa Biyone lets out a soul-chilling, terrifying roar, terrifying within
“Range: Caster” “Target: All Areas (Radius 30m)/All”. The target must
move farther than 30 meters from Barusa Biyone if possible, or if
movement is not enough, Full Move to get as far away as possible. The
character in the skirmish must always declare withdraw. The affected
targets cannot attack Barusa Biyone with melee or ranged attacks, nor can
it be directly targeted by the “Target: 1 Character” magic or effects.
This effect lasts only for 10 seconds (1 round) and is psychic type.

skills.name: Power Strike II
text: A Barusa Biyone can deal an additional +12 damage on their next attack.
However, any Evasion Check made by them this turn receives a -2 penalty.

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: A Barusa Biyone can make two Iron Claws attacks each round. They may
choose to attack different characters with each attack.

skills.name: Mobile Form
text: The armor covering the entire body transforms, making it easier to move
and attack. The Body section gains a +4 bonus for Accuracy, Evasion, and
+4 for Damage. At the same time, Defense is reduced by -10.
This unique skill, once used, cannot be deactivated until the combat is
over.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible, +4 & +4 • None
text: Barusa Biyone’s size precludes attacks. The Head section cannot be the
target of melee attacks and gains a +4 bonus on Evasion checks against
ranged attacks.
The Body section receives a +4 bonus to Evasion checks against melee
attacks.
When the Legs fall to 0 HP or lower, this effect disappears.

description: Barusa Biyone is a Greater Daemon that takes the form of an upright white bear wearing black full-body armor. It stands 7 meters tall and has glowing red eyes, like a bright fire.

Legend has it that it lived in a frozen place in the Daemon world where everything was at absolute zero, which may explain its preference for silence (oddly enough, the armor that covers its entire body makes no sound). If anything disturbs the silence, it will attack mercilessly.

Barusa Biyone is immensely confident in its armor and is accustomed to mocking those who cannot break it, treating them like small insects. However, if an enemy manages to break its armor, Barusa Biyone will acknowledge them and destroy them first.

name: Lada Adroda
sectionsNote: Sections: 6 (Head x 2 / Body / Wing x 2 / Tail) Main Section: Head (All)

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: A Lada Adroda can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic
Convergence], [Magic Control], [Metamagic/Targets], [Hawk Eye], [Multi-
Action], [Rune Master], and [Wordbreak].

skills.name: Techniques
text: A Lada Adroda can use the [Gazelle Feet], [Cat's Eyes], [Recovery (10
pts.)], [Scale Leggings], [Strong Blood], [Beetleskin], [Bear Muscle],
[Centaur Legs], [Giant Arms] and [Daemonfinger] Techniques.

skills.name: Deadly Poison/22(29)/Fortitude/Neg
text: If a Bite attack hits and deals 1 or more points of applied damage, the
target receives extra 2d+12 poison magic damage.

skills.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
text: A Lady Adroda can make two Claws attacks each round. They may
choose to attack different characters with each attack.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Against melee attacks Head sections receive a +4 bonus to Evasion
checks.
This effect disappears when the Body section falls to 0 HP or lower.

skills.name: Flight
text: All sections receive a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.
If one of the Wings falls to 0 HP or lower, this unique skill cannot be
used.

skills.name: Tail Sweep
text: The monster can use its tail to attack up to 5 targets in the same skirmish.
An Accuracy check is made on all characters at once, and damage is
determined individually.
This attack cannot be used in consecutive rounds.

description: Lada Adroda is a superior species in the same family as the Lesser Daemon Ragnakang. However, the Lada Adroda is much larger and has two heads instead of one. This Greater Daemon has a commanding role over the Daemons, and has as many as one hundred Daemons in its ranks.

name: Endertuz
sectionsNote: Sections: 6 (Maiden / Pearl / Ivy x 4) Main Section: Pearl

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Targeting], [Magic Convergence],
[Magic Control], [Universal Metamagic], [Double Cast], and [Rune
Master].

skills.name: Knowledge & Weakness Exploit
text: Endertuz can make Sage Knowledge checks with standard value 18 (25
fixed value).
Endertuz deals double damage to other monster weak points it detected.

skills.name: Open Eyes/⏩Close Eyes
text: The Maiden section has different abilities depending on its eyes
condition. When the eyes are closed, the Maiden section is treated as blind
(other sections still have eyesight).
The [⏩Open Eyes] and [⏩Close Eyes] can be performed only once
before the Main section performs the Major Action.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • +4
text: The maiden is holding the pearl and shielding it.
The Pearl section gains a +4 bonus to Evasion checks against melee and
ranged attacks.
This effect disappears when the Maiden section falls to 0 HP or lower.

skills.name: Lovely Figure/22(29)/Willpower/Neg
text: It binds adversaries with guilt and inhibits their actions.
A character who inflicts 1 or more applied damage by a melee attack to the
Maiden section and fails a Willpower check cannot take any Major or
Minor Actions for the following 1 minute (6 rounds).
This effect is only active when the Maiden has her eyes closed and is
automatically canceled when the Maiden opens her eyes.
This effect is of the psychic type.

skills.name: Praying Maiden (Only When Eyes Closed)
text: Maiden and Pears sections heal HP and MP by 10 points at the end of
their turn.

skills.name: Raging Maiden (Only When Eyes Open)
text: The Maiden section is treated as having acquired the following Combat
Feats (in addition to those of [◯🗨Magic Aptitude]):
[Multi-Action], [Mana Strike], and [Battle Master].

skills.name: Mana Resistance
text: Reduce all Magic Damage Pearl section received by -5.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • Impossible
text: Tangled ivy hinders attacks.
The Maiden and Pearl sections cannot be targeted by a melee or ranged
attacks.
This unique skill is lost when two or more Ivy sections have 0 or fewer
HP.

skills.name: Coordinated Attack
text: If an attack on an Ivy section is evaded, the other section's attacks on that
target gain a +1 to the Accuracy check against that target. This modifier is
accumulated for each evaded attack. However, once any section attack hits
or the monster's turn is ended, it is lost.

description: This is a Greater Daemon that looks like a maiden holding a pearl with countless ivies entwined around her. The maiden is said to have taken the body of a person who was once sacrificed to this Daemon. The Maiden enjoys showing herself to make others hesitate to attack her or to make them feel guilty. At first glance, it looks like a Plant, but the main section is the central pearl, and the ivies and the maiden accompany it to protect it.

name: Geldam
sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Head / Upper Body / Lower Body) Main Section: Head

skills.name: Miasma Shroud/25(32)/Fortitude/Half
text: Strong poison gas swirls around Geldam. Each time a character attempts
a melee attack against this monster, they suffer 2d+10 poison magic
damage, regardless of success or failure.
This poison gas deflects incoming arrows and bullets and has the same
effect as the Fairy Magic spell [Missile Protection].

skills.name: 2 Actions
text: Can perform two Major Actions in one round.

skills.name: Magic Aptitude
text: They can use the Combat Feats [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Magic
Convergence], [Magic Control], [Metamagic/Targets], [Rune Master], and
[Wordbreak].

skills.name: Poison Breath/24(31)/Fortitude/Half
text: With "Range: Caster," it scatters smoky poison breath around it and deals
to "Target: 1 area (6m Radius)/20" 2d+20 poison magic damage.
This ability can only be used once every 10 seconds (1 round).

skills.name: Sweeping Attack
text: Geldam makes a Weapon attack against all enemies that it can reach. If
[🗨Power Strike III] is declared, the damage is added to any one of the hit
characters. The effect of [🗨 Magic Weapon] becomes the success value
of the Accuracy check for all targets.
This unique skill cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Magic Weapon
text: Changes the success value of the Accuracy check with the weapon to 35
without rolling any dice.
This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns.

skills.name: Power Strike III
text: They can deal an additional +20 damage on their next attack. However,
any Evasion Check made by them this turn receives a -2 penalty.

skills.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
text: Against melee attacks Upper Body and Head sections receive a +4 bonus
to Evasion checks.
This effect disappears when Lower Body section falls to 0 HP or lower.

loot.item: Great Daemon’s Glaive (3,200G/Gold Black White S)

description: This goat-like Archdaemon is subservient to only the Daemon King. Geldams are large, muscular goatmen, 5m tall, and carry a massive glaive. These glaives are larger than adult human, and magically bonded to the Geldam that carries them, so it is impossible to claim one as the spoils of battle.
Being Archdaemon Geldams, they have hundreds of Daemons at their command. Because of their service to the Daemon King in the Daemon World, however, they will rarely appear in Raxia themselves.
Humanoids

name: Ordinary Person

skills.name: Sword's Grace/Change Fate
text: Once per day, they may choose to change the result of a Skill Check or
Damage roll, by switching the faces of the rolled 2d to the opposite sides.

description: These are civilians who do not have the means to fight. If you need data for a civilian NPC in a scenario, you may use this data.

name: Bandit Archer

skills.name: Bow
text: An attack with a Bow is treated as a Shooting Attack with "Range: 2

skills.name: Targeting
text: Stray shots cannot occur.

skills.name: Sword's Grace/Change Fate
text: Once per day, they may choose to change the result of a Skill Check or
Damage roll, by switching the faces of the rolled 2d to the opposite sides.

description: These bandits carry weapons and attack merchants and travelers. If they go out in the wilds, they are called thugs or bandits; if they go out on the sea, they are pirates. This data represents those who use bows as weapons among them.

They are the lowest level in a large organization, but they may operate in groups of three to five people. Such small groups mainly target those with low protection and are unlikely to challenge strong or numerous enemies.
This data can also be used to represent lower level soldiers or villagers who use a bow.

name: Bandit Trooper

skills.name: Sword's Grace/Change Fate
text: Once per day, they may choose to change the result of a Skill Check or
Damage roll, by switching the faces of the rolled 2d to the opposite sides.

description: Armed with weapons, these thugs attack merchants and travelers. They are armed only with mundane one-handed melee weapons and crude leather armor.
This data can be used to represent lower-level soldiers, villagers with weapons, etc.

name: Mounted Bandit
sectionsNote: Sections: 2 (Rider / Horse) Main Section: Rider

skills.name: Dismounting
text: This monster’s Rider section is mounted on the Horse section. If the
Rider is dismounted, all sections suffer a -1 penalty on all Skill Checks and
have their damage reduced by -1 point.
See Rider class and the Riding Rules for rules (at CR III, p. 84) for this
monster on how to dismount and mount back at the mount. If not on
mount speed, this monster becomes “12/-”.

skills.name: Sword’s Grace/Change Fate
text: Once per day, they may choose to change the result of a Skill Check or
Damage roll by switching the faces of the rolled 2d to the opposite sides.

description: Riding on horseback, these thugs attack travelers and peddlers. Armed with spears, they block the way of their prey with their horses, threaten them, and take their money and goods. They work in groups of several to ten men.

name: Swift Blade

skills.name: Throw Knife/4(11)/Evasion/Neg
text: Throws a knife. This unique skill deals 1d+1 physical damage to “Target:
1 Character” at "Range: 1 (10m)".
This effect may be used up to twice per combat.

skills.name: Killing Blow
text: If the 2d roll determining damage is 9 or more, the damage is increased
by +4 points.

skills.name: Sword's Grace/Change Fate
text: Once per day, they may choose to change the result of a Skill Check or
Damage roll, by switching the faces of the rolled 2d to the opposite sides.

description: This is a Humanoid agile warrior. It is not only a melee attacker, but also can throw knives and quickly moves, leading the battle to an advantageous situation.

description: This is a heavy warrior armed with a large shield and metal armor, a one- handed weapon. They are knights who protect important Humanoid strongholds, such as royal castles and customs posts.
All Humanoid monsters in this book were created assuming that race is Human.
Here are some guidelines for using it with other races.
You can use this data when you want to treat a specific NPC as monster data or when you want to make an enemy of a specific race appear as a monster.
Data Modification

When each value is decreased, the minimum value of the Standard Value and Fixed Success Value is treated as "0(7)". Similarly, the minimum value for Damage is "2d-2," and the minimum value for Defense is "0".
[◯Sword's Grace/Change Fate]
As it goes without saying, this unique skill exists on the assumption that race is Human; if race is changed to something other than Human, this ability should be removed.
Adjustment of Unique Skills

For the sake of simplicity, some racial ability effects are only reflected as modifications and are not specified in the unique skills column. For example, the racial ability [Darkvision] is listed as "Perception Modification: Five Senses (Darkvision)" and not separately. The effect of [Sword’s Grace/Gentle Water] for Elves of level 11 or higher is not included in the monster data as it is unlikely to be relevant during battle.

Additionally, there are cases where some inconsistencies are allowed, and the process is simplified. For instance, when we give both [Sword's Grace/Gentle Water] and [Sword's Grace/Body of Flame] to Elves and Dwarves after the 6th level, the use of one of the hands is intentionally omitted.
